tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phya g.yang 'gugs pa'-i phrin las sgrigs su bkod pa bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (220)

kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur dngos mtsho skyes rje// shes rab blo gros mi zad zhi ba 'tsho// mes dbon gsum sogs snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi// babs so gsum gyi bdag po rnams la btud// gsar rnying grub thob rgya mtsho'i thugs bcud gter// rgyal bstan rnyed dang bkur stis rgyas pa'i tshul// rdo rje'i lam mchog nor bu'i mdzod khang las/ byung ba'i tsinta ma ṇi 'di nyid rmad// 'dir brten gyi gang zag dbang thob sdom pa la gnas pas sbyor ba yo byang bshams rang gzhung las byung ba bzhin tshags su tshud pas/ dngos gzhi'i bsgom bzlas la/ thog mar bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ hri sngon bskal ma'i tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang*// snga 'gyur bka' ma'i tshul khrims dri ldan sogs kyis sros phyung sngon du 'gro bas skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa ni/ dus 'di nas bzung bla med byang chub bar// bla ma dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam lha// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// 'ur sum brdung*/ ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal bas thugs bskyed ltar// bdag gi bla med byang chub sems bskyed de// (221)snying rje chen pos 'gro kun dbang bsdus nas// bla med byang chub lam la 'god pa'i phyir// dbang gi lha mo bdag gi bsgrub par bya// sum brdung*/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ tshogs bsags zhing sdom pa bzung ba ni/ rang nyid skad cig rigs byed mar gsal ba'i// thugs ka'i zla steng hriḥ las 'od 'phros pas// 'og min mkha' spyod bde chen zhing khams na// ku ru kulle'i lha tshogs bco lnga la// sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med bskor ba dang*// steng du bla ma 'od dpag med mgon bcas// nam mkhar spyan drangs badzra sa ma dza// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal na mo hūm̐// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// thog med dus nas bsags pa'i sdig kun bshags// 'phags rnams tshogs gnyis bsags la rjes yi rang*// 'gro blo dang 'tshams chos 'khor bskor bar bskur// mya ngan mi (222)'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo// dkon mchog gsum la rtag pa skyabs su mchi// smon dang 'jug pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do// sangs rgyas rigs lnga phyi nang gsang ba yi// sdom pa dam tshig rnams kyangabadag gis bzung*// 'khor ba'i sems can thar pa'i lam la 'god// nyan rang rnams ni theg chen sa la bzhag

/kun kyang rdzogs byang 'di la 'god par bgyi// tshogs zhing lha tshogs rang gi snying gar thim// sems can thams cad bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan// sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras kun dang bral gyur cig /dus rnams rtag tu bde ba tshad med pa// de la phyogs ris med par bdag sems snyoms// nang mchod byin brlabs ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa= stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ raṃ oṃ ā hūm̐// zhu ba las byung rlung me thod sgyed steng*// ā:yig las byung mtshan ldan ka pa lar// ('ur sum brdung*/ nyin rjes ma rnams la sum brdung rkyang pa/)(223)go ku da ha na las sha chen lnga*/ bī ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga*/ de steng bhrum̐ sams khaṃ dziṃ hūm̐ yig las/ sangs rgyas lnga yi ngo bor gyur pa'i steng*// hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan// de las 'od 'phros rlung g.yos me sbar bas// thod pa'i rdzas zhu steng du rdo rje lhung*// lan gsum dkrug nas rdo rje zhu nas thim// dri med shel ltar dwangs pa'i bdud rtsir gyur/ zhes mkha' lding gi rgya dang*/ oṃ ā hūṃ ha ho hrī/ lan gsum sngon gtor btang ba ni/ bhrum̐ la rin chen snod du oṃ yig las// gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan phun tshogs pa/ oṃ ā hūm̐ gis zag med bde skyed gyur// sa phyogs 'dir gnas sa bdag yul bdag dang*/ sa bdag bgegs dang 'byung po kun la byin// so sor tshims na dga' mgu yi rang mdzod// bdag gis gnas 'dir byang chub sgrub pa la// ko (225)long ru nga phra dog ma byed par// dkar phyogs rnams kyi bdag gi sdong grogs mdzod// nag phyogs rnams kyis ma 'che gzhan du dengs// gal te bsgo ba'i bka' la mi nyan na// rab 'bar ye shes rdo rjes mgo 'gems 'gyur// de phyir don chung nyan cher ma bsdo bar// rang lus srung zhing bag yod bya bar rigs/ oṃ sarba bhu ta bigha naṃ ba lingta khā hi khā hi/

u tsa ta ya phaṭa/ 'ur dgu brdung*/ zhes phyir 'dor la srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ aḥ stong pa'i ngang las 'og gzhi rdo rje'i sa// rab tu sra mkhregs dum bu gcig gyur pa'i// 'og kun rdo rje'i ra ba zlum po'i steng*// rdo rje mda' yi ra ba phub pa'i 'og /rdo rje'i bla bre bres shing phyir rol kun// ye shes me dpung kha dog lnga ldan gyur// bskal pa 'jig pa'i me bzhin rab tu 'bar// phyogs mtshams steng 'og bar med dum bur cig /(225)oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣahūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥswa hā/ 'ur sum brdung*/ de nas nyin dang por g.yang sgo 'byed pa'i cho ga rin po che'i lde'u mig sbyar/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ āḥ rin chen sna tshogs las grub thod pa'i snod// de steng hūm̐ yig las byung rdo rje yi// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dpag med pa// sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par bzhin// sangs rgyas zhing kun khyab pa'i mchod sprin 'phro// dus kun rgyun mi chad pa nam mkha'i mdzod// 'phags pa kun kyi spyan snga 'byung bar 'gyur// oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ sum brdung*// brten dang brten brkyed ni/ oṃ shud n+ya ta = chos rnams ye nas brjod bral stong pa nyid/ e las chos 'byung dkar po chos dbyings khyab// de nang 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab steng*// sna tshogs padma 'bum ldan nyi ma'i steng*// sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba bhrum̐ yig las// rin chen sna tshogs las grub gzhal yas khaṃ// (226)nang nas rim bzhin dmar ljang sngon po dang*/ ser po dkar po rtsigs pa rim pa lnga*// de steng gser gyi pha gu phra yis mdzes// rin chen bri phul gser gyi ska rag bzhi// chu srin kha nas drwa ba drwa phyed dang*// rnga yab me tog phreng ba me long dang*// zla ba rlung gi skyod pas rnam par mdzes// bya 'dab las 'phyang rin chen shar bu dang*/ steng du mda' yab padma phyed pa'i dbyibs// de dag bar du rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*// rnga yab gdugs dang dar dpyang rgyan gyis spras// phyi yis rnam bur mchod pa'i lha mos bskor// steng gi phyur bu rin chen tog gi brgyan// gru bzhi sgo bzhir sgo 'khyud mtshams dang zur// zla phyed la gnas rdo rje no bus spras// sgo bzhi'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi'i steng*// rta babs rnam bu bcu gcig rtse mo la// padma la gnas chos 'khor ri dwags (227)bcas// phyi'i sa gzhi rin chen 'dod yon gang*// pad 'dab rdo rwa ye shes me ris bskor// ye shes dkyil 'khor chen po de yi rgyab// phyogs mtshams 'jig rten rab 'jigs dur khrod brgyad// ri brgyad mtsho brgyad shing brgyad mchod rten brgyad// me brgyad sprin brgyad klu brgyad zhing skyong brgyad// rnor brgyad dang phyogs skyong chen po brgyad// ro dang keng rus sha za 'byung pos gang*/

de ru tshogs kun log par mi ltung ba'i// rang byungahe ru ka yi gnas mchog go/ pho brang nang gi sa gzhi shar phyogs dkar// lho ser nub sngo byang ljang dbus dmar ba'i// dbus dang phyogs bzhi phyogs mtshams steng 'og tu// padma dmar dang ro steng zla ba'i gnas/ dbus dmar hriḥyig dmar po'i 'phro 'du las// skad cig bcom ldan 'das ma rig byed ma// padma (228)raga'i mdog can gzi 'od 'bar// zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang po utpal gyi// mdel can mda' dang me tog dmar po yis// gzhu gnyis 'geng pa snyan gyi gong du bkong*// g.yas 'og lcags kyu dmar po g.yon 'og tu// utpal dmar po'i zhags pa 'debs pa'i tshul// dbu skra dmar ser gyen brdzes thod skam brgyan// spyan gsum dmar zlum g.yon du g.yo bar gzigs// zhal gdangs mche gtsigs lcags 'dril khro bo'i sku// thod rlon do shal phyag rgya lnga yi brgyan// rin chen dar dpyang stag gi sham thabs can// skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis pad nyi dang*// dbang phyug u ma sgra gcan snying gar mnan// ye shes rang 'od 'khrugs pa'i klong na 'gying*// de yi phyogs bzhir shar du rdo rje ma// lho ru gsang (229)ba'i sgau ri nub tu ni// chu ma byang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mtshams bzhir bum pa'i steng du thod pa bzhi// de rgyab phyogs bcu'i shar du go ri ma// lho ru tso ri nub tu be ta li// byang du ghasma ri dang dbang ldan du// puska si dang shar lhor sha ba ri// lho nub tsand+ra li dang nub byang du// ḍom bhi ni dang steng du mkha' spyod ma// 'og tu sa spyod ma rnams sku mdog dmar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis utpal mda' gzhu 'gengs// brkyang bskum gar sogs cha lugs gtso mo 'dra// kun kyi gnas gsum oṃ ā hūm̐ gsum dang*// gtso mo'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems// de yi thugs kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' hrī:

'khor kun thugasakar ming yig dang po las// thig les brgyan pa rnams las 'od zer 'phros// 'og min gnas (230)nas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems// nam mkhar spyan drangs badzra sa ma dza/ /spyan 'dren pa ni/ hrīḥ 'phags bzhi bskyed byed chos sku yum chen mo// gzugs kyi skur ston 'phags ma rig byed ma/ gshegs dang bzhugs pa'i mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*// chu zla bzhin du gnas 'dir snang bar mdzod// padma gar gyi dbang phyug gsang ba'i yum// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ngo bo nyid// padma rigs kyi lha mo kun kyi gtso// bde chen dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs su gsol// sgrol ma myur ma spyan ni glog ltar myur// 'jig rten dbang phyug yum gcig gsang ye ma// dbang byed sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun skyob ma// po ṭa la yi gnas nas gshegs su gsol// ḍā ki 'bum gyi gtso mo mdzad pa'i tshe// padma mkha' 'gro dbang gi lha mo mchog /gau ri la sogs lha mo bcu bzhir bcas// mkha' spyod (231)o rgyan gnas nas gshegs su gsol// 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs kyis// rgya gar ku ru kulla'i ri bo yi// phug pa'i dbus su rtag tu gnas bcas ma// lha mo ku ru kulle gshegs su gsol// pho brang gzhal yas pad nyi bdud bzhi'i steng*// rang rang gtso 'khor so so'i gdan steng du// brjid cing dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ku ru kulle sa pa ri wa ra badzra sa mā dzaḥdza hūm̐ baṃ ho/ padma ka ma la ye staṃ/ arghaṃ pra ti tstsha swa hā/ dbang bskur ba ni*/ rang gi thugs las sprul pa'i mchod pa yi// rgya mtshos mngon par mchod do putstsha hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam ye dbyer med 'dres// slar yang dbang lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas// nam mkhar spyan drangs sna tshogs mchod pas mchod// bdag la ye shes (232)lnga yi dbang bskur stsol// gsol btab mod la rigs lngas byin gyis rlabs// yum lngas bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur bas// dri ma kun dag bdud rtsi'i sku lus gang*// chu lhag yar phyur gtso mor 'od dpag med// 'khor rnams kun la gtso mos dbu brgyan gyur//

phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa ni/ bdag lus zhing gi rdul snyed rab sprul te// lus ngag yid gsum dang bas phyag 'tshal lo// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyi rnam sprul pa'i// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams thams cad na// bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung mchod pa'i tshogs// lha yi bdud rtsi dkar ser dmar sngo'i mtsho// yan lag brgyad ldan khrus kyi rdzing bu tshogs// padma ku mu ta dang utpal mtshal// ha ri sbrul snying glang po sa mchog ste// nyi zla nor bu brgya (233)byin tshangs pa'i 'od// gaṅga'i gzhung rgyud u rgyan mchod sbyin chu// lha dbang mi dbang zhal zas ro brgya pa// dri za'i rgyal po bye ba'i rgyud mang sgra// sum rtsen bye ba phrag brgya'i bltad mo mdzes// tshangs pa'i rgyal po stong gi bstod dbyangs snyan// zag med tshul khrims dri yi zhing kun khyab// ye shes bdud rtsi'i zag med bde skyed rol// dpag bsam shing las 'phyang ba'i lhardzas gos/ /shis byed rdzas mchog brgyad dang rgyal srid bdun// nor bu cha bdun rgyal po'i nyer spyod tshogs// bkra shis grub pa'i rtags mtshan ngo mtshar brgyad// gling bzhi ri rab bye ba phrag brgya dang*// lha klu mi yi longs spyod 'dod yon tshogs/ thod sgrub dang 'brel na/ bla ma yi dam 'kha' 'gro dang*/ ratna sha wa ri la 'bul/ bdag la mchog dang thun mong (234)dang*// khyad par mi nor zas gsum gyi// dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol// zhes sbyar ro// thams cad blo yi blangs te 'bul lags na// bdag la phan phyir nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig / nang mchod mtheb srin gyis gtor cing*/ rdo rje 'chang chen ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// rdo rje gdan pa padma rakṣi ta/ pakṣi de wa pan chen shākya shṛ// paṇa chen bhuu mi shri dang bi ma shri// rig 'dzin paṇa grub zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// mang dkar lo tsa kyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags// kun mkhyen dol bu ma ti paṇḍi ta// gzhon nu blo gros ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// gu ṇa shri dang dpal 'byor don grub pa// spyan snga chos grags rin chen phun tshogs pa// chos rgyal phun tshogs dkon mchog rin chen dang*// dkon mchog phrin las ra ga a syas sogs// rtsa rgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

yi dam bcom ldan 'das (235)ma rig byed ma// rdo rje la sogs lha mo bcu bzhi'i 'khor// rgyud kyi srung ma mgon po gri thod can// lha mo'i bka' sdod gnod sbyin ma la sogs// yi dam chos skyong zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ces bdud rtsi lce la bzhag /gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ gzhan yang rlung me thod sgyed kā pa lar// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang ye shes lnga// zhu zhing khol ba'i ye shes bdud rtsi'i mtsho// 'dod yon sna tshogs rlangs pas zhing kun khyab// dam rdzas gtor chen 'bar ba'i mchod pa 'dir// rig byed lha mo bco lngas dgyes par rol// dngos bsham yid sprul mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bdag gi rlung sems snang ba dbang 'dus nas// tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par (236)mdzad du gsol// mkhas grub bshes gnyen thams cad dbang 'dus nas// thub bstan dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol// rigs bzang blo gsal thams cad dbang 'dus nas// bshad bsgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzod// tshul khrims ldan pa= dge 'dun sde chen tshugs par mdzad du gsol// rgyal po rgyal phran thams cad dbang bsdus nas// yul khams chos la 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol// 'byor ldan sbyin bdag thams cad dbang bsdus nas// dge 'dun bkur sti 'phel ba mdzad du gsol// lha klu gzhi bdag thams cad dbang= bkra shis bde legs 'phel ba= /skye 'gro pho mo thams cad dbang= /lus sems dge la sbyor bar= bdud rigs log lta can kun= bstan la bar chad med par = 'bru nor longs spyod mkho rgu dbang 'dus nas// dpal 'byor (237)'bad med lhun gyi grub par mdzod// oṃ bha ga wa ti ku ru kulle sa pā ri wa ra e dam puuṣpe nghub pe dhi baṃ gandhaṃ ba lingta gri hṇa sarba artha ma ma ka ra ka ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swa hā/

lan gsum/ spro na a ka ros dur khrod kyi zhing skyong la bsngo'o// hrī las byung ba dbang gi kha dog can// chos kun ro gcig ston phyir zhal gcig pa// dus gsum mkhyen phyir spyan gsum g.yon du gzigs// bdud bzhi rtsad nas bcad phyir mche bzhi gcigs// rigs lnga mtshon phyir thod skam lnga yi brgyan// tshad med rnam bzhi mtshon phyir phyag bzhi yis// dang pos thabs shes zung 'jug mnga' gzhu 'gengs// g.yas 'og byams pa'i lcags kyus srid gsum 'gugs// g.yon 'og snying rje'i zhags pas 'gro ba(238)'dzin// srid pa mi 'khrul zhabs g.yas bskum pa'i tshul// zhi bar mi gnas zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i gar// 'jig rten zil gnon srid gsum bdag mo mnan// 'du byed dag phyir thong rlon phreng ba dang*// yon tan kun rdzogs rin chen rus pas brgyan/ nyi ma bye ba'i 'od 'phro gzi brjid 'bar// bsgom pa tsam gyi 'jig rten gsum po rnams// dbang du bsdu mdzad lha mo'i sku la bstod// lha mo'i snying po gsang sngags 'bru brgyad pa// khri yi 'jig rten phal pa thams cad dbang*// 'bum phrag gcig gi mi yi rgyal po rnams// de bzhin 'bum phrag gnyis kyi lha rnams te// 'bum phrag bdun gyi lha ma yin rnams dang*// bye bas 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gnod sbyin tshogs// rigs drug sems can thams cad dbang bsdud pa'i/ gsung mchog nus par ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo'i thugs ni stong nyid chos kyi sku// mtha' bzhi skye 'gags gnas bral phyag rgya che// nyan thos rang rgyal sar gnas sems dpa'i tshogs// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum// shes rab pha rol phyin pa yum chen mo// zab cing rgya che lha mo'i thugs la bstod// gang zhig 'phags ma bsgom zhing bzla byed na// dug gi gnod dang dug gi 'chi ba dang*/ bhru ba g.yan pa mdze sogs nad kyi rigs// dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad zhi// klu dang sbrul gdug stag sogs gcan gzan dang*// dgra dang mtshon cha dbul phongs 'jigs pa skyob// sna tshogs gter dang gser dngul sna cha dang*// gos la sogs pa'i nor rnams gang 'dod pa// thams cad kun la dbang bsgyur longs spyod pa'i// yon tan kun 'byung (240)ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// glang rgod rta rgod dug sbrul chu srin dang*// stag dang bse dang chu glang la sogs pa// rigs sngags kyis bkug bzhon par bya rung zhing*// dregs ldan lha klu mi yi rgyal po yang*// gus zhing 'dud pas mngags bzhug las byed pa'i// phrin las thogs med lha mo rig byed ma// khyod kyis mkha' mnyam 'gro ba 'di dag kun// rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus nas kyang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i go 'phang la bzhag par// thugs bskyed thugs dam smon lam de lags na// bdag gi 'dod dang khyed kyi thugs dam gcig// khyed kyi thugs bzhed phrin las bdag gis bsgrub// de bzhin ma gcig bu bzhin brtse bas dgongs// bdag gi gang gsol phrin las myur 'grub mdzod// oṃ dge ba can ni gzi brjid che/(251)/'jig rten gso byed snyan pa che// dbyangs can ma dang spyan yangs ma// shes rab dpal dang blo 'phel ma// gso byed ma dang rgyas byed ma// swa hā oṃ gyi 'dod gzugs ma// sems can kun la phan par brtson// g.yul las sgrol byed rgyal ba mo// lha mo shes rab pha rol phyin// 'phags ma sgrol ma yid 'ong ma// rdza rnga dung ni rgyas pa mo// rig pa'i lha mo tshig snyan ma// zla ba'i mdangs can dkar mo che// mi pham gos ni ser mo can// sgyu ma chen mo dkar chen mo// stobs mo che la pha rol phyin// tsub mo chen mo gtum pa mo// sdong ba'i sems can brlag byed ma// rab tu zhi ba zhi ba'i gzugs// rnam par rgyal ba 'bar ba'i 'od//

glog gi (242)phreng ba'i rgyal mtshan can// ral gri 'khor lo gzhu thogs mtshon// tshol byed rengs byed nag mo che// mtshan mo nag mo mtshan spyod ma// srung byed rmongs byed zhi ba mo/ mdzes ma dge ma 'gro lding ma// tshangs pa mo dang rig byed ma// gsang ba mo ni brag phug gnas// bkra shis don byed zhi ba mo// skye gnas rig byed yid mgyogs ma// thod pa can ni shugs can ma// tshangs ma bden ma gzhan mi rgyal// ded dpon chen mo snying rjer gnas// chu zos lam ni rab bzlog ma// mchog ster don byed ston pa mo// bud med gzugasal dpag med gnon// ri khrod ma dang rnal 'byor ma// grub mo gtum mo bdud rtsi ma// nges ma nor can bsod nams ma// (243)skal chen skal bzang mdzes ston ma// mthar byed sgrag byed 'jigs byed ma// drag dang brtul zhugs chen mo dag// 'gro ba gcig tu phan brtson ma// skyabs med gus la gang ba mo// ngag gi dbang phyug zhing phra ma// rtag par kun 'gro rjes 'gro ma// don kun grub byed bzang mo ma// gtsang byed sil byed nor stor ma// mi 'jigs bsod nams gau ta ma// spyan ras gzigs dbang gis gsungs pa'i// mtshan brgyad rtsa brgyad 'di dag gis// bcom ldan 'das ma khyod la bstod// ces mtshan brgya da rtsa brgyad/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig lhug 'don/ oṃ rje btsun ma// 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa nas/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bar gyi bstod/ bzlas dmigs ni/ rang gi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' yi// thugs kar nyi (244)steng hrī yig dmar po'i mthar// sngags phreng g.yas su bkod nas g.yon du 'khor// padma rā ga'i phreng ba 'khor ba bzhin// de las 'od zer dmar po glog lta bu// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams khyab par 'phro// sangs rgyas byang sems kun kyis byin rlabs dang*// lha mi 'gro ba kun kyi tshe bsod nams// 'jig rten khams kyi rtsi sman rin chen tshogs// nyi shu nor bu'i bcu rnams thams cad bsdus// bdag la thim pas bsod nams gzi brjid stobs// yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur//

oṃ ku ru kulle hriḥswa hā/ zhes tsanda dmar po'i 'phre bgrang bya zhing*/ 'bru 'bum zla ba grangs kyi bsnyen pa ste/ dus ngan bsod nams dman phyir bzhi 'gyur du bzla bar gsungs so// ༈ ratnī thod sgrub dang 'brel na/ yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i sngags bzla ba ni/ bdag nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i// thugs ka'i 'od zer kha dog lnga// thod pa'i (245)nang du 'phros pa yi// thod pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba'i// yid bzhin nor bur gyur par bsam/ thod pa la ni 'od zer lnga*// khyad par dmar po shas che ba'i// rtse la lcags kyu'i mtshan pa ni// 'jig rten phyogs bcur ro 'phros pa las// bkra shis rdzas brgyad rgyal srid bdun// dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba// ma rmos lo tog gter gyi bum// nor lha mi nor zas gsum dang*// mdor na yid la gang 'dod pa// 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus drangs// thod par thim pa yang yang bsam// thod pa yid bzhin rin po che// nor bu kun 'byung dngos su gyur/ oṃ ratna ma hā kā pa la sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ hūm̐: ratna puṇye siddhi hūm̐: dha naṃ mi ddhisiddhi hūm̐: na na kha rde siddhi siddhi hūm̐: dha la saṃ bo siddhi siddhi hūm̐ dza dza: zhes ma (246)yengs bar ci mang du bzla/ sgrub pa zhag ran pa'am/ rtags mtshan byung na/ na ma kā pa la sha ra ya dza hūm̐ muṃ ha ri swa hā: zhes las sbyor sngags 'di zla bar bya/ ༈ thun mtshams stong tshig gi mchod bstod ni/ oṃ ku ru kulle sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ sogs dang*/ zhing khams thams cad yongs su dag pa la// rin chen me tog mang po bcal du bkram// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum// yum gyur sgrol ma khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas nor can dang rgyas pa'i rigs la dgos pa'i phyag rdor bsgom bzlas ni/ swa bhwa wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po/

de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po nam mkha'i mdangs can/ zhi zhing 'dzum la 'gying (247)bag dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i srog zhu gsol ba/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa/ phyag yas pas thugs kar 'bar ba'i rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing g.yon gdan la brten pa/ na bza' mchog dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rab tu bzhad cing rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can no// de'i drung du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sngo bsangs khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing dgra st+wa 'dzin pa'o// rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badzra sa ma dza/ dza:hūm̐ baṃ ho/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kar zla ba la sngags kyi phreng ba gsal bar gyur// na mo badzra pā ni ye/ ma hā (248)badzra pra tiṣṭhi ta ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta sha ri ra ya anta rga ta ya/ badzra sha ri raṃ/ me ku ru badzra a dhaṣṭhi na swa hā/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla/ ༈ dril tshags/ hūm̐: rang nyid yi dam gnas 'gyur te// dran rdzogs khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil// sku mdog ljang la dmar pa'i mdangs// g.yas pas rdo rje nam mkhar phyar// g.yon pas sdigs mdzub me 'bar mdzad// khro bo'i chas kun yongs su rdzogs// zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs dgra bgegs mnan// thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ ljang mthar// sngags kyis g.yas su bskor ba las// 'od zer ljang gu phyogs bcur 'phros// 'og min gnas nas bdud rtsi'i 'khyil// rang 'dra dpag med spyan drangs te// bdag dang nas 'bru rnams la thim// thun rdo re dang nas 'bru re// rang 'dra'i bdud rtsi 'khyil pa re// me 'bar tsha tsha 'phro (249)bar gyur// rang nyid las kyi khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ ljang sngon gyi mthar bzla bya'i sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/

rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud skul/ mthu stobs byin rlabs thams cad bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sku dang sngags phreng phyag mtshan gyi rnam par char bab pa ltar byon nas bdag dang thun rdzas rnams la thim pas bdag gi mthu stobs gzi byin rab tu rgyas shing thun rdzas rnams khro chung me 'bar zhing tshwa tshwa 'phro bar gyur/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ stong phrag tsam dang*/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa tsam bzlas la phus btab pas/ thun rdzas kyi khro bo rnams 'od du zhu ste hūm̐ yig ljang sngon me'i tsha tsha thul thul du 'phros pa 'ba' zhig tu gyur/ mchod (250)bstod ni/ oṃ a mṛ te arghaṃ sogs nas/ shabta 'i bar dang*/ hūm̐ḥ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ 'o chab bshams la/ 'o chab kyi steng du skad cig dran rdzogs su rdo rje rnam 'joms dkar po gsal ba'i thugs srog dang sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab 'o chab dag byed kyi khrus chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ rnam 'joms tshar gcig dang nyer snying gang 'grub dang sham bu/ oṃ e ho shuddhe sogs khrus bdun ci rigs pa sbyar ba tshar bdun dang*/ sdig pa thams cad sogs phan yon bcas brjod la lha mi dmigs par bzhag rang nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus dbul phongs byed pa'i bes rag dang god 'dre sogs bgegs rigs thams cad mdun du bkugs te (251)gus pas 'khoed/ glud gtor de dag rnams kyi yid la gang 'dod pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i gter chen por gyur/ hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen he ru kaḥ sangs rgyas kun kyi byin gyis brlabs// bgegs rigs 'dul ba'i gnyen por bskos// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i mthu stobs kyis// bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la// gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dang*// khang khyim 'di la 'khri ba yi// ltog 'gong dbul sri bse rags rnams// rang gzugs yas stag 'di la khug

/bse rag rgyal po gzhon nu dpal// ltog 'gong dbul sri mang pos bskor// god kha thams cad khyod las byung*// dbul 'dred bul sri khyod las byung*// lo nyes thog nyes khyod= mi la na tsha khyod= (252)nor la god kha khyod= mi kha bra mchu khyod= tshe la bar chod khyod= dme 'dre thams cad khyod= za kha 'thung kha khyod kyis 'phrog /bu tsha'i bla ni khyod kyis brkus// bza' mi 'thab 'dre khyod kyis byas// de phyir gnod byed 'khor dang bcas// gzugs brnyan 'di la thim par gyur// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ zhes gnod byed thams cad gzugs brnyan la sib sib thim par bsgom ste/ nas g.yang glud dang ngar mi bran/ hūm̐: nga ni khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil// ljang nag rgya gram sdig 'dzub mdzad// khro bo'i chas kun sku la rdzogs// nyon gcig bse rag 'gongs po'i tshogs// rgyu 'byor yon bdag 'di nyid la// tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas/ sku 'phrog rlom pa'i lan chags dag /thams cad 'dir 'dus glud gtor longs// gzugs mdzes 'jam (253)klas 'jigs bral dang*// rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// rang rang yid mthun snong nang du/ glud gtor 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga*// oṃ ā hūm̐ gis byin brlabs nas// khyed rnams mgu zhing tshim gyur cig/ 'di nas glud rta/ bse rag rgyal po gzhon nu pa// bu chung gzugs la g.yu rna can// sbang dmar gri chung sked la btsud// chibs su ri bong kha sho bcibs// sreg pa bdun ni klad na lding*// khyi gu ri'u tshe shis dang gis// chung gsum bse rag mang pos bskor// yod na mi dga' med na dga'/ gang na mi dga' stong na dga'// rgyags na mi dga' ltog na dga'// phyug la mi dga' dbul la dga'// blo nyes tshong nyes btang ba'i bdag// khyod la glud dang gtor ma sbyin// yon (254)bdag 'di la ma gnod cig /bse rag rgyal po nag po ni// mi rgan nag po chen po zhig /gos su sha khog skam po gyon/

kha na rus pa snum med mur// kha nas sdug glu mug glu len// sprul pa byi la byis pa 'gyed// mchig gi steng nas phye la rku// dkar thog rlom zhing skur thog bcom/ khyod la lan chags glud gtor sbyi/ 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du song*// gong 'dre mi nag phag la zhon// grod pa'i zhwa la rgyun mas brgyan// lag na bsha' gri dmar po khur// nor bdud kham sa khyi mgo sogs// go 'dre gri bo gri mos bskor// khyod la glud dang gtor ma sbyin/ 'di ru ma gnod gzhan du song*// gzhan yang 'gong po dam sri dang*// 'dre mo gri bo gri mo dang*// (255)sgab 'dre ltog 'gong dbul sri rnams// ngar mi ting lo chang bu dang*// sha bhun sbang ma chang rkyar dang*// zho lad ram pa la sogs pa'i// rang rang mthun nas 'di khyer la// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// yon bdag mi nor 'khor bcas la// ma nyes ma 'khor ma gnod par// dpag tshad mang po'i pho rol du// da lta nyid du 'gro bar gyis/ oṃ nṛ tri shan tri ka tri e dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

zhes pa yan lan bdun/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te*/ oṃ sambha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun gyis chu gtsang breng/ sarba bhigha nan gad tstsha gad tstsha/ de dag tshim nas phyir mig mi lta bar mtha'i rgya mtsho'i pha raul du song bar gyur/ glud gtor khang khyim mi mthong ba'i sar bskyal bcug glud mi len cing bden tshig (256)la mi nyan pa'i 'byung po// gnod pa'i sems 'chang ba mtha' dag rang gi sku las spros pa'i khro chung me dpung thun rdzas hūm̐ yid mtshon chen 'bar ba'i char gyis bskrad cing rdul phran tsam du brlag par byed par gyur/ de nas thun bzung la/ hūm̐ḥ nga ni khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil// rang 'dra'i khro chung ser lta 'bebs// bskal pa'i me dpung 'tshubs shing 'bar// gang dag 'gro bar mi byed pa'i/ bse rag ltog 'gong rdul du rlog / oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ sumbha ni/ drag tu bzla bzhin pas khyim gyi phyogs thams cad la rdo thun gtor/ slar khro chung thams cad tshur 'dus pa las byung ba'i rdo rje'i mtsho cha me ru'i gur khang cis kyang mi shig pa'i nang du srung bya gnas khang nor phyugs zhing dang bcas pa tshud par gyur/ de nas/ hūm̐ḥ bdud rtsi (257)'khyil pa'i byin rlabs las// ye shes bdud rtsi'i mu rgyun gyis// phug gi lha la khrus gsol lo// phug lha pha mtshun g.yang rgan la// grib kyis phog pa dag gyur cig /sbra dang khyim la khrus gsol lo// rtsog 'dre rme rmug dag gyur cig /sbra dang khyim la khrus gsol lo// btsog 'dre rme rmug dag gyur cig /mi dang nor la khrus gsol lo// bse rag god 'dre sangs gyur cig / rnam 'joms sngags dang*/ oṃ e ho shuddhe shuddhe/ yaṃ ho= raṃ ho= baṃ ho= laṃ ho= e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ shu ddhe shuddhe a a swa hā/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes khrus chab phyogs thams cad du 'thor bas/ 'go ba'i lha lnga*/

skyob pa'i lha dgu/ dgra bla yul lha gnyan po sogs 'go ba'i lha srung rnams la mi gtsang ba'i dri ma phog pa rnams dang*/ bdag dang yon gyi bdag po'i (258)sdig sgrib dme rmug nal gsum gyi gri ma yal zhing nor rdzas la 'gong po bse rag gi kha rlangs phog pa sogs mdor na grib dang mi gtsang ba mtha' dag shel dkar gyi bum pa bkrus pa ltar gtsang zhing dag par gyur/ zhes nyin phyi ma rnams su yang g.yang glud bkar mas bgegs bsgrad khrus gsol 'di rigs spros pa la dga' na bya/ mi spro na nyin dang por byas pas grub bo// ༈ de nas sangs rgyas kyi mdun bskyed ni/ bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum la// sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi// 'gro rnams dbul phongs bsal ba'i phyir// bdag gi bla med sangs rgyas bsgrub// 'gro kun bde ldan sdug bsngal bral// bde las mi nyams btang snyoms shog /skad cig dran rdzogs ngang nyid las// padma zla ba'i gdan steng du// mdun bskyes sangs rgyas rin po che// me tog yon tan gyi rgya mtsho// baiḍūrya dang (259)gser gyi ri// kha dog bzang po gser dag tu// snang ba'i dpal gyi bcom ldan 'das/ gser mdog chos gos rnam gsum gsol// mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag rdo rje yi// skyil krung bzhugs shing 'od zer 'bar// gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od zer gyis/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs thim// hūm̐ḥ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// sangs rgyas rin chen me tog yon tan mtsho// baiḍūrya dang gser ri kha dog bzang*// gser du snang ba'i dpal gyi bcom ldan 'das// lha mo dpal chen mo yi bshes gnyen khyod// gshegs dang bzhugs pa'i mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*// chu zla bzhin du gnas 'dir snang bar mdzod// mdun mkhar dam ye dbyer med brtan par bzhugs// sgo gsum rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bdag sogs sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir sku (260)khrus gsol// oṃ na mo bha gha wa te ratna ka ma gu ṇa mu dra badzra sa ma ya dza dza/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ tiṣṭha lhan a ti pu ho/ kwa ya shuddhe āḥ zhes sngags lan gsum gyis gsal btam/ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas rol mo sogs// nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon rnam pa lnga// bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad dang rin chen bdun// kunabazang smon lam lta bu'i mchod pas mchod/ oṃ na mo bha gha wa te ratna ka ma la gu ṇa sa mu tra sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ sogs nas/ shabta pra titstsha swa hā/ ru pa shabta gandhe ra sa pra she sarba pu dza pra titstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra sa pha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs// rin chen me tog yon tan rgya mtsho ni// baiḍūrya dang (261) gser ri kha dog bzang*// gser du snang ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod// mdun bskyed thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ yig mthar// sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis// rgyal mchod byin rlabs bsdus nas bdag sbyin bdag /gnas khang yul zhing la thim thams cad ni// snang stong 'ja' tshon sangs rgyas zhing ltar gyur// zhes bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer gser gtso ma lta bu bdag dang sbyin bdag la phog pas thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib spyi dang*/ bye brag ser sna'i nyes pas dbul zhing phongs par gyur pa'i las sgrib ci yod pa thams cad sang gi dag/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ na ma sarba ta tha ga ta hri da ya a nu ga te oṃ ku rum gi ni swa hā/ zhes ci mang dang*/ mtshan sngags bzla bar spro na/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te ratna ka ma la gu ṇa sa mu tra baiḍūrya ka na pya me (262)ru pu waṇa ka na kaṃ bha sa bhi ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes bzla'o// mthar/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i 'od zer gyis yul phyogs gnas khang dang bcas pa bde ba can gyi zhing khams lta bu bkod pa'i khyad par mtha' yas pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs par mos de'i dbus su rin po che'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs bcas pa'i dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du gter bum dang padma zla ba'i gdan re re/

bar mtshams rnams su mchod pa'i yo byang bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mtha' bskor du khrus kyi rdzing bu/ dpag bsam ljon shing*/ rin po che'i ri bo/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog 'dod 'jo'i ba mchog nor bu'i 'gram stegs la sogs pas bskor zhing*/ phyogs mtshams kun tu 'ja' 'od dang rin po che'i sprin 'khrigs par gyur// oṃ swa bha wa= sogs kyis dbyings (263)de nas snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ stong pa'i ngang las khang khyim 'di// rin chen sna bdun gzhal yas khang*// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs can// khor yug gser gyi ra bas bskor// rin chen sna tshogs gcal du bkram// ma rmos lo tog spungs se spungs/ dpag bsam ljon shing ldem me sdam// 'od zer 'ja' tshon lam se lam/ rma g.yang sprin phung thibs se 'thibs/ de dbus rin chen sna tshogs khri// padma zla ba btsegs pa'i gdan// bhrum̐ las rin chen snod yangs par/ khaṃ las lha ma'i 'dod don rnams/ g.yang rdzas mchod pa'i sprin dpung gtibs// zag med nam mkha'i mdzod gyur pa// rma g.yang lha tshogs thams cad rnams/ rab tu dgyes pa'i rang bzhin gyur// spro na bden brjod ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs (264)pa'i stobs dang*/ bdag gi bsod nams dang*/ smon lam gyi stobs dang gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang gzung sngags snying po phyag rgya'i tshogs kyi bden pa'i stobs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos kyi pho brang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa lha so so'i gdan dang bcas pa/ phyi nang kun tu yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba lta bu'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phun tshogs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig thal mo khang stong du sbyar la/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bhyo= sogs lan brgyas/

de nas/ sarba bid pū ra sogs sbyar/ 'di brjod na/ a ka ro dang*/ na mkha' mdzod sngags gnyis mi dgos/ de nas spos dud dang mda' dar g.yab la/ rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis lcang lo can nas lha mo dpal chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i (265)thugs rgyud bskul nas sngon gyi thugs dam dran te dgyes pas dgongs te skad cig gis byon par gyur/ hūm̐/ de ring gza' skar tshes grangs bzang*// g.yang rdzas sna tshogs ri ltar spungs// dar dkar mda' dar g.yab mos g.yab// rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'bod// 'di nas byang gi phyogs rol na// ri rab chen mo'i byang gi ngos// gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse mo yi// lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog na// skyed mos tshal bzang me tog 'od// khang bzang gser gyi rgyal mtshan// bzhugs pa'i lha mo chen mo dpal// grogs mo lha mo brgyad dang bcas// yon bdag dad pas khyod 'bod na// ma thog myur du gshegs su gsol// mtshan ni pad ma'i phreng ba can// mtshan nas 'bod kyis da tshur byon// dpal ldan ma dang (266) bkra shis ma// mtshan nas 'bod kyis da tshur byon// dkar mo nor gyi bdag mo ste// mtshan nas= grags pa chen mo padma'i spyan// mtshan nas= byed pa mo dang 'od chen mo// mtshan nas= rin po che ni rab sbyin ma// mtshan nas= zas byin ma dang dpal chen mo// mtshan nas = khyod kyi 'khor gyi grogs mo brgyad// nor rgyun ma dang zla shel ma// mtshan nas= sbyin byed ma dang rab sbyin ma// mtshan nas= 'phags ma sbas ma rab bzang ma// mtshan nas= lha mo chen mo dbyangs can ma// mtshan nas 'bod kyi da tshur byon// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// lha mo 'byon pa'i gnas ngan yang*// khyod la sems can don las med// byang chub sems ma mched dgu yang*// bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la// snying rje'i thugs kyis myur du byon// khang khyim (267) g.yang rdzas 'di rnams la// dgyes zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ de wi ma hā bhri de wi kaṣwa sa pā ri wa ra badzra sa ma dza/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ tiṣṭha lhan/ zhes brjod pas/ lha mo dgu po gnod sbyin bye ba// rgyal chen bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas te byon nas gzhal yas khang gi so so'i gdan la bzhugs shing rgyal po bzhi yang sgo bzhi la bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod de nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas mchod par gyur/ mchod phreng ni/ hūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i rig stong yum// shes rab chen po lha mo dpal// 'khor ni nor rgyud ma la sogs// lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa la// dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni// yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon dang*// dag cing dri bral zhabs bsil dang*// sna tshogs (268)mdzes pa'i me tog dang*// tsan dan la sogs 'dug spos dang*// ma rig mun sel snang gsal dang*// ga bur sogs sbyar rmad byung dri// ro brgya dang ldan bshos gtsang dang*// sgra snyan rol mo sna tshogs 'bul// mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra// dri bzang lha ma'i bcud ldan zas// sna tshogs reg bya dpag med 'bul// dkar gsum mngar gsum bza' btung dang*// zag med bdud rtsi gtor ma'i tshogs// sman 'bru dri dang snying po lnga*// dar zab gos kyi bye brag 'bul// gdugs bzang gser nya padma dung*// bum pa rgyal tshan dpal be'u 'bar// 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo dang*// blon po glang po rta mchog dang*// dmag dpon la sogs rin chen 'bul// yungs dkar dur wa bilba zho// me long li khri dung dkar dang*// gi waṃ la sogs srid gsum na// (269)mchod 'os rmad byung ji snyed 'bul/ rta glang gnas lug 'dod 'jo'i ba// ma he la sogs bzhon pa'i tshogs// khang bzang dpag bsam skyed tshal 'bul// lha klu dag la che ba'i nor// rin chen baiḍūr gser g.yu dngul// mu tig bye ru shel la sogs// rin thang che ba'i nor rnams 'bul// gdugs dang bla bre dar dpyangs dang*// 'phan dang chun 'phyang rnga yab dang*/

rin chen dar zab za 'og gi// gdan gos yo byad dpag med 'bul// nas 'bras gro sran til dang khre// sna tshogs 'bru yi phung po dang*// rtsi bcud mar gyi longs spyod dang*// nye bar 'tshe ba'i kha zas tshogs// dpag med rnam dag blo yis 'bul// mdor na rab 'byams zhing khams na// bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ba'i// mchod 'os mchod pa'i bye brag tshogs// thams cad gcig tu bsdus te 'bul// bdag la brtse bas bzhes nas kyang*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor mchog thun gyi// dngos grub gaṅga'i rgyun ltar phob// byang chub rgyas pa 'tsho mdzad gsol// oṃ/ de wi shri sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ/ sogs brjod/ nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ sā bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ ā hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis rlab// lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas mnyes par gyur/ oṃ de wī ma hā shri ye de wī aṣṭa sa pā ri wa ra e daṃ bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hī/ ces (271)lan gsum ma bdun gyis 'bul/ hūm̐/ lha sman bkra shis tshe ring ma'i gdangs/ g.yang gi lha mo dpal chen mo// sku dog ljang gu 'od zer 'bar// phyag g.yas rin chen padma 'dzin// g.yon pas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mdzad// padma gter gyi bum pa'i steng*// zhabs gnyis btsun mo rol pa'i stabs// mdzes sdug blta bas chog mi shes// rin chen rgyan cha si li li// dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru// dri zhim ngad pa sangs se sang*// na bza' mang po lhubs se lhub// khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// g.yang bshos rin chen 'bar ba'i dbyibs// phye mar shing rtsi dri bzang 'thul// g.yang phor mar khus ltems se ltem// ro bcud zas sna rdza ltar bkram// nor sna g.yang rdzas brag ltar brtsegs// chang 'o zho mtsho ltar bskyil// 'bru sna phye mar gangs ltar spungs/

(272)/zag med kun bzang mchod sprin 'dis// mchod do g.yang gi lha tshogs mchod// gsol lo mchod do dgyes gyur cig /mda' dar 'di la rten chos la// khang khyim 'di la bzhugs su gsol// yon bdag 'di la dngos grub stsol/ phya dang g.yang gi dngos grub ni// ri rab lta bur spung dul gsol// rgya mtsho bzhin du bskyil ba dang*// sprin dpung bzhin du gtibs pa dang*// bar snang char bzhinadabab tu gsol// dad mos rtse gcig pas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas phyag bya zhing mchod pa phul bas de dag gi thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis bdag zhan thams cad kyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi mthu stobs rab tu rgyas par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen me tog yon tan rgya mtsho (273)baiḍūrya dang gser gyi ri kha dog bzang po gser du snang ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol//

zhes lan gsum/ dam pa'i chos dkon mchog gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ g.yang gi lha mo dpal chen mo la phyag = mchod do= g.yang gi lha mo dpal ldan ma la= mchod do= g.yang gi lha mo bkra shis ma la= mchod do= g.yang gi lha mo grags pa chen mo la= mchod do= g.yang gi lha mo padma'i spyan la= mchod do= g.yang gi lha mo byed pa mo la= (274)mchod do= g.yang gi lha mo 'od chen mo la= mchod do= g.yang gi lha mo zas sbyin ma la= mchod do= g.yang gi lha mo rin po che rab tu sbyin ma la= mchod do= byin gyis brlab tu gsol= rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'di la tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa zas nor longs spyod g.yang gi dngos grub chen po myur du stsol cig dpa' bo gcig grub las gsungs pa'i rtsa ba'i snying po'i bzlas dmigs ni// bdag bskyed kyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed bskul/ de'i thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer sna tshogs byung ba'i rtse mo las lha mo chen mos sku nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab par gyur/ de dag gi phyag mthil nas mchod pa'i sprin chen po sprul te rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod pa'i dge ba las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi sprin chen po 'khrigs pa las bdud rtsi'i char chen po babs pas ser sna dang 'dod chags kyi dri ma bkrus/ 'bras bu yi dwags kyi 'gro ba kun tshim nas sangs rgyas kyi bde ba la bkod/ yang nor bu rin che la sogs pa 'dod gu'i char rgyun (275)chad med pa babs pas bdag gzhan 'gro ba mtha' dag skye ba kun tu dpal 'byor zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter chen po la dbang thob// 'od zer slar log te thugs dkar thim par bsgom// gzhan yang sku spros pa de dag tshur 'dus pa'i tshe bdag dang sbyin bdag la thim pas sgrib pa bsal nas byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/

sku'i 'od zer las skyed pa'i nor bu'i sprin 'thug po las nor longs spyod kyi char chen po babs pas/ gnas khang bang mdzod dang bcas pa mer gyi khengs par gyur/ yang rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis lha mo gtso 'khor bskul/ de dag gi sngon gyi dam bca' rjes su dran/ thugs srog las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyi snod thams cad sbyangs pas bde ba can gyi zhing khams lta bur gyur/ nang bcud kyi 'gro ba spyi dang khyad par bdag dang byin bdag gi ser sna rku 'phrog gi nyes pas mtshon pa'i sdig sgrib mtha' dag sbyangs/ snod bcud mtha' dag gi dpal 'byor yon tan rab tu spel/ slar 'od zer tshur 'dus pa las 'khor 'das kun gyi yon tan byin rlabs/ tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal 'byor/ dbang thang snyan (276)grags/ stobs rtsal gzi brjid/ 'byung ba bzhi yi bcud/ lha klu mi'i phywa g.yang*/ mdor na brtan g.yo'i tshogs bcud srid zhi'i dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te bdag mdun sbyin bdag rnams la sib sib thim par gyur/ rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ ka ma la wā si ni/ ka ma le/ ma hā lakshi me ra dza me ba su nā nā kha dhe sarba siddhi/ de hi de hi ba ra de swa hā/ ces ci 'grub dang*/ sad ya rthed na/ dzi ni ghṛ ni sarba artha sā dha ni/ sha shi ni/ a lakshi mi ni/ me nā sha ya/ siddhyantu me mant+ra ba dāḥswa hā/ oṃ bhri ku ṭī ba ra ma su bha ye swa hā/ ces bdun las mi nyung bar brjod/ hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo nor rgyun ma// sku mdog ser mo gser gyi mdog /phyag g.yas 'bras kyi snyi ma 'dzin// 'bru yi char pa si li li// g.yon pas gter gyi bum pa 'dzin// mdzad med dngos grub chu bo'i rgyun// rinachen rgyan cha si li li// dar gyi cod paṇa bu ru (277)ru// padma'i gter gyi bum pa'i steng*/ sgeg bzhad gar stabs khyugs se khyug /khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// g.yang bshos phye mar zas phud 'bul// bzang shing phye mar spos kyis mchod// mda' dar 'di la rten chos la/

khang khyim 'di la bzhugs su gsol// yon bdag 'di la dngos grub rtsol// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub ni// ri rab lta bur spung du gsol// rgya mtsho bzhin du bskyil du gsol// sprin phung bzhin du gtibs pa dang*// bar snang char bzhin 'bebs par mdzod/ hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo zla shel ma// sku mdog ser mo= sogs nas tshig rkang nyi shu 'gre'o/ hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo sbyin byed ma/ sku mdog= hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo rab sbyin ma/ sku mdog= hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo 'phags ma ni/ sku mdog= hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo sbas ma ni/ sku mdog= hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo rab (278)bzang ma/ sku mdog= hūm̐/ g.yang gi lha mo dbyangs can ma// sku mdog= 'bebs par mdzod/ tadya thā/ dzi ni gri ni/ sarba a karma siddhi ni/ si si mi/ si li si/ ni mi ni mi/ a lakṣa yā me/ na sha ye swa hā/ zhes nyer gcig dang*/ nor rgyun ma sogs lha mo brgyad kyi thugs kar zla gdan la baṃ gser mdog sogs kyi thugs srog sngags kyi bskor bar gyur/ gong ga ི de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros sogs sbyar / oṃ bha su dha ri ṇaidya swa hā/ sarba ba su siddhi hūm̐ swa hā/ zhes sbyar ba nyer gcig dang*/ de bzhin du/ oṃ tsand+ra kant+yai swa hā/ oṃ dā dā ye swa hā/ oṃ su dā dā ye swa hā/ oṃ arya ye swa hā// oṃ su bha drā ye swa hā/ oṃ gupta dā swa hā/ oṃ de byai swa hā/ oṃ sa ra swa st+yai swa hā/ sarba ba susiddhi hūm̐ swa hā/ zhes sbyar ba nyer gcig tsam bzāo// de nas/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer steng phyogs su 'phros pas su cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas lha chen (279)tshogs kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed gzhal yas khang gi bar khyams g.yas ngos su bzhugs par gyur/ hūm̐/ steng phyogs 'dod khams lha yi yul// sum cu rtsa gsum gnas mchog nas// nor dang g.yang gi bdag po ni// nor lha lha chen tshogs kyi bdag// sku dog dkar la glang chen dbu// phyag bzhi la phug dgra st+wa dang*// zas gzhong rin chen phreng ba 'dzin// chibs su byi ba sngon po chibs// 'dir byon dkar gtor mchod pa bzhes// thud g.yag mar gyi lug gu dang*// 'bru sna'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/

yon bdag rta nor zhing khang la// bgegs kyi gnod pa khyed kyis srungs// 'khor la bka' nan ma chung zhig steng phyogs lha yi phywa dang g.yang*/ /char pa bzhin du 'bebs par mdzod// khyad par (280)dud 'gro rkang bzhi rnams// 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i dngos grub rtsol// oṃ ga ṇa pa t-i sa pā ri wa ra e dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ lha chen po'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du gaṃ las sngags phreng g.yas 'khor du 'khod/ bdag mdun 'od kyis bskul bas/ de las 'phros pa'i 'dod zer gyis 'jig rten gsum gyi dpal 'byor spyi dang*/ bye brag steng phyogs lha yi phya g.yang thams cad 'od dang thig le dkar la 'tsher ba'i rnam par bsdus te bsgrub bya mi nor zhing khang dang bcas pa la thim pas bkrag mdangs snum bag gzi brjid dang ldan/ gnas khang thams cad longs spyod chen pos mer gyis gang*/ khyad par sprul pa du mas bgegs thams cad gzir zhing gnad la bkar bar gyur/ oṃ ba ra ta ka swa hā/ ba pu sarba siddhi siddhi hūm̐ swa hā/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ de bzhin du/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer 'og phyogs su 'phros pas klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ g.yon phyogs kyi bar 'khyams (281)'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'khyil pa la bzhugs par gyur/ hūm̐/ 'og phyogs rgya mtsho klu yi yul// bkra shis 'o ma'i rgya mtsho nas// klu g.yang dngos grub kun gyi bdag /klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po ni// sku mdog dkar po dung gi mdog /sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka la// rin chen 'bar ba'i cod pan can// phyag gnyis gter bum thugs kar 'dzin// sku smad gser sbrul ser po 'khyil// g.yang gi rgya mtsho me re re// 'dir gshegs g.yang rten 'di la bzhugs// khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// dkar gtor klu sman 'o zho mthud// dung sbrul dung nya dung sbal 'bul// 'og phyogs klu g.yang dngos grub de// rgya mtsho bzhin du bskyil bar mdzod// bu nor bde skyid dngos grub stsol// klu g.yang mi la dbab tu gsol// oṃ na (282)ga rā tsa ma nu ṣe nā tha e dam bha ling ta khā hī khā hī/

zhes lan gsum dang*/ thugs kar zla steng phuḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gsum gyi dpal 'byor spyi dang bye brag 'og phyogs klu yi phywa g.yang thams cad 'od dang thig le sngo la dngas pa'i rnam par bsdus// khyad par thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis glu chen po rnams bskul bas mdzad pa med pa'i rin po che'i phung po phyur bur spungs par bsam la/ oṃ nā gā rā tsa sarba siddhi siddhi hūm̐ swa hā/ zhes bzla/ de bzhin du/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer shar phyogs su 'phros pas rma rgyal spom ra gnyen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ mdun gyi khyams la bzhugs par gyur/ hūm̐/ bar phyogs lha srin gnyen gyi yul// shar phyogs gangs ri rtse rgyal na// rma g.yang kun gyi mnga' bdag ste// rma rgyal spom ra lha yi sras// sku dog dkar la 'od zer 'phro// dbu la dung rmog stag 'phru can// sku la ber dkar (283)bse khrab gsol// stag dong gzig shub sked la bskor// phyag na mdung dang nor bu 'dzin// chibs su rta dkar 'phur shes chibs// rma rigs sum brgya drug bcu dang*// rma sman 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// thugs kar yid bzhin nor bu las// dngos grub sna tshogs char ltar 'bebs// 'dir gshegs yon bdag kha 'dzin mdzod// dkar gtor zas phud sna tshogs dang*// bya rta glang gzugs mchod pa 'bul// rma dang g.yang gi dngos grub ni// na bun bzhin du 'thib par mdzod// mi 'phen rta hrag dngos grub stsol/ btsan phyug dar gsum 'dzoms par mdzod// oṃ ku mā ra phu tri sa pā ri wa ra e daṃ bha ling ta kha kha kha hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum/ spom ra'i thugs kar zla steng shaḥyig dkar por sngags phreng dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyis/ 'jig rten gsum gyi dpal 'byor (284)spyi dang*/ bye brag bar phyogs mi dang gnyan gyi phya g.yang thams cad 'od dang thig le ser la brjid pa'i rnam par bsdus/

khyad par thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rma g.yang dngos grub mtha' dag 'ub kyis bsdus nas gnas khang bang mdzod dang ra ba phyugs lhas yul zhing dang bcas pa la thim pas/ rgud pa med pa'i phywa g.yang gi byin chags par gyur/ oṃ ku mā ra phu tri sarba siddhi siddhi hūm̐ swa hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla zhing bsang gsur sogs ma chad pa bya bar gsungs so// ༈ de nas longs spyod rgyas byed rjes 'brang gi phrin las la/ ratna'i rnam sras mdung dmar can ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang*// sgo gru rta babs rdzogs pa'i dbus// nyi zla padma seng khri'i steng*// gri snying bhai ཿyig dmar po las// 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa la// stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad kyi// tshe bsod dpal 'byor dbang bsdus nas/ bhaiḥyig yongs su gyur pa las// sa brgyad rgyal po chen po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar/(285)/mi'u thung khro zhing gtum pa'i tshul// bse khrab rmog zhu dar dmar can// sgeg cing brjid pa'i cha lugs can// phyag g.yas rgyas mtshan mdung dar bsnams// g.yon pas ne le lcags kyu 'dzin// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// mdun na kluo nor 'chang ma// dmar ser gzhon tshul ldan pa'i sku// gcer bu rin chen rgyan drug mdzes// g.yas pas lcags kyu mgul la brten// g.yon pas nor bu rnga yab 'dzin// de ltar gsal ba'i ngang nyid las// bdag mdun thugs ka'i sa bon las/ 'od 'phros ri rab byang phyogs du// rgyal po 'khor bcas spyan drangs bstim/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs dam dgongs rgyal po che// dang po'i sangs rgyas mngon gyur kyang*// 'gro ba'i don du sprul pa'i sku// sa brgyad sems dpar bzhugs pa (286)po// da lta byang phyogs rgyal po'i tshul// shākya seng ge'i bstan pa srung*// sems dpa' chen po gshegs su gsol// ri rab chen po'i byang phyogs kyi/

lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas// bdag gi gdung bas spyan 'dren na// thabs mkhas thugs rje'i rgyal po che// thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol// pho brang gzhal yas chen po'i dbus// rin chen khri rkang gdan khri'i steng*// phyag dang zhabs ni bsil nas kyang*// rin chen 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ bai shra wa ṇa ye dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pheṃ pheṃ hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥyang dag sangs rgyas rin po chen mang 'gro ba'i don dgongs sprul pa'i sku// sa brgyad sems par bzhugs pa po// khyed la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// na mo pu ru sha ya ho/ mthu stobs mnga' bdag rgyal po che// khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// phyi mchod me tog bdug spos dang*// (287)mar me dri dang zhal zas sogs// sil snyan rol mo dbyangs dang bcas// spyan gzigs dkor cha mthun pa'i rdzas// lha chen mnga' bdag khyed la 'bul// bdag la 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol// nang mchod rgya phor bse phor dang*// gser dngul rin chen skyogs nang du// chang phu darin chen dar zab bcas// sman gtor rakta nang gi rdzas// mdzes ba'i lha mo bcu drug gis// phyag rgya sna tshogs gar gyis bsgyur// a la la ste mchod pa 'bul// dgyes bskang bdag la dngos grub stsol// mdung dmar rgyal mtshan gri snying dang*// tshogs kyi longs spyod dpag med mchod// mdzes pa'i klu mo nor skyong ma// lha klu'i bu mo mdzes sdug bskor// rgyal po dgyes mdzad thugs dam bskang*// bdag la zas nor char ltar phob// bdag ni (288)rig 'dzin sgrub pa po// khyod ni dngos grub gter gyi bdag /phyi nang gsang ba'i gachod sprin mchod// 'dod pa'i don la gsol 'debs kyi// rgyal blon 'bangs dang yul 'khor dang bcas// thams cad bdag gi dbang du sdus// mi nor longs spyod rgyas par mdzod// 'dod pa'i re 'dod bskang du gsol/ zhes mchod nas/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/

ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs kyi// lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras// sa brgyad sems par bzhugs pa ste// dbang gi phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir// padma ra ga'i mdog 'dra zhing*// mi thung bzhengs pa'i cha lugs can// dbu la bse rmog phod can gsol// 'jol ber steng na bse khrab can// dar tshon sna lnga'i pho long ni// brjid pa'i nan dam mang pos bcings/ phyag g.yas mdung dmar rgyal mtshan bsnams// srid pa gsum yang dbang du sdud/(289)/phyag g.yon ne le lcags kyu 'dzin// 'gro ba'i rnam shes dbang du sdud// gling bzhi byang phyogs skyong tsa na/ ind+ra ni la'i mdog dang ldan// klu dang gnod sbyin 'dul tsa na// rin chen gser gyi sku mdog can// mkha' 'gro lha mo klu mo dang*// bdud mo'i ded dpon mdzad tsa na/ baiḍūr mthing ga'i mdog dang ldan// 'gro ba'i rnam shes dbang sdud cing*// longs spyod char ltar 'bebs tsa na// sku dog dmar po 'od zer 'bar// dbang chen mthu byin bsam mi khyab// yon tan ma lus rdzogs la bstod// 'jig rten 'di na grags che ba'i// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// mi'am ci dang lto 'phye che// thams cad yongs kyi ded dpon ni// 'jig rten khams na 'gran zla bral// lha chen dpal 'bar khyed la bstod// khyod ni 'gro ba'i don sprul tshe// sku mdog gcig tu ma nges te// dkar ser (290)dmar ljang mthing ga'i mdog /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs phrin las bdag /cha lugs gcig tu ma nges te// zhi dang khro dang zhi ma khro// gon pa gcig tu ma nges te// khrab dang ber chen lha yi gos// dgos 'dod re skong khyod la bstod// zhon pa gcig tu ma nges te// seng ge khyung dang glang chen dang*// stag gzig dom dang ma he 'brug /rta mchog dred dang chu srin bzhon// phyag mtshan rnam pa sna tshogs pa// bkra shis rdzas brgyad rnga yab dang*// nor bu bi dza pu ra dang*// ral gri mda' gzhu gter gyi sgrom// sna tshogs sprul pa'i phyag mtshan 'dzin// yid bzhin gter bdag khyod la bstod// bdag ni gdung sems dam tshig can// tshul bzhin bsnyen cing sgrub pa dang*// mchod cing bstod de thugs dam bskul// sras dang btsun mo 'khor dang g.yog

/gnod sbyin bye ba (291)bdun 'bum bzhengs// khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdus// 'gro ba mi yi rnam shes sgul// sbyin bdag pho mo'i lag pa sgul// g.yang chen nor dang brdzed chen gos// bcud can zas la sogs pa rnams// thams cad bdag la stsal du gsol// mi snying sgul la mi 'gram chog /rang dbang med par thams cad bsdus// 'dod pa'i re ba ma lus stsol// gnas pa tshe yi dngos grub stsol// rgyud 'dzin sras kyi dngos grub stsol// snyan grags gdul bya'i dngos grub stsol// longs spyod nor gyi= mi zad zas kyi= g.yang lugs gos kyis= rkang bzhi phyugs kyi= bang mdzod nas kyi= dar zab rdzas kyi= rinachen gser g.yu'i= sra brtan go khrab= mi 'dzad gter gyi= thugs dam ma g.yel rgyal po che// 'di ltar bdag gis bskang gsol nas// 'dod pa'i don la (292)gsol btab tshe// gang 'dod dngos grub ma stsal na// thugs dam nyams par mi 'gyur ram// de bas thugs rdzes brtser dgongs nas/ rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*// dbang sdud zas nor longs spyod kyi// bdag la dngos grub rgya cher stsol/

de nas sngags bzla ba ni/ oṃ ma ha ra tsa yakṣa sa ma ye bhe shra ma na ye sarba tsitta ratna hriṃ dza/ las sbyor bzla pa ni/ bhai shra ma na ra ga ratna hrī hrī sarba siddhi hriṃ hriṃ/ 'gul 'gul/ yaṃ yaṃ/ dung dung*/ bsdus bsdus/ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes dmigs gnad dang bcas bzla bar bya'o/ de nas gnam chos rta bdag ku be ra ni/ hūm̐/ mdun du nor lha ku be ra/ sku mdog nag po zhal gcig pa// phyag gnyis g.yas pas ral gri la/ g.yon pas rta yi srab mda' 'dzin/ sku la khrab rmog brjid par gsol// chibs su rta nag mdangs ldan bcibs// rang 'dra lnga (293)brgya 'khor dang bcas// spyan drangs mdun bskyed rten la bstim/ spos dkar dang shug gsur gyi dub gtong zhing snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas/ hūm̐/ 'di nas byang gi phyogs rol na// rgya mtsho chen po'i phar 'dabs na// gser ri bdun gyi pha rol na// rol mtsho bdun gyi shar 'dabs na// ri rgyal chen po'i byang phyogs na// nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang kun// thams cad gtso ma gser gyi mdog /nyi ma zla ba 'grim pa'i lam// gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse mo na// rin chen gter kha bye bas brgyan// rin chen gser gyi bye ma brdal// khrus kyi rdzing bu dpag bsam shing*// ma rmos lo tog 'dod 'jo'i ba// 'dod yon sna tshogs gcal du bkram// de na pho brang lcang lo can/ lcang lo can gyi byang phyogs na/ rin chen brtsegs pa'i lding khang na// gnod sbyin sde dpon ku be ra// 'bod do gdung ba'i dbyangs (294)kyis 'bod// khyod la mngon shes spyan ldan pas// snyan gyis gson la thugs kyis dgongs// khyod la rdza 'phrul stobs mnga' bas// skad cig tsam gyis 'dir gshegs la// yid sprul rin chen gzhal yas khang*// cang shes nag po'i khri la bzhugs// sngon tshe gsang bdag shāka thub dang*// srong btsan spyan sngar khas blangs ltar// bdag gis gang bcol 'grub par mdzod// oṃ ku be ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza/

dzahūm̐ baṃ ho/ tiṣṭha lhan// sa ma ya staṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ hūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang dang gsang ba'i bdag po yis// dkyil 'khor du mar dbang bskur dam la bzhag /byang phyogs skyong ba'i dpal mgon ku be ra// khyed la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga*// bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad dang rin chen bdun// dar zab (295)'bru sna shing tog zas sna'i phud// sku gzugs mda' dar la sogs mthun rdzas bshams// khyad par rin chen snod mchog rgya che bar// gtor ma zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i mtsho// ha ho hri yis byin gyis brlabs byas pas// kha dog dri rog nus pa phun sum tshogs// zag med bde ba bskyed par byed pa 'di// rta bdag gnod sbyin chen po ku be ra// 'khor dang bcas la 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes// oṃ ku be ra sa pā ri wa ra e dam ba ling ta grihṇa tuṃ sa ma ya rakṣaṃ tu ma ma siddhi me pra yatstsha/ ma ma sarba karma siddhi a mo gha swa hā/ zhes lan gsum/ arghaṃ sogs/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe dpal chen he ru kaḥ gsang bdag rta mgrin la sogs kyis// rgyud sde mang po'i dbang bskur zhing*// dam tshig gnyen po'i gral du bzhag /'jig rten byang phyogs skyong mdzad pa'i// dpal (296)mgon ku be ra la bstod// zla ba'i sras po gzi brjid can// rnam thos sras kyi sprul pa ste// lha min g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phyir/ sku mdog nag po mi sdug gzugs/ dkar po'i lha rnams rgyal byed pa'i// gnod sbyin sde dpon stobs po che// gnod sbyin lus ngan po la bstod// chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po yis/ bod yul gtsug lag thog ma ste// khra 'brug lha khang srung mar bskos// de nas bod kyi lha ru gyur// rgyal 'gong rnams kyi kha gnon mdzad// dkor bdag ku be ra la bstod// sku mdog nag po mun pa'i mdog

/spyan bsgrad khro gnyer aṃ gtsigs bsdams// rta gdon thams cad zhabs la mnan// dbu la bsi rmog sdem 'phrus brgyan// sku la dar ber dmar ljang gsol// bse khrab stag gi sham thab gsol// phyag g.yas bsam gcod ral gri phyar/ (297)rta gdon rnams kyi klad khrag 'gems// g.yon pas rta yi srab mda' 'dzin// rngog chags kun kyi rje bo mdzod// chibs su rta nag 'phur shes bcibs// sprul pa rang 'dra lnga brgya dang*// 'khor ni gnod sbyin stongs gis bskor// kun kyang bse khrab bse rmog can// sngon po chu ris chibs su bcibs/ mdung dar ru mtshon chems se chem// rta g.yang dngos grub kun kyi bdag rta bdag chen po ku be ra// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// snod sbyin chen po ku be ra// khyod ni rta yi bdag po ste// dmigs yul srung bya'i rta rnams la// khyod la bcol lo bdag po gyis// gzhis byes lam gsum gar phyin kyang*// skyobs shig 'tshos shig rdzi bo gyis// gnod pa ma btang thub par srungs// rta nad thams cad (298)zhi ba dang*// rta yi yams nad thub par srungs/ btsan slad btsan gyi gnod pa dang*// sdom dang la gar la sogs pa// rta nad thams cad zhi bar mdzod// rta god chod la rta sri chings/ rngog chags thams cad srung ba dang*/ rgod ma thams cad 'gab 'phel ba'i// phrin las 'di dag myur 'grub mdzod// ces dang*/ bsnyen pa ni/ rta lha'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng*// kaṃ yig mtha' la sngags g.yas 'khor// de las 'od zer byang phyogs 'phros// lcang lo can nas ku be ra// grangs med spyan drangs rten la thim// bka' nyan gsung sdod byed par gyur/ oṃ aḥku be ra swa hā/ zhes ci mang dang*/ sham bu gdags na/ gho ra rakṣa rakṣa bhrum̐ bhrum̐ srungs shig ces sbyar/ de nas dngos grub bskul ba'i dmigs pa ni/

ku be ra yi thugs ka nas// 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros// rta g.yang dngos grub thams cad kun// 'od zer tshul du bsdus nas ni// rang gi rta la thim pa yis// rngog chag 'phel zhing rgyas par bsgom/ oṃ aḥku be ra ya swa hā/ gho ra siddhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes ci (299)mang bsgrang bar bya'o// ༈ de nas dzam bha la'i phrin las dgos 'dod char 'bebs ni/ nor lha yi gtor gzhung ltar la/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ rin chen lnga las grub pa yi// gzhal med khang pa'i dbus su ni// dzam lha sku mdog dkar po ste// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas be con// phyag g.yon ne'u le bsnams pa ste// gru mor kha ṭaṃ ga ldan pa// dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes/ spyan gsum zhal gdang rin chen gyi/ rgyan ldan 'brug la chib pa'o// shar du rdo rje dhā ki ma// mthing nag g.yas na rdo rje dang*// g.yon pas rten 'brel nor rdzas 'dzin// lho ru rin chen ḍā ki ma// ser mo g.yas na nor bu dang*// g.yon pas rin chen bum pa 'dzin// nub tu padma ḍā ki ma// dmar mo g.yas na padma dang*// g.yon pas 'gug byed lcags kyu 'dzin// byang du las kyi ḍā ki ma// ljang gu rdo rje rgya gram g.yas// g.yon pas ne'u le rkyal pa 'dzin// kun kyang rin chen rgyan ldan zhing*// brkyang (300)bsgum tshul gyis bzhugs par// pho brang de yi phyi khyams gsum// phyogs mtshams padma'i gdan brgyad la// lte bar 'dab ma zla gdan re// shar dbus dzam las dzam dmar ni// dmar dkar sngo ba'i zhal gsum pa// phyag drug dang pos rin chen thod// bar mas lcags kyu zhags pa ste// tha gnyis ne'u les rin chen 'bebs// zhabs bzhi'i nor bdag pho mo mnan// de yi phyogs mtshams 'dab ma la// dkar ser dmar ljang sngo dang nag /khro bo zhal gsum phyag drug ste// byang shar 'dab mar dzam lha dgu// kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ re re'ang 'khor ni brgyad res bskor// lho dbus hūm̐ las dzam nag ni// rab khros thod khrag ne'u le 'dzin// phyogs mtshams sde rgya dzam nag brgyad// rgyan ldan rin chen ne'u le'o// nub dbus dzam las dzam lha dang*// ku wer ra sogs gnod sbyin brgyad/

ser po bi dza ne'u le 'dzin// de'i (301)dbus dang phyogs mtshams su// nor rgyun ma sogs lha mo brgyad// mchog sbyin 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin// byang dbus dzam las dzam lha ser// zhal gsum phyag drug skyil krung bzhugs// g.yas gsum shing thog lcags kyu mda'// g.yon gsum zhags pa ne'u le gzhu// rang 'dra'i yum gyis g.yon nas 'khyud// de yi 'dab brgyad phyi nang la// 'phags pa ngal bso rigs bcu yi// 'brog gnas mched lngas 'khor gyis bskor// shar lhor a par tsitta dkar// 'jigs gzugs nor bu ne'u le bsnams// phag gdong ser mo gri thod 'dzin// mched lnga gar thabs mu tig brgyan// lho nub nor bdag ye shes grags// dmar mdzes rin chen ne'u le 'dzin// kun 'khyil mched gsum mthing ljang dmar// bzhengs thabs bum pa nor bu 'dzin// nub byang gang po mdzes mdzes gnyis// ser mdzes (302)shing thog bum pa 'bul// byang shar shri las lha mo dpal// ljang mdzes rin chen padma dang*// skyabs sbyin mdzad cing bum steng bzhugs// gser mdog bu mo lnga brgyas bskor// phyi rol khor yug chen po la/ gnod sbyin sde dpon bcu gnyis sogs// bye ba drug cu drug cur bcas/ lcang lo can nas spyan drangs gyur// ༈ hūm̐/ byang phyogs gter gyi gzhal yas nas// nor gyi dbang phyug dzam bha lha// thugs rje'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzam lha'i rigs dang rnam sras rigs// nor lha pho dgu mo dgu dang*// a par dzi ta lha mo dpal// gang mdzes nor bdag ye shes grags// phag gi gdong mo mched lnga dang*// zas gos nor gyi lha mo gsum// 'brog gnas mched lnga la sogs pa// gnod sbyin nor lha thams cad byon// ji srid bar du brtan par bzhugs// badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ tiṣṭha lhan/ stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag (303)yi// dpal 'byor blo yis blangs te 'bul// yid sprul rtags brgyad rgyal srid bdun// dngos 'byor mchod gtor 'di 'bul bzhes//

bsdus na de yan gyi chog la/ rgyas par byed na 'di ltar ro// ༈ hūm̐/ mchod yon bsil zer khengs pa'i ga bur sde/ khrus chab sbrul gyi snying po'i rdzas ldan bcud// me tog 'ja' mdangs so sor phan byas pa// bdug spos yongs 'du'i drung nas 'thul ba'i ngad// mar me nyin mor byed pa'i gzugs gsal ba// byug pa yid 'ong lha yi chu bo'i rgyun/ zhal zas bdud rtsi'i rtser 'thon re brgya pa// rol mo'i yan lag 'bum ldan snyan pa'i sgra// re re'ang mchod pa'i bye brag ma lus pa// rab 'byams nam mkha'i khyon rnams kun bkang zhing*// thams cad 'tshogs pas dog pa ma mchis pa'i// ngo mtshar kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin 'bul lo// ༈ hūm̐/ brtan g.yo'i bkod pa (304)rgya mtsho'i dkyil chen por// klu dbang rin chen thams cad legs pa bstar// mtho ris 'byor pa kun tu chags pa'i rtser// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis zlos gar sgyur// gter bum ma rmos snye ma brdal ba'i sar/ mtha' bzhi rnam gnon rgyal srid sna bdun bshams// dpag bsam nags su 'dod 'jo'i ba yi khyu/ pyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i phyir// bsam 'phel mthu stobs rngams brjid 'gying ba dang*// gzhan yang srid zhi'i tshar dud ngar ba yi// dbang phyug chen po'i longs spyod ma lus pa// mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod du 'bul gyis bzhes// ༈ oṃ ā hūṃ/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ padma kro dha arya dzam bha la hrī da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ e dam bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ dzam bha la dza len tra ye dha na me dhi hrīḥswa hā/ e dam ba ling ta= oṃ dzam luṃ swa hā/ e dam= oṃ dzam (305)bha la dza len tra ya swa hā/ e dam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ buddha badzra ratna padma karma dzam bha la siddhi pha la hūm̐/ e dam= oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swa ha/ e dam= oṃ purṇa bha dra ya swa hā/ e dam= oṃ dā na dā ya swa hā/

e dam= oṃ ku we ra ya swa hā/ e dam= oṃ ki li ma li ne swa hā/ e dam= o pi tsi kuṇḍa li ne swa hā/ e dam= oṃ mu khant+ra ya swa hā/ e dam= oṃ tsa rant+ra ya swa hā/ e dam= oṃ ba su dha ri ṇadyai swa hā/ e dam= oṃ tsand+ra kanta ye swa hā/ e dam= oṃ rtā ye swa hā/ e dam= oṃ su rtā ye swa hā/ e dam= oṃ bha su bha dra ye swa hā/ e dam= oṃ su bha dra ye swa hā/ e dam= oṃ gupta ye swa hā/ e dam= oṃ de be ye swa hā/ e dam= oṃ sa ra swa tyaṃ swa ha/ e dam= oṃ de wi shrī ye swa hā/ e dam=(306)oṃ bai shra wa a yu ṣe hūm̐ ā: e dam= oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye hūm̐ swa hā/ e dam= oṃ ma hā rā dza yakṣa sa ma ye sarba tsitta ratna ghw-i dza dzaḥ e dam= oṃ nā ga ṇi ba su te pū dra padma swa hā/ e daṃ= oṃ bai rakṣa bhyod/ e daṃ= oṃ bai shra wa ṇa ye nā da kra be ra ma hā ga bai kri ta bi na te na maḥsiddhi swa hā/ e dam= o ba su bha dra/ purṇa bha dra/ saṃ buddha dzha bha na/ kan ta rasmi ta bha bā ṣe na ra swa hā/ e dam/ oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hri da hūm̐/ de wa ba ti hūm̐/ ma hā kā la dhi dha hī lu sa ma ya hūm̐/ hūm̐/ ratna siddhi ho/ e dam= oṃ hrīḥ.a pa ra dzi ta dza dzaḥ e dam= oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra yakṣa dha ri ṇi/ e dam= oṃ dhe wa nā ga yakṣa shu la ma ma bishnu ya mu du dri dzam bha la ya swa hā/ e dam= tri'u tri'u/ e dam= oṃ i ling ga ki pi ling ki/ ka (307)ling ki/ a na le/ kaṇḍa li gṛ hṇa sandha li/ pi sha tsi na le na maḥshu tra mu tri ma ha pi sha tsi na ye/ e dam= oṃ sarba yakṣa yakṣi/ e dam= oṃ sarba ba su de wa e dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ arghaṃ nas/ shabta pra ti tstsha swa hā/ ༈ 'phags pa dzam bha la dkar po 'brug zhon lha/ dzam dmar nor skyug pho mo/ khro zhing sgeg pa'i dzam bha la// dzam ser zhal gsum phyag drug yab yum dzam ser nor rgyun ma yab yum/

dzam bha la rigs dgu'i rigs thams cad dang*/ rnam sras rigs dgu'i rigs thams cad dang*/ nor lha pho brgyad mo brgyad/ lha mo chen mo dpal phreng*/ gnod sbyin a pa ra dzi ta/ gnod sbyin gang po dang mdzes ma/ nor bdag ye shes grags/ phag gdong ma mched lnga*/ kun 'khyil ma spun gsum/ 'brog gnas mched lnga*/ gnod sbyin sde dpon bcu nyis/ sde (308)dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ stobs chen sum cu rtsa lnga*/ ljongs chen gnas pa bcu drug yul 'khor skyong ba lnga brgya// gnod sbyin bu mo yid 'phrog nor bu ma lnga klu mo padma'i gtsug phud ma la sogs 'phags pa gnas srung gi btsun mo lnga brgya/ kun tu rgyal ba la sogs sras lnga brgya// sras mo lnga brgya 'khor gnod sbyin bye ba drug cu'i tshogs rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo// mnyes shing tshim nasabadag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal dang 'byor pa/ stobs dang mnga' thang*/ nor dang longs spyod thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bskres skom mu ge tshong nyes/ phyug nad god kha snying stong thams cad zhi ba dang bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ༈ hūm̐/ bde gshegs sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin// gzugs kyi skur ston dzam bha la// dran pa tsam gyis dbul phongs sel// dzam lha 'khor bcas phyag 'tshal bstod// thog med ser (309)sna'i las bsags rnams// mthol bshags byang zhing dag gyur cig /dbul phongs thams cad zhi ba dang*// dpal 'byor nor dbyig 'phel zhing rgyas// 'dod rgu'i snang srid dbang du sdus// snyigs dus mu ge'i bskal pa bzlog /thugs dam dus bab sa ma ya// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// ༈ ces brjod mchod pa rgya chen po yid kyis sprul te mchod nas/ jo bo rjes zhal gzigs dus bstod pa'i gzhung byin rlabs can ni/ e ma ho/ 'jig rten dbang phyug nor bdag skur sprul 'phags pa ni// gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes

ngo bo nyid// zhal gcig phyag gnyis bu skra gyen brdzes nor bus brgyan// sha rgyas gsus 'phyang sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' bklubs// phyag yas be con 'dzin pas 'jig rten dbang du sdud// g.yon pas ne'u le 'dzin pas longs spyod char bzhin 'bebs// sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags 'brug la chibs// sna tshogs rin chen brgyan gyis mdzes la phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yon gyi gru mor rdo rje kha ṭāṃ bsnams pa ni// nyid kyi sku la gnyis med 'khril ba'i yum mchog mtshon// spyan gsum khro gnyer cung zad bsdus pa zhi khro'i tshul// yid la re ba'i 'bras bu sbyin la phyag 'tshal bstod// shar du zheng snga rnam dag me long ye shes sku// rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas nor bu g.yon pas rin chen bum pa 'dzin// dbyig gi char 'bebs rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// nub tu 'dod chags rnam dag sor rtog ye shes sku// padma mkha' 'gro dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas padma g.yon pas 'gugs byed lcags kyu 'dzin// 'gro rnams dbang sdus padma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// byang du phra dog rnam dag (311)bya grub ye shes sku// las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas rgya gram g.yon pas ne'u le'i rkyal bu bsnams// las kun 'grub byed sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// mgon po nam mkha'i mdog can nor gyi char 'bebs pa// ma skyes rang bzhin dag phyir sku mdog sngon por bzhugs/ khyod ni rdo rje sems dpa' nyid de bdag 'dra na// rtag tu yid la re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// ༈ bsdu na 'og nas/ 'phags pa gnod gnas dbang po sogs/ /bed gshegs kun kyi gsung las legs sprul zhing*// thugs rjes chags pas sku mdog dmar po bzhugs// dbang gi phrin las rdzogs mdzad dzam bha la// ma lus 'gro ba'i re skong phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yas zhal dkar bas lha rnams dbang du sdud// g.yon zhal sngo bas klu rnams dbang du sdud// rtsa zhal dmar bas mi rnams dbang du sdud// srid gsum dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhis nor skyug mnan// 'gro kun (312)re skong dgos 'dod rin chen dang*//

khams gsum 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu gnyis// g.yas gnyis dang po bar pas bsnams par mdzad// rin chen thod pa zhags pa g.yon gnyis na// mtha' gnyis ne'u le btsir zhing rin chen 'bebs// rnam mang rin chen nor gyi char 'bebs pa// ma lus 'gro ba'i re skong phyag 'tshal bstod// sku la rin chen du mas rnam par brgyan// klu chen brgyad dang lha yi na bzas bklubs// sgeg pa'i nyams ldan 'gro ba kun yid sdud// mgon po dzam bha la la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag la longs spyod nor chen dngos grub stsol/ zhes grwa pa mngon shes can gyi gter ma'o// nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun kyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam bha la// dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ ngal bsos dge ba stobs chen lus ngan po// g.yu mdog go dang rgyan cha dar gyis bklubs/ rgyal mtshan ne'u le (313)'dzin cing seng ge'i khar// phyed skyil brjed 'chang gnod sbyin mthu bo'i byin// btsun mo nang mi mngag gzhug sder bcas pa// mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la longs spyod phyir// khyod la 'dud do dpag bsam yongs 'du bzhin// bsam pa'i re ba bskang ba'i mchog sbyin mdzad// ༈ bam las gyur gnod sbyin mo// gser gyi mdog 'dra g.yas gri gug /g.yon pas thod khrag rab bsnams shing*/ kha ṭaṃ ga la rab tu 'khyud// phag gi gdong can mu tig brgyan// rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// rang 'dra'i 'khor bzhi bcas la bstod/ mchod pas mnyes nas 'dod pa'i don// char rgyun bzhin du ster bar mdzod// 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter ma'o/ ༈ dur khrod nags tshal shing drung chen po ru/ lhag par gnas bcas sha za mkha' 'gro gsum/ sgyu ma'i skur ston phrin las grub pa'i lha// sna tshogs mdzad pa yid bzhin nor 'dra zhing*// (314)dpag bsam shing ltar dgos 'dod re ba skong*/

mi 'dzad gter gyi bum bzang mdzod 'dzin pa// dgos 'dod mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// sha za mkha' 'gro mched gsum gyis// gtor ma bzhes la bdag gzhan kun// byang chub 'grub po'i grogs kyis phyir// sbyin dang bsod nams tshogs kyi rdzas// 'grub pa'i mthun rkyen dngos grub stsol/ 'phags klu grub kyis mdzad pa*/sna tshogs grol gyi gter ma'o// ༈ gnod gnas dbang po arya dzam bha la/ dkar ser dmar ljang sngo nag khra ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag drug zhal gcig phyag gnyis sogs// cha lugs sna tshogs phyag mtshan sna tshogs can// sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyed la phyag bstod// dzam lha'i yab gyur sems dpa' rin chen mang*// dkar po lcags kyu bum bsnams seng ge chibs// sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug klu mo 'khril// nag po 'dor stabs mchod rten ba dan 'phyar// ngam nag ral gri mda' dar rta sngon can// (315)dmar po zang ral phub bsnams rta sngon chibs// skag mdog bzhengs stabs mdung dmar mchod rten bsnams// dmar mdzes bzhengs stabs phyag gnyis dung sgra sgrogs// sngo ljang ral gri ne'u le rta sngon bcibs// ri rab phyogs mdog bzhengs stabs bzhugs pa sogs// 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i lus can khyod la bstod// dzam la'i mes po drang srong rnam thos sras// dzam la'i phyi mo lha mo dpal chen mo// dpal ldan ma dang dkar mo bkra shis ma// padma'i phreng ba can dang padma'i spyan// nor gyi bdag mo grags pa chen mo dang*// rin chen rab sbyin ma dang zas sbyin ma// byed pa mo dang 'od zer chen mo ste// bcu nyis mtshan ldan ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// dzam la'i yum ni padma gtsug bde ma// dmar ser nor bu pad snod zhal pa bsnams// btsun mo lnga brgya gnod sbyin bu mo ni// yid 'phrog lnga brgya'i tshogs dang bcas la/ (316)bstod// dzam la'i mched kyi mchog gyur gar mkhan mo// mdog smug g.yu 'brug la chibs bco rgyad phyag

/kun tu rgyal ba la sogs lnga brgyar bcas// rmugs 'dzin 'chol ba la sogs bstod par bgyi// dzam lha'i btsun mo lha mo nor rgyun ma// zla 'od ma dang shin tu bzang mo dang*// chu shel ma dang 'phags ma sbas ma dang*// sor legs ma dang lha mo dbyangs can ma// nor lha mo dgu 'khor dang bcas la bstod// dzam la'i bka' blon nor srung chen mo brgyad// nor bu bzang dang gang ba bzang po dang*// ku we ra dang gnod sbyin dmar po dang*// gi ling ma li pi tsi kunḍa li// mu khan dra dang tsa rant+ra la bstod// dzam la'i bka' sdod 'jig rten longs spyod bdag /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dzam bha la// gshin rje btsan dang ma mo dzam bha la/ bdud dang drang srong nyi zla'i dzam bha la// phyugs lha ljang gu bcas la mchod cing bstod// nor bu (317)bzang po dung mdog lug gi gdong*// gang ba bzang po gser mdog rta yi gdong*// sred spangs zangs mdog ra yi gdong pa can// rgyal ba khyu mchog g.yu mdog glang chen dbu// yang dag shes ni mdog bzang sha ba'i gdong*// 'brog nas mched lnga 'khor bcas mchod cing bstod// a par dzi ta bang mdzod gnyer kha ba// gang po mdzes ma mngag bzhugs khol mo te// myur mgyogs pho nya nor bdag ye shes grags// dzam la 'khor g.yog bran dang bcas la bstod// gnod sbyin sde dpon bcu nyis nyi shu brgyad// ljongs gnas bcu drug stobs chen sum cu gnyis// yul skyong lnga brgya gnod sbyin 'khor gyi tshogs// bye ba drug cu drug cu dang bcas pa// sde bo che la dbang chen drag shul che/ kha dog ldan zhing 'od dang gzi brjid che// gzhan gyi mi thub pha rol dpung 'joms pa// 'phags pa gnod gnas dbang po 'khor bcas la// mchod do bstod do mchod bstod byin rlabs kyis// bdag cag dpon slob srung bya 'khor bcas kyi// phyugs nad god kha thams cad bzlog tu gsol// bskal ngan mu ge thams cad=

phya g.yang bsod nams nyams pa= dbang thang rlung rta rgud pa= gtor brlags chag che snying stong= bse rag ltog 'gong dbul sri= rta nad rte'u sri thams cad= lug nad gtar mgrin thams cad= /rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// bang mdzod 'bru yi= rkang bzhi phyugs kyi= ja dar longs spyod= /gser dngul= rin chen= rta drel bzhon pa'i= /lhab lhub gos kyi dngos= /brgyud 'dzin mi yi= /dpal dang 'byor pa'i= mnga' ris 'khor 'bangs khe grags stobs// 'dzad med gter gyi= 'di nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// mi 'dzad nam mkha'i mdzod la longs spyod nas// 'phags pa mchod cing dbul phongs skyob byed cing*// sbyin pa'i phar phyin myur du rdzogs pa yi// phrin las mdzod cig sngon gyi thugs dam dgongs// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las (319)grub par mdzod// ༈ des nas dam can nor sgrub gsang ba yang khol gyi phrin las/ bdag nyid yi dam lha'i thugs ka'i sa bon dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs gsal ba'i thugs ka'i triḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas 'o yug nas dam can lha tshogs dang gon da sbyin nor lha/ yul gyi nor lha 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dam can nor lha brtanam thams cad mtsho la kha ba bab pa ltar spyan drangs nas mdun bskyed la yang yang bstim mo// hūm̐/ bdag ni rig 'dzin bsgrub pa po// bdag ni padma thod phreng rtsal// bdag ni bstan pa'i srog shing yin// bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can// dam la gnas shing lha la phreng*// padma rgyal po'i bka' srung ni// dam can skyes bu chen po khyod// khyod ni srung ma dam tshig can// khams gsum srid gsum kun kyi bdag// khyod ni dngos grub kun kyi mdzod// sku mdog dkar la cung zad dmar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ldan// phyag g.yas lcags kyu nor bu 'dzin// g.yon pas lde mig ne'u le bsnams// sku la ber dkar me tri gsol//

(320)dbu la stag zhu khra bo mnabs// rtse la dar dmar cod pan 'phur// zhabs la sag ti lham chen mnabs// yum ni kong btsun sman dang bcas// chibs su seng ge dkar mo bcibs// bsam pa yid la thog me sleb// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// mchod phyir bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol// skyes bu dam can da tshur byon// dge bsnyen chen po da tshur byon// gnod sbyin ded dpon da= yum dang bcas pa da tshur byon/ dzam la mched brgyad= /dngos grub stsol phyir= dge bsnyen nyer gcig= dbang sdus mdzad phyir= brtan ma bcu gnyis= bsam pa bsgrub phyir= mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu rnams// 'khor dang bcas pa da= /bar chad bsal phyir gshegs su gsol*// nor lha dam can 'khor bcas rnams// brten pa'i rdzas la da= /mchod pa'i rdzas la da= /dngos grub g.yang dang= /dam tshig dbang gis= /badzra sa dhu tsa tri hrīṃ dza (321)dza hūm̐ baṃ hāoḥ rin chen pho brang dam pa 'dir// gnyis med brtan par bzhugs su gsol// phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul// dam rdzas sman gtor rakta dang*// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams// dngos grub stsol phyir bzhes su gsol// badzra sa dhu sa ma ya arghaṃ sogs/ ma ha pañtsa bha ling ta rakta pu dza ho/ kyai/ phyogs phyogs de ni pha ki na// nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na// rin chen gzhal yas khang bzang nas// bla mkhar smug po'i pho brang na// 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i 'do zer 'phro// steng na dngos grub char ltar 'bebs// sku mkhar rin chen gzhal yas dbus// rin chen gser gyi khri steng na// padma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba ru// nor bdag dge bsnyen chen po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis dkar la dmar// ber kar me tri dmar po mnabs// gser sked rin chen sku reg bcings// dbu la stag zhu khra bo gyon// dar dmar cod pan (322)'phur lce btags// zhabs la sag ti lham po che// phyag g.yas lcags kyu nor bu 'dzin// g.yon pas lde mig ne'u le bsnams// rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan// skyes bu chen po khyod la bstod// pang du kong btsun sman gcig ma// dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// phyag g.yas me long yab mgul 'khyud// g.yon pas mda' dar dkar po bsnams// sku la dar
