dkar gser thig mnabs// dbu zhwa g.yu thod mu tig spras// skyes bu'i sku lad gyes par 'khrid// seng chen khri la bde bar rol// sga gong rin chen stag sgro bkal// yab yum gnyis su med par bstod// nor bdag dzam la mched brgyad ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog ser// g.yas g.yon lcags kyu ne'u 'dzin/

gter brgyad steng na rin chen brgyad// gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas la bstod// dge bsnyen nyer gcig sku mdog dmar// sku la me tri dbu (323)sag zhu// lcags kyu stag rgyal ba dan phyar// mchan du stag sgro rin chen snod// srid gsum 'gugs mdzad 'khor bcas bstod// brtan ma chen mo bcu nyis ni// me long nor bu mda' dar bsnams// dar dkar na bza' g.yu thig spras// dbu la g.yu thod mu tig brgyan// brtan ma bcu nyis 'khor bcas bstod// mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu ni// stag chas zhub chen btsun chas kyi/ phyag na nor bu rin chen snod// du ma rnam pa sna tshogs bsnams// sum brgya drug cu 'khor bcas bstod// khyed la phrin las bcol ba ni// 'gro ba mi yi rnam shes sgul// sbyin bdag pho mo'i lag pa rkyong*// g.yang chen nor dang brjid can gos// bcud chen bza' ba la sogs pa// thams cad dag la bstsal du gsol// mi snying bsgul la mi 'gram chog /rang dbang med par dbang bsdus shig / ces dang*/ rang nyid lha'i (324)thugs ka'i hūm̐ las dzaḥsbrel ma lcags kyu lta bur gyur pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ stong gsum 'jig rten gyi lha klu mi dang mi ma yin pa kun kyi zas nor longs spyod 'gro ba pho mo'i gsang gnas su lcags kyu'i rtse mo zhugs nas rang dbang med par rdzas la bstim// mdun bskyed lha tshogs kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer de ltar 'phros nas rdzas la bstim/ oṃ badzra sa dhu sa ma ya king ka ra hūm̐ badzra li la ma hūm̐ dzaḥ.oṃ dzambha la dza lent+ra ye swa hā/ tri dkar shar ling*/ tri pra ma ni ging ka ra bhyo/ ratna siddhi ku ru hūm̐ dzaḥdza/ tri'u tri'u pra ma dun dkar ba skyes pa bud med sarba pā shaṃ tri ya pha la khug skyol// phur sta dza/ phur sta dza/ snying ril ril tsher ma raksha thum ril ril// 'gro ba pho mo'i snying rtsa sgul sgrul/ ratna siddhi bhrum̐ 'dus 'dus/

rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus/ mi snying bsgul bsgul/ srid gsum ka cha nga la shog / ces ci mang du bzla ba ra bya'o// ༈ de nas rma rgyal spom ra'i phrin las bsam 'phel nor bu ni/ mdun du rma gnyan (325)spom ra sogs/ /char 'bebs bsam/ bar gzhung ltar gtang ngo*// ༈ de nas g.yang bsang nor bu'i char sprin ni/ bzang shing dkar mngar zas sna'i bsang dud dang*/ gser skyems bcas 'du byas la/

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ mi gtsang ba'i dri ma sreg gtor bskrus/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī/ lan gsum/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs dang*/ bdag gis bsod nams dang smon lam gyi stobs dang*/ rigs sngags kyi stobs kyis me tog dang bdug pa la sogs pa 'di dag kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod kyi char pa zad mi shes pa 'jo bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad khyab par gyur gcig na ma sarba bhuddha bho dhi sa twa nā/ sarba thāta khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa manta swa hā/ lan gsum brjod/ dbyangs snyan rol mo bcas 'di skad du/ kyai/ sangs rgyas byang sems smon lam dang*// 'byung ba 'dus pa'i rten 'brel las// rang byung bdud rtsi can gyi shing*/ (326)/spos kyi sprin chen trawa bar 'khrigs// bdug pa'i dri bsung zhing kun khyab// me tog phreng bas bar snang khebs// gser skyems ye shes bdud rtsir bskyil// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung gtibs// 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod char 'bebs// dbyangs snyan rol mo'i sgra yis 'bod// dad mos rtse gcig gus pa yis// mchod yul rgya mtsho spyan 'dren na// rab 'byams dag pa'i zhing khams nas// rgyal dang rgyal sras thugs rje can// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs chen po yis// ye shes rang gzugs chu zla'i gar// mdun mkhar sprin bzhin gtib par mdzod// pho brang lcang lo can gyi 'khor// skyed tshal bsod nams me tog 'od// khang bzang padma dam pa nas// nor gyi lha mo chen mo dpal// nor rgyun ma sogs grogs mo brgyad// nor bdag bye ba'i 'khor dang bcas// spyan 'dren dgyes pa'i thugs kyis (327)gshegs// tshogs kyi bdag po mi mgon dkar// rma rgyal spom ra gnyan po sogs// srid gsum g.yang bdag 'khor bcas rnams// bsang dang mchod pa'i gnas 'dir byon// rin chen me tog dar zab khri// dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/

padma utpal ku mud sogs// mdangs mdzes me tog phreng bas mchod// tsan dan bal bu a gar sogs// ngad bzang bdug pa'i sprin gyis mchod// sbrang rtsi bu ram ro sbyar ba'i// 'o chab arghaṃ rgyun gyis mchod// ro brgya nus pa stong ldan pa'i// zhal zas bza' btung du mas mchod// bstod dbyangs yan lag brgya ldan pas// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i// mgron rigs ma lus bsngags par bgyi// mnyes nas mchog dang thun mong gi// dngos grub chu bo'i rgyun ltar stsol/ kyai/ dkon mchog rgyal ba shākya thub// dam (328)chos gser 'od dam pa dang*// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun tshogs bcas la// phyag 'tshal bsang dang mchod pa 'bul// lha mo chen mo byang chub tu// thugs mchog bskyed mdzad dge ba'i bshes// rin chen me tog yon tan mtsho// baiḍūrya dang gser gyi ri// mdog bzang gser du snang ba'i dpal// byang sems nyan thos tshogs bcas la// phyag 'tshal bsang dang mchod pa 'bul// de bzhin gshegs pa dpal stug po// bkra shis dpal dang skar 'od dpal// g.yul rgyal snang ba'i dkyil 'khor dpal// rgyal mtshan shugs snang spos snang dpal// zhing mdzad sku dang mtshan snang dpal// mtshan dpal rin chen gnas kyi dpal// 'od 'phags yang dag rdzogs pa'i dpal// gser mchog snang dpal sgra dbyangs dpal// 'od kyi tog dang lhun po'i dpal// tshangs dpal dbang phyug chen po'i dpal// 'od dpal chos 'od rgyal po'i dpal// 'od bzang dpal dang tog gi (329)dpal// spos sgrol rgya mtsho'i snying po'i dpal// snyan dpal chos snang bkod pa'i dpal// shing rgyal ltar skyes ri bo'i dpal// ye 'od sman chen shugs kyi dpal// sprin chen dpal dang dran rtog dpal// dbang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan dpal// nor 'bru kun sdud zhi 'dren dpal// phun sum tshogs pa 'gugs pa'i dpal// rgyal po'i myu gu'i tshogs bcas la// phyag 'tshal bsang dang mchod pa 'bul// bde gshegs rin chen gtsug tor can// dri med rin chen 'od snang tog

/'dzam bu'i gser gyi rgyal mtshan dang*/ gser snang 'od snang snying po mchog /gser ri rin 'byung gdugs brtsegs pa// gser gyi me tog 'od 'bar tog /sgrol ma chen po rin chen tog /mi 'khrugs rin chen tshe dpag med// rnga sgra la sogs phyogs bcu dang*// dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal rnams la// phyag 'tshal bsang dang mchod pa 'bul// (330)'jam dbyangs phyag rdor spyan ras gzigs// sgrib sel nam snying kun tu bzang*// byams pas snying mdzes pa'i tog// gser 'od dam pa gser gyi snying*// rtag ngu chos 'phags rab gnas sogs// rgyal sras byang sems tshogs rnams la// phyag 'tshal bsang dang mchod pa 'bul// khyed rnams mchog pa'i byin rlabs kyi// bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis// nyes sdig thams cad med pa dang*// lus dang sems kyi dri ma sol// nor dang 'bru rnams 'du zhing 'phel// dbul zhing phongs pa'i rgyun chad de// lha klu gnod sbyin lha ma yin// dri za mkha' lding mi'am ci// lto phye che sogs 'dun cing 'gugs/ yams nad gnod 'tshe 'thab dang 'khrugs// 'gyed dang rtsod sogs rab zhi zhing*// pha rol phyin drug yongs su grub// kun mkhyen ye shes rdzogs pa sogs// chos mthun bsam pa'i don rnams kun// myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol// (331)kyai/ bsang ngo dpal chen lha mo bsang*// mchod do dpal chen lha mo mchod// dpal ldan bkra shis pad phreng ma// nor bdag dkar sham grags pa che// pad spyan 'od chen byed pa mo// zas sbyin rin chen rab sbyin ma/ bcu nyis mtshan ldan dpal chen mo// byang chub sems ma'i tshogs bcas la// phyag 'tshal bsang dang mchod pa 'bul// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*// lha rnams kyis ni dbang bskur bas/ de bzhin gshegs dang lha rnams yum// bde gshegs byang sems nyan rang dang*// tshangs pa khyab mjug dbang phyug che// lha sogs gnas kun yod pa'i dpal// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// lha min mkha' lding mi'am ci// lto 'phye chen po rigs sngags 'chang*// lag na rdo rje rdo rje 'chang*// 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dang lnga*/

gza' dang rgyu skar dpal de la/ phyag 'tshal bsang dang mchod pa 'bul// nyi bu rig byed bzhi yi dpal// bkra shis ma dang sems can ma// rgyal ma (332)rnam rgyal gang gā ma/ mu stegs bkra shis thams cad ma// dri med byed dpal sdig 'phrog ma// rgyags byed zla nyi gza' kun dpal// phyag 'tshal bsang dang mchod pa 'bul// seng bzhon pad mchog 'bum gyis bkab// pad ma pad 'byung pad gnas ma// pad 'dzin padma dang ldan ma// shis 'dzin bsod nams bsags pa'i lus// shes nyan can gyi bu mo la// phyag 'tshal = phyag dang spyan dang dbu 'bum mnga'// nor bu sna tshogs cod pan ldan// gzugs bzang kun kyi gzugs can ma// grags ma shin grags zhi ba ma// srin 'dra'i skra gtsang zla ltar mdzes/ dge ma dge byed sems can la// mngon phyogs 'phags ma me tog dpal// me tog ngag gi dbang phyug mar// phyag 'tshal= ri rgyal ri rab chu klung dang*// mtsho chu rgya mtsho kun gyi dpal// mu stegs thams cad mngon phyogs dpal// sman nag rtsa dang nor bu'i (333)dpal// gser sbyin zas dang sgom sbyin dpal// 'od gsal snang ma lus gtsang ngam// bde gshegs dbang sgyur lha mngon phyogs// brgya byin la sogs skyong bzhi'i dpal// phyag 'tshal= sbyin byed longs spyod gzi brjid ma// gzi ldan phun tshogs 'byor 'phel ma// mthong ma chos dpal khyab 'jug bsten// ku muta la gnas gnod bzod sbyin// mthu gnas dag byed bkra shis lag// mi shis kun 'jig bsod nams sdud// sa dang rgyal po gsang sngags rgyal// 'byung po gnod sbyin sogs kyi dpal// lha gnas lha dang bzlas brjod dang*// bzlas brjod sbyin sreg bya ba dang*// bkra shis kun kyi dpal gyur la// phyag 'tshal= 'od ldan mchod dga' skal pas 'gyur/ drang srong dga' brjod bud med kyi// gnas kun gtso mo dpal gyi mchog /lha min mi'am ci mo'i dpal// kha na (334)ma thos med gnas 'dug

yid 'ong bsil byed lus ngan kyi// snying sdug chos kyi rgyal po'i dpal// phyag 'tshal= nor rgyun ma dang zla shel ma// sbyin byed ma dang rab sbyin ma// 'phags ma sbas ma rab bzang ma// dbyangs can ma ste grogs mo brgyad// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la// phyag 'tshal= rnam mang thos sras de yi sras// ku be ra sogs rta bdag brgyad// dzam la dkar ser dmar nag sogs// rin chen nor gyi char 'bebs pa'i/ gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum bcas la// phyag 'tshal= lha mo 'khor dang bcas mchod pa'i mthus// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ nyes ltung sdig pa zad cing 'joms/ bkra ma shis kun med par mdzod// mi mthun phyogs kun myur du 'jig /nam yang brel zhing phongs med mdzod// bsod nams dpal dang bde ba dang*// skal pa bzang rnams sdud par mdzod// sdug bsngal kun (335)las sgrol zhing thar// bsod nams tshogs kun mngon gyur mdzod// sa la sa yi bcud 'phel zhing*// lo tog 'bras bu rab rgyas mdzod// lha rnams rtag tu rab dga' zhing*// srung zhing skyobs dang sbed par mdzod// zas gos mal cha sman la sogs// bder gnas yo byad lhun grub mdzod// nor bu mu tig gser dngul sogs// rin chen nor gyi char 'bebs mdzod// mu ge med cing lo tog legs// 'bru yi phung po char 'phel mdzod// ngan 'gro'i skye gnas rgyun chad cing*// lha mi'i bde ba rtag myong mdzod// yid bde thob cing dpal rnams thob/ bsam pa'i don kun yongs rdzogs mdzod/ kyai/ 'dod khams rtsa gsum lha yi gnas// 'dod 'byung gter gyi khang bzang nas// tshogs rje tshogs bdag bgegs kyi gtso// phongs sel 'byor ba kun (336)kyi bdag// lha gnas skyong zhing lha min 'joms// tshogs kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs bsang dang mchod pa bzhes// sku yi tshogs bdag dkar po bsang*// nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi bar mdzod// gsung gi tshogs bdag dmar po bsang*// khams gsum dbang du sdud par mdzod// thugs kyi tshogs bdag mthing ga bsang*// mchog thun dngos grub thob par mdzod// yon tan tshogs bdag ser po=

tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod// phrin las tshogs bdag ljang gu= dgra 'dre gdon gsum brlag par mdzod// ye shes las dang 'jig rtan gyi// tshul bzhin lha chen 'khor bcas la// rin chen bdun dang bkra shis brgyad// bsang mchod rngan yon rgya chen 'bul// rigs kyi bu la brgyud kyi lha// 'khor ba srid pa'i lugs yin pas// lag na rdo rje'i bka' bzhin du// mi dang lha ru ma 'bral bar// rtag tu srung (337)skyob sdong grogs mdzod// steng phyogs lha yid phywa g.yang phob// dbu 'phang dgung bas mtho bar mdzod/ kyai/ rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil nas// rin chen gzhal yas khang pa nas// rgyal ba kun kyi bstan skyong zhing*// nor bu gter gyi bdag po ste// klu rgyal mi mgon dkar po ni// sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs kas mdzes// thugs rje sprin gyi dbu rgyan can// gter bum nor bus gang ba 'dzin// 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs bsang mchod bzhes// nor bdag mi mgon dkar po bsang*/ klu mo kun shes 'od ldan bsang*// blon po dung skyonga'od 'bar bsang*// dga' bo 'jog po la sogs pa'i// klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas= /ma dros gzi chen la sogs pa'i// rgyal ba'i zhal mthong bstan pa srung*// gtsug na rin chen thogs pa yi// klu (338)rgyal brgya stong khri 'bum bsang*// klu bran bye ba dung phyur= rigs bzhi klu yi tshogs rnams la// dkar gsum klu sman dkor cha dang*// bsang mchod rngan yon rgya cher 'bul// char chu dus su 'bebs pa dang*// lo phyugs rtag tu legs par mdzod// mi nad phyugs nad zhi ba dang*// bde skyid dpal 'byor phun tshogs mdzod// 'og phyogs klu yi phywa g.yang phob// dbang thang mtsho ltar 'khyil bar mdzod/ kyai/ shar phyogs gangs dkar rtse rgyal na// 'ja' tshon 'od kyi gur khang nas// rma rgyal spom ra lha yi sras// dung khrab dung rmog sku la gsol// dung rta dkar po ri tsam bcibs/

stag ral gzigs shubs 'khor gsum bskor/ stag 'phru khyung dang nyi zlas brgyan// thugs dkar yid bzhin nor bu las// rma g.yang dngos grub char ltar 'bebs// rma sras dung (339)mi dkar po dgu// spu ris ldan pa'i rta dgu chibs// sring mo lcam dgu yum dang bcas// me long sba gling kyu ru ru// sha rkyang dgo gtsod bem dang rol// lcam sring bzhi bcu rtsa lnga dang*// rma rigs sum brgya drug bcu mchod// yang 'khor sum brgya drug cu dang*// phyi 'khor bye ba 'bum phrag sogs// lha 'khor stong dang rma sman 'bum// mod khams chu bzhi sgang drug gi// yul bdag gnyen po 'khor bcas rnams// 'dir gshegs bsang mchod rngan yon bzhes// 'dod yon lnga dang rin chen bdun// 'bru sna dar zab ja chang phud// rin chen sman sna shel tshig bshos// g.yag lug ra sogs gzugs 'gros tshogs// bal bu mkhan dkar a ga ru// ga yu shug phye mar gsur gyis mchod// zhi ba bsang gis mchod cing rngan// rma g.yang zas dang dkor mdzod (340)nor// rkang bzhi phyugs dang bang mdzod 'bru// rigs rgyud 'phel dang btsan dar che// tshe bsod dbang thang longs spyod sogs// dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// rma g.yang nam mkha'i char bzhin phob// tshe dpal ri ltar brtan par mdzod/ ༈ kyai/ sras bcas rgyal ba thugs rje can// dpal gyi lha mo 'khor dang bcas// srid gsum g.yang gi bdag mo rnams// spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas mchog 'dir// dgyes pas byon la bka' drin che// ma 'byor ma dag ma tshang sogs// byis blos nongs pa ci mchis pa// brtse ba'i thugs kyis bzod bzhes la// mchod cing gsol btab bcol ba'i don// rgya chen rgyun mi chad pa'i gter// dri med baiḍūrya bzhin du// 'dod dgu char du bsnyil bar mdzod/ ༈ ye shes lha rnams ji srid bar// brtan bzhugs thugs rje'i byin rlabs stsol// 'jig rten pa rnams (341)rang gnas gshegs// dus dang dus su slar 'byon nas// mchod bzhes dgyes pa'i thugs kyis dgongs/

tshogs gnyis mthar phyin phywa dang dpal// srid dang zhi ba'i bcud du 'khyil// bla med bkra shis 'od po ches// 'jig rten mtha' dag khyab par shog / ces dang*/ de nas gtor 'bul dngos grub g.yang 'khyil ni/ dkar mngar gyi bza' btung ci rigs pa gtsang bar bshams la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrum̐ yig las/ rin chen snod mchog yangs pa'i nang*/ khaṃ yig 'od zhu dngos bshams kyi// bza' btung lha yi bdud rtsi'i bdud// ye shes bdud rtsir byin rlabs pa// 'dod yon sprin phung 'phro bar gyur// oṃ a ka ro sogs lan gsum/ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ hūm̐/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i ye shes sku// shes rab pha rol phyin ma dngos// sangs rgyas kun kyi bsod nams las/ (342)/'khrungs pa'i lha mo chen mo dpal// 'gro ba'i don la dgongs pa mo// dad pa dam tshig dbang gis ni// gzhan gyi don la thugs bskul tshe// lcang lo can nas sku bskyod la// grogs mo lha mo brgyad dang bcas// rdzu 'phrul thugs rje che po yis// skad cig sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs// mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i steng*// dgyes pa chen pos bzhugs su gsol// rab gus dad pas phyag bgyi'o// utpal la sogs me tog phreng*// tsandan dang sbyar bdug pa'i sprin// nyi zla mar me snang gsal 'od// 'o chab dri med arghaṃ sogs// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod tshogs 'bul// dam ye gnyis med bdud rtsi'i mtsho// zhal zas bza' btung lha mi'i bcud// 'od zer sbu gu'i ljags skyong la// mchod bzhes dgyes pa'i thugs kyis dgongs// oṃ (343)ka ma la wā si ni/ ka ma le ma hā laṣa she mi rā dzyaṃ me/ ba su nā nā kha dhe sarba siddhi/ de hi de hi ba ra de swa hā/ e daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

lan gsum/ sad ya the na/ dzi ni ghri ni/ sarba artha pā dhni/ sha shi ni/ a lakṣa mi ni/ me nā sha ya siddhyantu mant+ra pā dāswa hā/ zhes gtso mo la 'bul zhing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ oṃ ba su dha ri ṇyai swa hā/ e daṃ ba liṃ sogs/ oṃ sant+ra kand+yai swa hā/ oṃ dā dā ye shes swa hā/ oṃ su dā dā ye swa hā/ oṃ arya ye swa hā/ oṃ su bha tra ye swa hā/ oṃ guta ye swa hā/ oṃ te bhi ye swa hā/ oṃ swa ra swa st+ye swa hā/ e daṃ ba liṃ sogs/ tadya thā dzi na ghṛ ni/ sarba a karma siddhi ni/ si si mi/ si li si/ ni mi ni mi/ a lakṣa ya me na sha ye swa hā/ (344)sarba bha su siddhi de hi me hūm̐ swa hā/ hūm̐/ yi bzhin nor 'dra'i sems ma che/ zag med bde bskyed rgyal ba'i yum// 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong mdzad ma// nor sbyin lha mo dpal chen mo// margad mdog can 'od zer 'bar// mdzes 'dzum dar dang rin chen brgyan// phyag g.yas rin chen padma 'dzin// g.yon pas mchod sbyin dngos grub ster// gter gyi bum pa'i khri la bzhugs// khyod la mchod bstod gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan bkra shis pad phreng ma// nor bdag dkar sham grags pa che// pad spyan 'od chen byed pa mo// zas sbyin rin chen rab sbyin ma// mtshan mchog bcu gnyis ldan pa la// phyag 'tshal mchod bstod thugs rjes dgongs// nor rgyun ma dang zla shel ma// sbyin byed ma dang rab sbyin ma// 'phags ma sbas ma rab bzang ma// dbyangs can ma ste grogs mo (345)brgyad/ gser mdog rin chen dar zab brgyan// phyag g.yas 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin// g.yon pas gter gyi bum pa bsnams// yid 'ong sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan// nor bdag bye ba 'bum bcas la// gsol lo mchod do dgyes gyur gcig /sgrub mchog bdag dang yon bdag la// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub ni// ri rab lta bur spung du gsol// rgya mtsho bzhin du bskyil du gsol// sprin phung bzhin du gtibs pa dang*// bar snang char bzhin 'bebs par mdzod// bdag dang 'gro ba sems can kun// ngan 'gro'i skye gnas rgyun chad cing*// dbul ba'i 'jigs dang bral bar mdzod// sgrub pa'i rten la dgyes bzhugs la// 'di dang gtan gyi legs dgu'i dpal// yid la gang bsam 'grub par mdzod/

zhar byung srid gsum g.yang bdag la gtor ma 'bul (346)na/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho ཿhrīḥ hūm̐/ rtsa gsum gnas nas tshogs kyi bdag /rgya mtsho'i klong nas mi mgon dkar// gangs dkar rtse nas spom ra gnyan// 'khor bcas mchod pa'i gnas mchog 'dir// dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol// badzra sa ma dza/ tiṣṭha lhan/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti sa pā ri wa ra e daṃ ba li taṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ na gā ra dza ma nu ṣe nā tha sa pa= oṃ ku ma ra phu tri sa pa= ba su nā nā kha dhe sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha hūm̐/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mdzad cing*// dngos grub stsol ba'i g.yar dam can// steng phyogs lha dang 'og phyogs klu// bar phyogs gnyan gyi sde dpon che// 'khor dang bcas la mchod cing bstod// bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub ni// nam mkha' lta bur rgya che zhing*/(347)/rgya mtsho bzhin du gting zab la// ri rab lta bur lhun sdug pa// myur ba nyid du bstsal ba dang*// gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad du// bsam rgu 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod// ces phrin las bcol lo/ ༈ de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ swa bha sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ ram̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐// zhu ba las byung rlung me thod skyed steng*// a yig las byung mtshan ldan ka pa lar// go ku da ha na las sha chen lnga*/ bī ra shu ma las byung bdud rtsi lnga*/ de steng bhrum̐ aṃ dziṃ khaṃ hūm̐ yig las// sangs rgyas lnga yi ngo bor gyur pa'i steng*// hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan// de las 'od 'phros rlung g.yos me 'bar bas// thod pa'i rdzas zhu steng du rdo rje lhung*// lan gsum dkrugs pas rdo rje zhu nas thim// dri med (248)shel ltar dwangs ba'i bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ tshogs spyan 'dren dang mchod pa ni/

gnas 'og min chos dbyings zhing khams nas// pha bla ma gar dbang rdo rje 'chang*// sku dmar gsal dar dang rin chen brgyan// phyag rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnams// gdan pad zla khyung chen khri la bzhugs// 'khor rtsa rgyud bla ma sprin ltar gtibs// sku 'ja' 'od thig le shigs se shig// gsung gsang sngags chos sgra di ri ri// thugs brtse ba'i 'dzum mdangs shigs se shig /nged dbu slob tshogs kyi dpon la byon// bcud 'chi med bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod bzhes// don phyag rgya chen po'i ngos grub gnang*// pha khyod dang dgongs pa mnyam pa zhig /dus da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs/ / nub bde chen 'bar ba'i zhing khams nas// dpal rigs bdag mgon po 'od dpag med// sku (349)dkar gsal mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar// phyag mnyam zhag lhung bzed bum pa bsnams// gdan mdzes byed rma bya'i khri la bzhugs// 'khor sems dpa' sems ma sprin ltar gtibs// sku 'od zer sangs rgyas zhing kun gsal// gsung tshangs dbyangs drug cu snyan pa'i sgra// thugs 'gro ba kun la rtag tu dgongs// nged 'dir tshogs tshogs kyi dpon la byon// tshogs zag med bdud rtsi mchod pa bzhes// don 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub gnang*// bdag 'phos tshe khyed kyi zhing khams su// der skye bar da lta byin gyis rlobs// lho ku ru kulle'i ri phug nas// yum bcom ldan 'das ma rig byed ma// sku padma rā ga'i ri bo 'dra// phyag mda' gzhu lcags kyu utpāl bsnams// gdan dbang phyug sgra gcan zhabs kyis mnan/(350)/'khor gnas gsum mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs// sku rin chen rus rgyan khra la la// gsung rig sngags 'brug sgra 'u ru ru// thugs snang srid dbang sdud hri li li// ma 'dir gshegs bu yi tshogs dpon mdzod// tshogs sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga po bzhes// don khams gsum dbang sdud dngos grub gnang*// ma khyed ltar snang srid zil gnon par// bu da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs// nub o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing khams nas// 'khor gau ri lha mo bcu bzhi po// sku mtshan mdog rus rgyan dar dpyang 'phur// phyag utpāl mda' gzhu wang se wang*// gdan pad nyi bam gyi gdan la 'gying*// 'khor ḍā ki bye ba sprin ltar gtibs// sku byin rlabs me dpung 'u ru ru// gsung pheṃ pheṃ a ra li sgra sgrogs// thugs sgrub pa po la dung nge dung*/

nged 'dir tshogs tshogs (351)kyi grogs la byon// tshogs bdud rtsir byin rlabs dgyes par rol// don mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gnang*// sring khyed dang skal ba mnyam pa zhig /dus da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs// yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas// rgyud bka' yi srung ma gri thod can// sku mthing nag char sprin gtibs pa 'dra// phyag zangs gri thod pa zangs se zang*// gdan pad nyi bam chen gdan la bzhugs// 'khor ḍā ki bye ba bsam mi khyab/ / sku dur khrod rgyan cha dpungs se dpung*// gsung drag sngags 'brug sgra di ri ri// thugs gsang sngags bstan la dung nge dung*// 'dir tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes phyir byon// dgra gdon bgegs tshogs su bstim la rol// don phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub rtsol// mi bdag gi ci bsam 'grub pa zhig (352)/dus da lta nyid du phrinalas mdzod// oṃ gu ru badzra dha ra o daṃ= oṃ ku ru kulle hrī sa pā ri wa ra e daṃ= oṃ ma hā ka la sarba ḍa ki ni e daṃ ba liṃ ta kha hi/ de nas bskang ba la/ skong rdzas rnams kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bur gyur/ oṃ badzra spha raṇa khaṃ gis byin gyis rlabs la/ hri/ gsang ba ye shes ḍā ki rgya mtsho'i tshogs// khyed rnams thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni// sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam lnga ye shes lnga// 'dod yon gtor ma tshogs kyi longs spyod bcas// 'og min la sogs zhing khams rab 'byams na// tshogs kyi mchod pa bdud rtsi'i bye brag dang*// glu gar rol mo pi waṃ gling bu'i tshogs// rkang gling cang te'u rgyan drug rin chen rgyan// 'ja' 'od spos sprin me tog char rgyun sogs// bla med mchod pa'i tshogs dang rgyan cha'i tshogs// gang mchis bsam pa dag pa'i blos blangs nas// deng (353)'dir bskang ba'i rdzas su dmigs byas te/ / chos longs sprul sku'i ngo bo ḍā ki'i btso// gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i=

rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs// mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyi= rdo rje phag mo zhal gcig mkha' 'gro bzhi// snyan rgyud lhan cig skyes ma'i= zhal gnyis zhal bzhi dbu bcad don grub ma// mkha' spyod dkar dmar rnams kyi= khraus ma rigs lnga dur khrod mkha' 'gro brgyad// thugs rje khros ma'i lha tshogs= seng gdong ma dang stag gdong dom gdong ma// seng gdong lha mo bcu bzhi'i= ku ru kulle sgron ma dug sel ma// sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig= yid bzhin 'khor lo seng sding nags kyi sgrol// sher phyin sna tshogs yum gyi= skul byed ma dang rdo rje lcags sgrog ma// lha mo 'od zer can ma'i= gdugs (354)dkar rnam rgyal gdugs nag ri khrod ma// bsrung ba'i lha mo lnga yi= dbyangs can ma dang ral gcig khro gnyer can/ rigs sngags lha mo kun gyi= khri btsun kong jo ma cig lab kyi sgron// bod yul ḍā ki kun kyi= dkar ser dmar ljang sngo dang smug po'i mdog /'bum phrag yangs pa'i ḍā ki'i= gnas yul rtsa dang zhing la gnas pa yi// ḍā ki ma lus kun gyi= dpa' mo rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang gyur nas// drod gsum 'bar ba gsum dang 'du ba gsum// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes mkha' 'gro'i bskang ba dang*/ hūm̐/ nor lha gter bdag rgya mtsho bskang ba'i rdzas// dkar gsum mngar gsum ba ling rin chen 'bru// brten rdzas sgrub rdzas mchod rdzas dngos 'byor bshams// yid kyis mdzad med nam mkha'i mdzod du sprul// dag (355)dang ma dag zhing khams rab 'byams na// rin chen gter chen dpag sam rin chen shing*// gter gyi bum pa rta lug gnag gi khyu// mi dbang stobs ldan btsun mo dpal 'byor bcas// dpung bzhi yan lag ru dar go mtshon khrab// bskang ba'i rdzas su blo yis blangs byas nas/ gser mdog rnam mang thos sras gnod sbyin brgyad// ljang chung klu brgyad bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang*// lus ngan mthing ga phyag drug lha mo brgyad// mdung dmar ma trag bzhi yi=

rnam sras rigs brgyad dregs byed 'brog gnas lnga*/ gnod sbyin gar mkhan mchog gi= /rgyal chen yab gyur lha chen dbang phyug che// u ma mkha' 'gro bzhi bcas= rgyal chen yum ni lha mo dpal chen mo// padma'i phreng ba can ma'i= bkra shis ma dang dkar mo zas sbyin ma// rin chen (356)rab sbyin ma= nor gyi bdag po snyan pa grags chen mo// byed pa mor grags ma yi= padma'i spyan ma gzi brjid 'od can ma// bcu gnyis mtshan ldan lha mo'i= rgyal chen sras mchog arya dzaṃ bha la// rmugs 'dzin gnod gnas dbang po'i= sku sprul dzaṃ dkar 'brug chibs mkha' 'gro bzhi// kun 'khyil lha mo gsum bcas= gsung sprul dzaṃ dmar sbas yum rigs byed ma// nor skyug gnod sbyin gnyis kyi= /thugs sprul dzaṃ nag gnod sbyin klu yi tshogs// phrin las dzaṃ khra dang bcas= yon tan dzaṃ ser gnod sbyin pho mo dgu// dzaṃ ser zhal gsum phyag drug= /dzaṃ lha'i yum mchog lha mo nor rgyun ma// mched lnga gnod sbyin mo brgyad= /rgyal chen btsun mo klu mo nor skyong ma// gnod sbyin bu mo lnga (357)brgya'i= /rgyal chen mdzod 'dzin gzhan gyi mi thub pa// rigs gsum las mkhan bcas pa'i= mngag gzhug gnod sbyin gang dang mdzes pa gnyis// klu rgyal gang mdzes rnams kyi= /rgyal chen sras po'i dbang po dgu cu gcig /mched spun sum cu rtsa gnyis= sde dpon nyer brgyad rgyang gnas cu drug dang*// las mkhan ye shes grags kyi= 'phrog ma bur bcas srin mo chen mo brgyad// yul 'khaur skyong ba lnga brgya'i= gnod sbyin sde dpon bcu gnyis bdun 'bum 'khor// gnod sbyin bye ba drug cu'i= 'phags skyes spyan mi bzang dang yul 'khor srung*// rang rang dpung dang bcas pa'i= lha chen yum mchog bkra shis tshe ring ma// mched lnga 'khor dang bcas pa'i= sngags kyi bdag po klu brgyad mi mgon dkar// nor (358)rgyas wa ru ṇa yi=

rta lha re manta dang ku be ra// phyugs lha ljang gu rnams kyi= nor lha rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang gyur nas// tshe rabs kun tu dpal 'byor phun tshogs te// sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa'i phrin las mdzod// deng nas bzung ste longs spyod mnga' thang rnams// yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzad du gsol// zhes nor lha spyi bskang dang*/ bye brag tu bskang ba la/ dpal chen mo'i rten bskyed nas gzhung 'gros kyi lha klu gnyan gsum yan tshar grangs ci nus dang*/ rnam sras kyi bskang gso rin chen spungs pa ni// hūm̐// ri rgyal lhun po'i pho brang nas: lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas// rin chen mdzes pa'i pho brang nas: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: sa brgyad byang chub sems dpa' po: da lta byang phyogs rgyal po'i tshul: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang*// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i phyir: thugs dam bskang ba'i gnas 'di ru: bskul phyir bsgrub phyir gshegs (359)su gsol: bcom ldan shākya thub pa dang: gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yi: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa: dam las ma 'da' gnas 'dir byon: rgyal po chen po gshegs su gsol// gnod sbyin chen po gshegs su gsol: sngon nas da lta yan chad kyi: dus rnams rtag tu bsgrub pa'i lha: gnod sbyin mdung dmar 'khor dang bcas: thugs dam bskang phyir gshegs su gsol: baishra ma ṇa ye dza:hūm̐ baṃ ho: tiṣṭha lhan: a ti pu ho: pra ti tsa ho: hūm̐/ rgyal po rnam sras 'khor bcas rnams: thugs dam banyen po bskang ba ni: ri rab gling bzhi gling phran brgyad: stong gsum longs spyod rin chen gter: pho brang rin chen rgyan ldan dang: bla bre 'phan gdugs dar dpyangs dang: rin chen sna bdun las grub pa'i: seng ge glang chen rta mchog khri: nyi zla padmas thugs dam bskang: (360)bkra shis rtags brgyad 'dod yon lnga: 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo dang: glang po blon po dmag dpon rta:

spyan gzigs dkor cha mthun rdzas bcas: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon tshogs: sman gtor rakta dza gad phud: dam rdzas gtor ma rgyan ldan dang: ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas kyi: rgyal chen 'khor bcas= rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang: gos chen gser gyi rgyan ldan dang: sna tshogs dar gyi lhab lhub gos: ber chen bse khrab rin chen khrab: bse rmog gser gyi sprog zhu dang: dbu rgyan mgul rgyan snyan rgyan dang: dpung rgyan phyag gdub do shal dang: rin chen rgyan sna dpag med kyis: rnam sras 'khor bcas= rnga chen mkhar rnga cha lang dung: pi waṃ gling bu sil snyan dang: cang til dril bu ting ting (361) shag: rol mo rnam pa dpag med kyis: bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis: dag par bsnyen bsgrub bzlas dzab dang: glu gar rol mo sna tshogs kyis: thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: nor bu rin chen padma dang: gser dngul mu men mu tig g.yu// khyad par rin chen sna tshogs dang*// rgya phor bse phor rin chen sder: 'dod yon longs spyod rab bkang nas: ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas kyis: thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: dar zab dkor cha longs spyod tshogs: mdung dmar rgyal mtshan lcags kyu dang: nor bu pañtsa pu ra dang: phyag mtshan ne'u le lcags kyu dang: gzhan yang phyag mtshan dpag med kyis: rgyal chen rnam sras thugs dam bskang: seṅge stag gzig dom dang dred: chu srin 'phar ba spyang gcan tshogs: khyung 'brug khu byug rma bya dang: ngang (362)pa ne tso 'dab chags tshogs: rta sngon glang po shang rta drel: ma he g.yag rgod za le 'bri: khyi dmar lug nag ra dmar sogs: dkor nor du mas thugs dam bskang: hūm̐/ rgyal chen rnam sras thugs dam bskang: mdung dmar can gyi= rgyal chen bzhi yi= nor skyong ma yi= nor rgyun ma yi= dzambha la yi= gang ba bzang po'i= nor bu bzang po'i= ku be ra yi= yang dag shes kyi=

nor lha 'brog gnas= gnod sbyin lngas rtsen= pi tsi kunḍa li yi= a pa ra yi= phyugs lha ljang gu'i= zhing lha tshangs pa'i= gzhan yang lha klu gnod sbyin dang: dri za gshin rje la sogs pa'i: ye shes 'jig rten thams cad kyi: nor lha rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: hūm̐/ rgyal po chen po 'khor bcas kyi: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba ni: 'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin (363)pa'i phyir: dri za'i skad gyi gdung dbyangs dang: g.yab dar dmar pos thugs dam bskang: brtan cing mi 'bral 'grog pa'i phyir: mdung dar rgyal mtshan= bzhugs pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: rin chen khri rkang seng khri dang: nyi zla padmas= dgyes pa'i dam rdzas= phyi mchod rnam lngas= mthun pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir: nang gi mchod pas= khyad par dam rdzas= gsang ba'i mchod pas= btung ba'i dam rdzas= dza gad dpa' bos= rgyan gyis dam rdzas yin= rin chen rgyan gyi= bsgrub pa'i dam rdzas= gri rgod snying gis= dam tshig gnyen po bse ba'i= bdud rtsi sman gyis= spyan gyi mchod pa= sna tshogs gzugs kyis= snyan gyi mchod pa= rol mo sgra yis= shangs kyi mchod pa= bdug spos dri yis= ljags kyi mchod pa= 'dod yon ro yis= sku yi mchod pa= 'jol ber bse (364)khrab dar zab dang: sna tshogs reg byas= thugs kyi mchod pa= bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ting 'dzin dang: chos dbyings dag pas= dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba'i= zhal zas tshogs kyis= rtag tu mi 'bral 'grog pa'i= rtag gtor chen pos= rgyun du phrin las bcol ba'i= rgyun gtor nar mas= 'gro ba'i rnam shes 'gugs= gnod sbyin 'bum gyis= longs spyod char ltar 'bebs/ gter bdag chen po'i= mdung dmar can gyis= gnod sbyin rnam sras= thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur cig: bdag gi nyams chag skong gyur cig: hūm̐/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: khyed kyi sku gsung thugs la sogs: yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig dang:

nyams chag 'gal 'khrul mthol lo bshags: hūm̐/ ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs nas: lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog gi: (365)rin chen 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: stong gsum rin chen gter gyi bdag: gling bzhi byang phyogs skyong tsa na: phrin las bzhi la mnga' brnyes shing: iṇḍa ni la'i mdog dang ldan: sa brgyad sems par bzhugs pa po: gnod sbyin pho mo mang po dang: klu yi sde dpon mdzad tsa na: rin chen gser gyi kha dog can: rta ki ma dang klu mo dang: bdud mo'i ded dpon mdzad tsa na: baiḍūr sngon mo'i sku mdog can:

snang srid dbang du bsdu ba dang: 'gro ba'i rnam shes 'gugs pa'i phyir: padma rā ga'i mdog 'dra zhing: mi thung bzhengs pa'i cha lugs can: le brgan dar gyi cod pan can: sku la bse khrab dmar po gsol: dbu la bse rmog rgya zhwa gsol: phyag g.yas mdung dmar rgyal mtshan bsnams: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa (366) dang: srid gsum zil gyis gnon par mdzod: phyag g.yas ne'u le lcags kyu 'dzin: longs spyod char ltar 'beb pa dang: 'gro ba'i rnam dbang du sdud: sku las 'od zer dmar po 'phros: srid pa gsum yang dbang du sdud: 'gro ba mi yi rnam shes 'gugs: yon bdag rnams kyi lag pa khyog: mi snying bsgul la mi 'gram chog: rang dbang med par rnam shes dkrugs : g.yang chen nor dang brjid chen gos: bcud chen zas la sogs pa yi: bdag la zas nor longs spyod kyi: dngos grub ma lus thams cad stsol: 'di ltar bdag gis bskang gsol nas: 'dod pa'i don la gsol 'debs tshe: gang 'dod dngos grub ma stsol na: thugs dam nyams par gdon mi za: de bas thugs dam ma g.yel bar: dbang sdud zas nor longs spyod kyi: bdag la dngos grub rgya chen stsol: nor bdag (367)rgyal po chen po yi: thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i tshe: khyed kyi sprul pa'i rgyal phran rnams: 'gro ba mi yi snying la zhugs: rnam shes khug la dbang du bsdus: 'jig rten khams kyi longs spyod rnams: ma lus thams cad dbang du bsdus: sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol: zhes dang*/ bskang bsdus ni: bhe: 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bde gshegs rin chen mang: ma 'ongs sangs rgyas bcom ldan rin che gdugs: da lta rnam par snang mdzad thugs las sprul: bslu med skyabs kyi dam pa'i thugs dam bskang: grags med gong nas mngon par sangs rgyas kyang: 'gro ba'i don du sa brgyad sems dpa'i tshul: shāka thub bye ba phrag brgya'i bstan pa srung: mgon po ngal bsos po yi thugs dam bskang:

lha yi gnas srung lha min g.yul ngo bzlog: gling bzhi gling phran kun gyi bdag po ste: (368)gter chen bye ba brgya stong mnga' bdag po: gter bdag lus ngan po yi thugs dam bskang: rgya nag ma hā ra dza'i dkor srung mdzad: bod du gru gu rgyal pos khyod mchod pas: bod du gru gu mi dar lha ru dar: dkor bdag gnas srung chen po'i= yab ni dbang phyug yum ni lha mo dpal: gar mkhan mchog dang dzam la ser nag sogs: sras dang sras mo lnga brgya lnga brgya ste: yab yum sras dang bcas pa'i= ma ṭag bzhi dang padma'i gtsug phud ma: gnod sbyin mo brgyad srin mo chen mo brgyad: zas gos nor gyi lha mo mched gsum sogs: gter bdag gnod sbyin mo tshogs= nor lha mched brgyad klu brgyad yum dang bcas: sde dpon nyer brgyad chos spun sum cu gnyis: ljang gnas bcu drug yul skyong lnga brgya'i tshogs: blon po'i tshogs (369)dang bcas pa'i= gnod sbyin 'khor tshogs bye ba bdun 'bum dang: lha klu lha min dri za mo'am ci: gzhan gyi mi thub drag shul stobs ldan pa'i: sde tshan dpung dang bcas pa'i= mgon po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas: gling bzhi ri rab lha mi'i longs spyod tshogs: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid rin chen bdun: blo yis blangs nas yid kyis sprul te 'bul: phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas bskang ba'i rdzas: dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru sna rin po che: dam rdzas dpal gyi gtor chen 'bar ba sogs: mthun pa'i dam rdzas du mas= 'gal 'khrul nyam chag gang mchis 'gyod pas bshags: khyed kyi thugs dam gnyen po bskang gyur nas: bdag sogs 'gro kun bsod nams tshogs rdzogs te: 'dzad med rin chen gter la mnga' brnyes nas: (370)'phags pa mchod dang 'gro ba skyob pa la: bde gshegs rin chen mang dang mnyam par mdzod: bces pa'i bar ci nus dang: dzam la nyer gcig gi bskang gsol yid bzhin nor bu rang gzhung ltar dzam nag bcas gab sprad nas bkra shis 'og bar lan grangs ci nus su btang*/

de nas dam can nor sgrub brkang gso ni: hūm̐/ bdag ni rig 'dzin bsgrub pa po: bdag ni rnal 'byor dgadam tshig can: dam la gnas shing lha la phreng: padma rgyal po'i bka' byung gi: dam chen skyes bu chen po khyed: khyed ni srung ma dam tshig can: 'dir byon bstan pa gnyen po bsrung: dam chen dmag tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: mchod phyir bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol: badzra sa dhu tri hriṃdzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kyaiḥ skyes bu chen po dgongs su gsol: khyed dang mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni: mkhar thabs bshos bu mnyes pas bskang*/ ra yi dbang pos= sha khrag gtor ma= chang phud sman gyi= smyug rgod dar snas= rin chen sna (371)lngas= ra bsur spos kyis= glu dbyangs rol mos= sman dang raktas= phyi nang mchod pas= skyes mchog thugs dam bskang gyur cig: skong btsun yum gyis= sprul pa 'khor gyi= yang sprul pho nyas= dge bsnyen brtan skyong= thugs dam gnyen po des bskang la: sgrub pa po yi bsam pa yid bzhin sgrubs: bsam ngan 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ hūm̐: dam can skyes bu chen po ni: mngon shes rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab: dam tshig can gyi srung ma yin: dam nyams rnams kyi srog gcod yin: bskang ngo dam can thugs dam bskang: sangs rgyas chos kyi srung ma yin: gsang sngags gnyan pa'i bka' srung yin: sgrub pa po yi khol po yin: bskang ngo dam can thugs dam bskang: gtad do gnyer ro dam can thugs dam bskang: bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas (372)rnams: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gar 'gro yang: 'dod pa'i don rnams myur du sgrubs: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: yang gcig phrin las bcol ba ni: sdang byed dgra gegs khyed la gtad: skad cig nyid la rdul du rlog: ltas ngan cho 'phrul sum brgya drug cu thongs: dgra bo mi nor 'khor bcas rnams: ma zad bar du longs spyod kyi:

dam las ma 'das phrin las myur du sgrubs: sgrub pa'i dus kyi rtags ston zhig: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ho dgongs su gsol: ho dgongs su gsol: ho dgongs su gsol: rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi srung ma: rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra bla: sangs rgyas gsang ba dang slob dpon padma'i spyan sngar bstan pa srung ba dang: sgrub pa po skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa: skyes bu chen po rdo rje legs pa yab yum rnams la rgyan gyi gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan (373)pa 'di: ri rab bas 'phang mtho ba: rgya mtsho bas gting zab pa: lha'i bdud rtsi bas bcud che ba: khyod dang mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di 'bul lo: nor bdag dzaṃ la mched brgyad: dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig: bstan ma bcu nyis: nam mkha' la bya zhon brgya dang nyi shu: bar snang la seng zhon brgya dang nyi shu: sa gzhi la ra zhon brgya dang nyi shu: sprul pa yang sprul bka'i lha srin sde brgyad rnams la 'bul lo: skyes bu chen po mthu dang rtsal gyi bdag po khyod la phrin las su bcol ba 'dod don ni bdag cag sgrub pa po rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams spel cig: mi snying sgul zhig/ mi sems g.yos shig: snang ba dbang du bsdus shig: zas nor longs spyod char ltar phob cig: g.yang chen gyi nor skyol zhig: brjid can gyi gos skyol (274)zhig: bcud chen gyi zas skyol zhig: mi nor zas gsum dbang du bsdus shig: 'bru dang zas nor yid 'ong gi rdzas char ltar phob cig: sgrub pa po'i bsam pa yid bzhin du sgrubs shig: dpal dang snyan grags chen po sgrogs zhig: sgrub pa po'i bstan pa nam mkha' la dar bzhin du phyor zhig: gdul bya char ltar phob cig: dkor nor spel zhig: 'khor rnams srungs shig: gnod par byed pa'i dgra gegs sgrol zhig: bstan pa srung la dar zhing rgyas par mdzod cig: nyin gyi bya ra gyis shig: mtshan gyi dus su mel tshe gyis shig:

nad dang dug 'ong na sman mdzod cig: gzhis la 'dug na rgyab brten dang kha 'dzin mdzod cig: byes su 'gro dus dpa' yi dasapung rogs (375)spyod cig: sra ba'i go gyis shig: rno ba'i mtshon gyis shig: bying na slongs shig: brjed na skul zhig: bros na bros sa'i ri bo gyis shig: gab pa'i nag tshal= brtan pa'i mkhar rdzong= chu zam med pa la zam tshugs shig: brag lam med pa la them lam gyis shig: bzang dang sprod cig: ngan phyogs dang bsnol zhig: ci bsam pa ci re ba thams cad bsam pa sgrub shig: phrin las gang brtsam pa ma thogs myur du sgrubs shig: gzhan yang nad dang gnod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig: tshe dang bsod nams snyan grags rgyas par mdzod cig: lha 'dre mi gsum mi nor zas gsum gdul bya snang srid ma lus pa dbang du sdus shig: gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol zhig: mi mthun pa'i phyogs ngan pa dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong (376)thams cad drag pos tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: sgrub pa po'i bsam pa yid bzhin myur du sgrubs shig: bcas dam brdar 'dod gsol bya'o// de nas bshags pa bya ba ni/ kye ma dgongs shig dgongs shig ḍā ki'i tshogs// thog med dus nas da lta'i tshun chod bar// ma sring mkha' 'gro nam brten de'i tshe// dam tshig chags nyams ci mchis mthol lo bshags// sgrub gnas gnas bzang ma brten grong nag bsgrubs// dam rdzas thams cad ma tshang= dus bzang tshogs gtor mar me sbyin sreg chag /rtags mtshan gzhan la bsgrags pa= rtsa rlung ma 'byongs kunda byang sems nyams// tshod min las rgya bsten pa= gnas lugs phyi nang rten 'brel bsgrigs ma shes// bud med spyi la smod pa= rang gi rtsa dang rlung dang byang chub sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gror ma rtogs= gnas grib grogs grib zas gos (377)grib kyis phog gzhan gyi nyams pa bskang ba= rgyud dang rgya gzhung gter chos bsre bslad dkrug

/dbang bzhi khrom chos byas pa= zas nor 'dod phyir snod min gsang sngags bstan// snod dang ldan la ma bstan = rab byung gsang dbang gsum pa dngos su bskur// snyan rgyud yi ger bris pa mthol lo bshags/ zhes mkha' 'gro'i bshags pa dang*/ nor lha'i bshags pa ni/ kyai/ dgongs shig gter bdag nor lha'i tshogs// tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du// brnab sems ser sna rku 'phrog sbyin pa'i gegs// gang dang ci bgyis 'gyod pas so sor bshags// bstan 'gro bla ma'i don du ma dmigs par// rang don gyis mnog sgrub sems= rten sgrub mchod bskang dam rdzas ma 'tshogs par// mchod pa chung zhing ngan pa= rta bong (378)sha dang yug sa'i phyag tshang zas// gas chag snod du zos pa= rta nag bzhon dang zhwa gos nag po gyon// gtor ma bya khyir byin pa= stod g.yogs sngon po lung thang phreng ba med// ro 'jus ro stan bting ba= nang khrol gtor mar brgyan dang gtor snod bshal// dam rdzas gzhan la byin pa= de sogs nor lha spyi dang khyad par gyi// dam tshig gang 'gal thams cad mthol lo bshags/ oṃ badzra sa two sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod/ tshogs drangs ba ni/ rdzas sha chen lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/ ye gdod nas rnam dag bdud rtsi ste/ de ma gtor 'khrul pas gtsang dmair 'dzin// da chos dbyings mnyam nyid a la la ho: zhes phul/ hoḥ spang bya dug lnga'i pha rol nas/ blang bya'i ye shes lnga po med// nged ma bcos lhug pa'i bdud rtsi (379)blangs// don mnyam nyid bde chen e ma hoḥ zhes rol zhing lhag ma bran la/ a ka ros= byin gyis brlab/ gnas chen po nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*// yul chen po sum cu rtsa gnyis na// don dgongs pa sangs rgyas yin mod kyang*// sku cha lugs mdzad pa 'khor ba'i tshul// mdog dkar ser dmar ljang sngo dang smug /rgyan rus pa mgo phreng khrag zhag thig gos mi lpags stag lpags glong chen ko /phyag gri thod kha ṭāṃ ḍa ma ru// sku rlung nag 'tshub cing me dpung 'bar// lam bar snang khams su skar mda' bzhin// yar mtho ris gnas su bltad mo lta// mar ngan song skyid sdug sa ler mthong*// gnas tshogs khang dur khrod gnas brgyad nyul// las 'jig rten bde rdzun shan yang 'byed/

(380)/pho skyes pa kun kyi bla yid khyer/ mo mdzes ma kun kyi bkrag mdangs len// sgom nyams len mkhan gyi drod tshad nyul// chos gsang sngags bstan pa yid la 'chang*// lha dkyil 'khor kun kyi mtha' la gnas// tshogs mchod pa kun kyi lhag ma sdud// bka' snang srid lha 'dre pho nyar 'gyed// gdon stong phrag brgya cu rol du khrid// nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i sa bon 'debs// mi dam nyams rnams la chad pa gcod// zas bstan dgra'i sha khrag dbug la dga'// khyed dga' ba'i lhag gtor bshams nas phul// nga rnal 'byor dga' ba'i phrin las mdzod// rkyen bar chad nad rigs dal kha bzlog /sngon khas blangs bzhin du phrin las mdzod// oṃ u tsiṣṭa ba ling ta kha hī/ zhes lhag ma gtsang sar (381)bskyal bar bya'o// de nas mjug chog la mchod pa ni/ na mo bha ga wa te sogs// mchod pa'i sprin gzungs kyi byin gyis brlobs la/ hūm̐/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyi sku// de bzhin gshegs dang rgyal ba'i sras// dpal gyi lha mo grogs mo brgyad// chos skyong rgyal po chen po bzhi/ srid gsum g.yang bdag 'khor bcas la// 'o ma dang sbyar bdud rtsi'i chu// yan lag brgyad ldan khrus kyi rdzing*// mdangs ldan me tog chun po bstar// spos dkar tsan dan dri bzang 'thul// snang gsal mar me nyi ltar gsal// ga bur gur gum ngad ldan chab// sbrang rtsi bu ram 'bru dkar zas// sna tshogs snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs rnams// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i phyir// gus pas 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ ma hāḥshrī de bi sa pa ri wa re bhyeḥ arghaṃ nas/ shabta pra titstsha swa hā/ (382) rin chen gdugs dang gser nya dang*// gter chen bum pa padma bzang*// dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpal be'u// mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'khor lo sogs// dngos grub= gus pas= aṣḍā mang ga laṃ= phun tshogs 'khor lo rin po che// dri med

btsun mo khyim bdag dang*// cang shes rta dang glang po che// phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i// dmag dpon rin chen sna bdun po// dngos grub= gus pas= sapta ratna= yid 'ong nags tshal ral gri dang*// khang bzang mal cha lha yi gos// sbrul gyi pags pa mchil lh+waṃ sogs// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i phyir// gus pas 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol// u sa sapta ratna= me long gi waṃ ba mchog zho// durba bilba li khri dang*// yungs (383)dkar g.yas 'khyil bkra shis rdzas// dngos grub= gus pas= aṣṭa mang ga laṃ ḍa bhyaḥ= yid 'ong gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra// yid 'dzin dri dang ro brgya'i zas// mjam gnyan 'khril chag reg bya'i mchog /dngos grub = gus pas= pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa= gzhan yang dngos bshams yid las sprul// lha dang mi yi dpal 'byor ni// bde ba'i yo byad ma tshang med// zad med bdud rtsi ci mchis pa// dngos grub= gus pas= sarba pu dza= bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rkang gnyis gtso// dran pas 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel// stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag rdzogs sangs rgyas// sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// shes rab pha rol phyin pa mo// nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin las// sgrub (384)la dngos grub stsol ba'i tshul// dpal gyi lha mo de la bstod// 'gro la dmigs med thugs rje yis// thabs mkhas rang bzhin skur sprul pa// 'khor gyi lha mo'i tshogs rnams la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zab cing rgya che gzigs pa po// yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po// spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras// 'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi// lha yi rgyal po lha min 'joms// mtha' dag bgegs la dbang bsgyur ba// gangs ri'i mdog ltar rab tu dkar// tshogs rje gzi brjid 'bar la bstod// rin chen gter la dbang bsgyur zhing*// rdzu 'phrul che zhing 'od dang ldan// mi mgon dkar po klu yi rgyal// dngos grub kun bdag khyod la bstod// shar phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po che// lha sras rma gnyan (385)spom ra ni/

btsun mo che dang blon 'khor bcas// rma g.yang char bzhin 'beb la bstod// khyed rnams mchod cing bstod pa'i mthus// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// rgyu 'bras dbul ba kun sel zhing*// tshogs gnyis dpal dang ldan par mdzod// mdor na gnas skabs mthar thug gi// mthun rkyen yid la gang bsam pa// 'bad med lhun gyis sgrub pa yi// dngos grub dus 'dir bstsal du gsol//

thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// bskul lo bskul lo thugs dam bskul/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas// dmigs med thugs rje chen po yis// las ngan 'dam du bying ba yi// sems can dbul bas nyen pa rnams// myur du skyob par mdzad du gsol// mchog thun dngos grub char ltar phob// byang chub sems ma dpal (386)chen mo// khyod kyi mtshan gyi rig pa mchog /'chang dang klog pa'i yon tan ni// bden par smra bas bka' bstsal pa'i// bden pa'i 'bras bu mi bslu bar/ sgrub mchog bdag dang yon bdag la// zad mi shes pa'i 'byor pa ni// nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur shog /grogs mo lha mo brgyad dang bcas// sangs rgyas spyan sngar zhal bzhes pa'i// thugs dam gnyen po ma snyel bar// dpal dang skal ba bzang la sogs// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ci mchis pa// bdag dang yon bdag rnams la stsol// mthu ldan rgyal po chen po bzhis// mdo sde 'dzin la srung ba dang*// longs spyod spel bar dam bcas ltar// mdo sde'i dbang por skyabs gsol ba'i// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi// 'byor pa'i bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*// (387)mnga' thang longs spyod 'apel bar mdzod// rgyal ba'i bstan skyong mthu stobs can// srid gsum g.yang gi bdag po rnams// bla ma sangs rgyas yi dam lhas// ji ltar bka' bsgos dran mdzod la// lha klu mi yi snod bcud kyi// bkra shis dge mtshan dwangs ma'i bcud// phywa g.yang dpal 'byor ci mchis pa// gnas 'dir g.yang gi rten la bsdus// steng nas char bzhin 'bebs par mdzod// 'og nas mtsho bzhin skyil bar mdzod// bar nas sprin bzhin gtib par mdzod// 'dod pa'i don kun grub pa yis// bkra shis bde legs bstsal du gsol// zhes bskul bar bya'o// ༈ de nas khu ye bya ba ni// gong du ji ltar smos pa'i 'khor 'das kyi bcud dwangs ma phyag g.yang dpal 'byor thams cad bdag mdun 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rdul lta bus rdo khab len gyis lcags phye blangs pa lta bu ('ub kyis bsdus nas bsgrub bya dang khyad par mdun gyi g.yang rten rnams la sib sib thim par gyur/

gzi byin bskyed/ mda' dar g.yab/ dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do// kye khu ye phywa dang g.yang blan no// g.yang 'gugs g.yang blan gar srid na// sngon tshe bskal pa'i dang po la// sangs rgyas bsod nams stobs chen pos// dus gsum dge ba'i phywa g.yang bsdus// rjes 'jug 'tsho ba'i ched du bsngos// bcud mchog zas g.yang de nas srid// bar du spyan ras gzigs dbang gis// gdong dmar bod la thugs rje bskyed// dpal 'byor chos rgyud mi brgyad 'phel/ rin chen 'bru sna'i gter sgo phyes// mi g.yang nor g.yang de nas srid// de rjes srong btsan sgam po yis// rgya bal nor g.yang bod du blangs// chab srid padma'i mtsho ltar rgyas// dge bcu'i chos (389)kyi lam bzang gtod// dbang thang chos g.yang de nas srid// de 'og bkra shis nor bu'i tshal// brag dmar dpal gyi bsam g.yas su// mkhan slob chos gsum zhal 'dzom ste// dam pa chos kyi sgron me spar// slob dpon chen po'i byin rlabs dang*// chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs bskyed kyis// 'jig rten dpal mgon nor gyi lha// mchod cing brngan nas nor g.yang bsdus// mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khams ma lus pa'i// bde chen dpal 'byor phywa dang g.yang*// thams cad bod ky-i yul du bkug /rgyal po'i mnga' thang dar zhing rgyas// gtsug lag dge 'dun sa gzhi gang*// mnga' bdag chen po'i bsam pa 'grub// g.yang 'gugs g.yang len de nas srid// da lta rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos// sbyin bdag tshe g.yang spel ba'i phyir// bkra shis (390)lha gzhi dkar po bting*// g.yang rten sna tshogs gcal du bkram// g.yang gi lha mo spyan drangs te// ting 'dzin sngags rgya'i gzi byin bskyed// dar dkar g.yab cing g.yang blan na// chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa dang*// lha mo 'khor bcas mthu stobs kyis// 'khor 'das lam gsum dpal 'byor kun/

khu ye phywa dang g.yang du len// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing rnams kyis// ngo mtshar bkod pa rab 'byams dang*// rtsa gsum byin rlabs dngos grub dang*// mthu stobs phrin las g.yang du len// 'chi med grub pa'i sku tshe dang*// rab brtan rdo rje'i bdud rtsi'i bcud// blo ldan mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod dang*// grub pa'i nyams rtogs g.yang du len// 'phags skye'i dge 'dun dar rgyas dang*// mkhas btsun bzang gsum thos bsam bsgom// tshangs dbang (391)'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi// mnga' thang dpal 'byor g.yang du len// steng phyogs lha dang 'og phyogs klu// bar phyogs mi yi 'jig rten gyis// brtan g.yo'i dwangs ma bcu bzhi dang*// snod bcud dge mtshan g.yang du len// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun// dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba// ma rmos lo tog rin chen ri// gter bum bcud rnams g.yang du len// rgya gar chos dang rgya nag khrims// stag gzig nor dang ge sar stobs// hor gyi rtsal dang bod kyi tshe// mtho ris 'byor pa g.yang du len// rnam thos sras kyi dpal 'byor dang*// ku be ra yi rta g.yang dang*// gang ba bzang po'i lug g.yang dang*// 'dzam la'i nor rnams g.yang du len// nor rgyun ma yi phyag g.yang dang*// zhing lha tshangs (392)pa'i 'bru g.yang dang*// mi thub dgra bla'i go mtshon g.yang*// nyi zla'i bkrag mdangs g.yang du len// phyug po'i nor dang btsan po'i stobs// 'phan po'i bu dang dar po'i 'phrul// lhab lhub gos dang bang mdzod 'bru// bcud ldan zas nor g.yang du len// bzugs bzangs dngas snyan blo gros gsal// rang bzhin bzang la dge bcur spyod// tshe ring nad med dbu 'phang mtho// bsod nams dar rgyas g.yang du len// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i g.yang*// 'dod rgu lhun gyis grub pa'i g.yang*// mi nyams rtag tu brtan pa'i g.yang*// bkra shis dpal 'byor dge legs kyi// phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig

/nyi zla bzhin tu shar zhing byon// lho sprin bzhin du 'thibs shing byon// chu chen (393)bzhin tu 'brubs shing byon// sbang char bzhin tu 'babs shing byon// 'thor bsdus la nyams pa gsos// phywa yi nyi ma kyi li li// g.yang gi zla ba ta la la// phywa 'dir la ma bros la// g.yang 'di sgo la ma nyams shig /dza ya dza ya siddhi ho// srid zhi'i dwangs bcud g.yang rten rnams la 'ub kyis bsdus par mos/ ༈ de nas lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi dag snang rig 'dzin srog sgrub las byung ba'i g.yang 'gugs me tog char bsil ni/ hrīḥ chos dbyings khyab brdal yangs pa rgyal ba'i zhing*/ phyogs dus rgyal ba rtsa gsum rig pa 'dzin// mkha' spyod 'ja' 'od 'khrugs pa'i gur khang nas// rig 'dzin bla mas byin rlabs g.yang khug cig 'og min rdo rje dbyings kyi gzhal yas nas/ longs spyod rdzogs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga la// theg dgu'i yi dam (394)lha yis bskor rnams kyis// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub g.yang khug cig /nyi shu rtsa bzhi gnas yul dur khrod nas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong rgya mtsho la// las byed pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba yis// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa'i= stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten zhing khams nas// bstan pa'i bdag po dus gsum rgyal ba dang*// bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'gro ba'i dpal mgon gyis// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i= /srid pa'i lha rabs dge bsnyen gzhi bdag dang*// spar sme lo 'gros bdag po 'byung ba 'di'i// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'i lha rnams kyis// rang rang las la dbang ba'i= phyogs skyong bcu dang 'jigs byed chen po dgu// lha klu gza' dang rgyu skar nyer brgyad lha// gtsang ris dpal mgon chen po bdun cu yis// (395)stobs dang gzi brjid rgyas pa'i g.yang*/ lo dang zla ba zhag dang dus tshod dang*// rten 'brel tshes la dbang ba'i lha rnams dang*// mkhar gyi rtse lha zhing gi tshangs pa yis// 'bru nor longs spyod dpal phun tshe dpal khug

/g.yang gi bdag po arya dzambha la// rgyal chen rnam thos sras dang gnod sbyin rigs// khams gsum dbang sdus dbang phyug chen po yis// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub g.yang= g.yang gi lha mo nor rgyun dpal lha mo// dbyangs can tshe ring ma dang brtan ma'i tshogs// khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i ḍā ki mas// bu nor longs spyod rgyas pa'i g.yang= ngo mtshar lha yi me tog spos sprin dang*// bkra shis rdzas rtags snang srid rol mo'i sgra// bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam yid bzhin nor// srid pa'i ngo mtshar dpal gyi /phun tshogs g.yang ra'i dbus (396)na 'od 'bar zhing*/ g.yang chang tshe ril bdud rtsi dpal gyi bshos// rab 'byams 'ja' gur 'khyil pa'i zer phreng sbrel// stobs phun mnga' thang rgyas pa'i g.yang= g.yang 'dis sgrub gnas kun kyi byin 'od phob// g.yang 'dis tshe dpal nyams pa yar la gsos// g.yang 'dis rgas shing rgud pa mal nas slongs// g.yang 'dis dbul po thams cad nor dang sprod// g.yang 'dis 'on long zha bo'i dbang po ston// g.yang 'dis cha che nyam nga phyir la sgyur// g.yang 'dis pho brang dbus su byin 'od phob// g.yang 'dis khams su srid gsum dbang du sdus/ g.yang 'dis 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid sprod// g.yang 'dis mthu rtsal nus pa med ltar sbor// g.yang 'dis 'khor dang longs spyod rgyas su chug /g.yang 'dis pha rol rtsod las rgyal bar mdzod// g.yang 'dis bdag (397)cag dpon slob mthun zhing 'grog /g.yang 'dis nyams chang 'gal 'khrul zhig pa gsos// g.yang 'dis grib dang mi gtsang g.yeng las skyobs// g.yang 'dis sde brgyad 'byung po'i srung 'khor mdzod// g.yang 'dis dngos grub phar ba thams cad khug /g.yang 'dis snyan dang grags pas sa steng khyab// g.yang 'dis ngo mtshar brug sgra rtag tu sgrogs/ g.yang 'dis byas tshad chos su 'gro bar mdzod// g.yang 'dis rigs dang chos kyi brgyud pa spel// g.yang 'dis sde 'di mi g.yo brton par mdzod// g.yang 'dis rang byung rig pa ma dang sprod// g.yang 'dis 'khor 'das gzhi zad sa la skyol// g.yang 'dis tshe gcig rdzogs sangs rgyas par mdzod// g.yang 'dis khams gsum 'khor ba dang nas sprugs// g.yang 'dis 'gro kun phyir mi ldog par mdzod/(398)/g.yang 'dis 'brel tshad padma 'od du skyol//

zhes brjod/ ༈ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi rin chen mkha' 'gro'i nor sgrub skabs nas byung ba'i g.yang 'gugs ni/ hū ྃhri: rig 'dzin bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// mkha' 'gro nor lha rab 'byams tshogs rnams kun// rtse gcig mos pa'i gdung bas rgyud bskul na// ye shes mchog gi thugs rje dus la bab// rgyas par 'og gi 'chi med tshe yi sogs re re bzhin sbyar/ hūm̐: rin chen bde gshegs nor lha rab 'byams kyis: dbus phyogs 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud dang: phyag g.yang longs spyod 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor rnams: bar snang khams kyi char bzhin gnas 'dir phob: hūm̐: rin chen rdo rje'i nor lha rab 'byams kyis: shar phyogs 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud dang: phywa g.yang longs spyod 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor rnams: nyi zla bzhin du gnas 'dir 'char bar mdzod: hūm̐: rin chen 'dod 'byung nor lha rab 'byams kyis: lho phyogs (399)'khor 'das= phywa g.yang= sprin phung bzhin du gnas 'dir gtib par mdzod: hūm̐: rin chen padma'i nor lha rab 'byams kyis: nub phyogs 'khor 'das = phywa g.yang= chu bo bzhin du gnas 'dir 'dus par mdzod: hūm̐: rin chen las kyi nor lha rab 'byams kyis: byang phyogs 'khor 'das= phywa g.yang= skyi ser bzhin du gnas 'dir 'dril bar mdzod: hūm̐: rin chen dam tshig nor lha rab 'byams kyi: mtshams bzhi'i 'khor 'das= phywa g.yang= bar snang rlung bzhin gnas 'dir g.yo bar mdzod: hūm̐: rin chen pho nya'i nor lha rab 'byams kyis: 'og phyogs 'khor 'das= phywa g.yang= lo tog bzhin du gnas 'dir smin par mdzod: ༈ 'chi med tshe yi phywa g.yang longs spyod khug: rgas med stobs kyi phya g.yang longs spyod khug: nad med rtsal gyi phya g.yang longs spyod khug: bcud (400)chen zas kyi= brjid ldan gos gyi= dpal chen nor gyi= bang mdzod 'bru yi= rta phyugs rkang bzhi'i=

go mtshon dbyig gi= rigs brgyud 'khor slob= snyan grags nus mthu'i= bsod nams dpal gyi= dbang thang rlung rta'i= 'dod rgu'i 'byor pa'i= ye shes chen po'i= phywa khug g.yang skyobs thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrī: g.yang khang bkra shis pho brang nyams re dga': g.yang rdzas 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor brjid re che: g.yang rten nor bu'i ba gam bkod re legs: g.yang bshos nyi zla nor bu bkrag mdangs che: 'jig rten snod bcud srid pa'i phywa dang g.yang: rab 'byams dag pa'i zhing gi dpal dang 'byor: 'khor 'das kun kyi bcud dang dwangs bcud kun: sgrub pa'i rdzas mchog 'di la dbyer med bstim: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor rgyud la byin chen phob: grub (401)pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma myur du phyungs: 'dod rgu'i dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob: mchog thun bkra shis bde legs bstsal du gsol: zhes dang*/ ༈ 'ja' tshon ma ning rgyas pa'i las tshogs las byung ba'i g.yang 'gugs ni/ hūm̐ hrī: gu ru padma'i sku las 'od 'phros pas// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i lha rnams dbang du bsdus: rin chen mkha' 'gros ye shes dbang du bsdus: padma mkha' 'gros klu rnams= las kyi mkha' 'gros mi rnams= sna tshogs mkha' 'gros lha mi= ma tshogs shugs 'gros skyes 'gro dbang du bsdus: phying gsang ba'i phywa g.yang 'dir byon cig: hūm̐: rnam thos sras dang dzaṃ la nor rgyun ma: dus gsum bde gshegs dkon mchog yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can gzhi bdag sogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rab 'byams thams cad kyi: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad phywa g.yang 'dir khug cig: hūm̐/ bdag mdun lha tshogs thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: steng 'og (402)bar gsum lha klu mi rnams kyi: longs spyod mnga' thang snyan grags mi nor rdzas: dar dkar g.yab cing klad nas spyan 'dren na: thogs pa med par phywa g.yang 'dir khug cig: hūm̐: gu ru'i rnam 'phrul mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs:

sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul bsam mi khyab: jo bo dkon mchog gsum po'i byin rlabs dang: rig 'dzin grub thob rnams kyi thugs rje dang: zhi rgyas dbang drag phywa g.yang 'dir khug cig: hūm̐: shar kyi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang: nyi zla bzhin du shar zhing byon: lho yi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang: lho sprin bzhin du 'thib shing byon: nub kyi phyogs nas= chu bo bzhin du 'bab cing byon: byang gi phyogs nas: skyi ser bzhin du 'gril zhing byon: steng gi phyogs nas= sbrang char bzhin du 'bab cing byon: 'og gi phyogs nas= lo tog (403)bzhin du smin zhing byon: khu ye puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swa hā: hūm̐: 'jam

dpal gzhon nu'i shes rab dang: spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje dang: phyag na rdo rje'i mthu stobs dang: dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs kyis: phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig: sangs rgyas steng rtsa'i byin rlabs kyis: phywa g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig: dam pa rigs brgya'i byin rlabs kyis: phywa g.yang= gnas rten bcu drug byin= phywa g.yang= nye ba'i sras brgyad= phywa= thub pa drug gi byin= phywa= rgyal ba rigs lnga'i= phywa g.yang= rigs gsum mgon po'i byin= phywa g.yang= rta phag yab yum= phywa= rang byung padma'i= phywa= srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas: na raka duḥkha yan ched kyi: phywa= mdor na gling bzhi gling phran dang: rgya gar rgya nag hor dang 'jang: bal yul ting se mdo khams kyi: (404)phywa= dar po'i dar g.yang 'dir khug cig: phyug po'i phyug g.yang 'dir khug= btsan po'i btsan= gnyan po'iganyan= ri bo'i rtse nas phywa g.yang khug: rgya mtsho'i gting nas phywa g.yang khug: mi nor longs spyod phya g.yang= rta phyugs spu nag= phya= lo tog 'bras drug= da lta myur du 'dir 'dus shig: myur ba nyid du 'dir bsdus shig: gnas khang 'di la byin phob cig: g.yang rdzas 'di la bcud phob cig: mda' dar 'di la 'od zug cig: bkra shis byin chags 'dir 'dus shig: ces so// ༈ dam chos bde chen lam mchog las/ g.yang 'bod dpal g.yang nor mdzod bzhugs so: hrī:bhrum̐: dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: grangs med gsum du bsod nams dang: ye shes tshogs chen bsags pa'i mthus: srid dang zhi ba'i dpal yon thob: sangs rgyas dkon mchog bden stobs g.yang: (405)skal ldan bdag la srung byar stsol: rgyal bstan lung dang rtogs pa'i chos: de las mdo rgyud bka' gter dang: bstan chos man ngag thams cad kyi: dpal yon stobs dang nus mthu'i g.yang: skal ldan bdag dang srung byar stsol: nye sras brgyad sogs 'phags pa dang: mchog zung la sogs nyan thos rigs: bse ru dang ni ne tso lta'i:

rang rgyal rtena'abrel bden mthong sogs: rim dgu theg pa'i dge 'dun sde'i: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpal thob g.yang: skal ldan bdag dang srung byar stsol: dgu ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs g.yang: yi dam lha tshogs dngos grub g.yang: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i dga' bde'i g.yang: dam can rgya mtsho'i mthu nus g.yang: skal ldan bdag dang srung byar stsol: kyai: steng phyogs 'chi med lha yi g.yang: 'og phyogs sa bdag klu (406)gnyan g.yang: bcu nyis gling gi mi nor g.yang: dpal mgon bdun cu'i mnga' thang g.yang: kyai rgya gar rgyal po'i chos kyi g.yang: rgya nag rgyal po'i khrimasakyi g.yang: ge sar rgyal po'i dmag gi g.yang: mi dpa' rta mgyogs mthon po'i g.yang: gser dngul gos dar rdzas kyi g.yang: rta nor lug sogs phyugs kyi g.yang: bza' btung 'dod rgu'i phun tshogs g.yang: skal ldan = kyai: don kun grub pa la sogs pa'i= mchog gsum brgyud 'dzin ban gyi g.yang: ston pa bshen rab la sogs pa'i: g.yu drung brgyud 'dzin bon gyi g.yang: gdong bzhi mgrin sngon tha gu'i lto: 'dren byed stong ldan la sogs pa/ phyi pa'i ston dang bstan pa'i g.yang: skal ldan= kyai: sku gsum rgyal ba'i mkha' dbyings nas: thugs rje'i dpal yon sprin phung las: phywa g.yang dngos grub char gyi(407)rgyun: bdag sogs 'gro la babs nas kyang: phun tshogs lo tog dar rgyas mdzod: nam mkha'i dbyings las kha char bzhin: phywa g.yang dngos grub myur du stsol: bar snang khams nas na bun bzhin: phya g.yang dngos grub myur du stsol: sa gzhi'i khams nas sa rlang bzhin: phya g.yang dngos grub myur du stsol: brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten g.yang: g.yo ba bcud kyi tshe bsod stobs: mchog dman 'gro ba'i dpal g.yang bcud: 'dir bsdus 'dir khug dngos grub stsol: bkra shis dbyar rnga'i sgra dbyangs kyi: sbyin bdag rma bya yongs tshim shog: g.yang 'bod dpal g.yang nor mdzod 'di: rnal 'byor bstan pa dar rgyas kyis:

bskul ngor kun bzang gzhan phan zhes: byang chub sems kyis blo ldan des: smras bzhin yi ger 'bebs po: arma de was bgyis pa des: phan bde nor bu'i mchog thob shog: dge'o// ༈ gar dbang las rab rtsal gyis gter byon thugs sgrub yon tan (408)kun 'byung gi g.yang 'gugs khol phyung ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings khyab brdal bde chen zhing khams su: spros mtshan bral ba'i rnam dag lha yi lha: kun bzang snang mtha' rdo rje 'chang chen sogs: brgyud gsum rtsa rgyud bla ma'i g.yang 'gug go: ma 'gags rang gsal longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing: phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten ye shes lnga rdzogs nas: rgyal ba rigs lnga la sogs lha tshogs kyi: thugs rje phyogs ris med pa'i g.yang 'gug go: ngo bo rang bzhin gsal ba'i zhing khams nas: klong yangs ma 'gags rol pa chen po'i rtsal: pad 'byung rig 'dzin grub pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs: byin rlabs thugs rje'i phya dang g.yang 'gug go skye med ngang las skye ba'i tshul bstan cing: thugs rje thabs mkhas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: gnas yul zhing gi yon tan ḍa ki'i tshogs: snod bcud srid zhi'i khams kyi g.yang 'gug go: rnam dag zhing khams dzam bu'i gling (409)mchog tu: bde bar gshegs pa 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing: shakya'i rgyal dang sangs rgyas stong gi tshogs: thugs bskyed mthu stobs ye shes g.yang 'gug go: bde gshegs gsung las sprul pa'i yi ger byon: rgyud sde bzhi drug theg pa rim pa dgu: nyon mongs 'jom mdzad dam chos brgyad khri'i tshogs: dgos 'dod re ba skong ba'i g.yang 'gug go: chos srid dpal 'byor 'du ba 'phags pa'i tshogs: byang sems nyan rang theg pa che chung dang: dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i byin gyis rlabs: chos srid bstan pa rgyas pa'i g.yang 'gug go: thugs nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: bstan pa srung phyir drag pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das srung ma'i tshogs:

dgra gegs bar chad srung ba'i g.yang 'gug go: hūm̐: dbus phyogs bde chen chos dbyings yangs pa'i klong: (410)rnam par snang mdzad mgon po dzam bha la: dbus phyogs zhing gi phywa dang g.yang khug la: longs spyod dga' skyid 'dzom pa 'dir stsol cig: shar phyogs dkar gsal padma'i khri'i steng du: mi skyod rdo rje nor bdag dzam la dkar: shar phyogs zhing gi phywa dang g.yang khug la: na gdon sdig sgrib zhi ba'i g.yang 'gug go: lho phyogs ser gsal padma'i khri'i steng du: rin chen 'byung gnas nor bdag dzam la ser: lho phyogs zhing gi= tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i g.yang= nub phyogs dmar gsal padma'i khri'i steng du: snang ba mtha' yas nor bdag dzam la dmar: nub phyogs zhing gi= khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i= byang phyogs ljang gsal padma'i khri'i steng du: don yod grub pa nor bdag dzam la nas: byang phyogs zhing gi= mthu stobs glog ltar myur ba'i g.yang 'gug go: spro na 'og gis (411)deng 'dir bdag sogs re re bzhin sbyar ro// hūm̐: dkyil 'khor bar khyams nor lha gter bdag tshogs: kun kyang mthu stobs gzi byin ya la la: steng gi phyogs nas lha yi mthu stobs dang: tshe dpal gzi brjid ldan pa'i g.yang khug cig: bar gyi phyogs nas mi yi kha rje dang: longs spyod nor dang rigs rgyud g.yang khug cig: 'og gi phyogs na klu yi nor bu dang: dgos 'dod re ba skong ba'i g.yang khug cig hūm̐: dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po chen po bzhi: shar phyogs sgo skyong rgyal chen yul 'khor srung: lus 'phags po yi srid bcud 'dir= dri za'i lag nas phya dang g.yang 'gug go: lho phyogs sgo skyong rgyal po 'phags skyes po: 'dzam bu gling gi srid bcud 'dir= gshin rje'i lag nas phya dang g.yang: nub phyogs sgo (412)skyong rgyal chen spyan mi bzang: ba glang spyod kyi srid bcud 'dir= klu dbang lag nas phya dang g.yang=

byang phyogs sgo skyong rgyal chen rnam thos sras: sgra mi snyan kyi srid bcud 'dir= gnod sbyin lag nas phywa dang g.yang= hūm̐: dkyil 'khor phyi rim nor lha bye ba'i tshogs: lha klu gza' skar spar sme lo zla zhag: gzhan yang 'jig rten srid pa'i lha tshogs rnams= deng 'dir bdag dang yon kyi bdag po la: mi nor zas gsum 'dzom pa'i g.yang khug cig: longs spyod snyan dang grags pa'i g.yang khug cig: bu nor rigs rgyud 'phel ba'i= chos srid bstan pa rgyas pa'i= rtsa rlung nyams rtogs 'phel ba'i= tshe ring nad med bde ba'i= rta nor phyugs lug 'phel ba'i= ci bsam 'dod don grub pa'i= phya g.yang char tshub bzhin du 'u ru ru: longs (413)spyod sbrang char bzhin du sha ra ra: gnas 'dir mtsho mo bzhin du me re re: longs spyod dga' skyid 'dzom pa 'dir stsol cig: ces brjod/ ༈ rig 'dzin smon lam rdo rje'i gter byon bla ma rtsa gsum kun 'dus kyi padma rgyal po'i sgrub thabs las byung ba'i tshe g.yang 'gugs pa ni: hrī: lhun grub thugs rje'i dpal ster mdzod: 'od gsal rab byams nam mkha'i klong: rgyal ba rig 'dzin tshe yi mgon: thugs rjes bdag la dgongs su gsol: hūm̐: rig 'dzin tshe la mnga' brnyes pa: skye med mi zad nam mkha'i khams: snang stong skye shi med pa'i zhing: 'byung ba rgud pas dbugs tshe nyams: nam mkha'i ngang nas tshe khug cig: sa la gnas pa sa yi bcud: sha yi khams kyi bkrag nyams na: 'byung ba sa yi bcud bsdus la: sha yi khams nyams sos gyur cig: rgya mtsho chen po chu yi bcud: khrag gi khams nyams bcud(414)shor na: yan lag brgyad ldan ye shes bcud: chu yi khams nas tshe g.yang sdus: khrag gi khams nyams sos gyur cig: 'bar ba ye shes me'i 'khor lo: drod kyi khams nyams stobs shor na: nyi ma'i 'od zer ye shes bcud: drod kyi khams nyams sos gyur cig: khyab byed g.yo ba rlung gi bcud:

dbugs kyi khams nyams tshe gud na: g.yo ba rlung gi bcud sdus la: dbugs tshe nyams pa sos gyur cig: snang srid snod bcud dpal gyi g.yang: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i thugs rje sdus: tshe khug lo brgya thub pa dang: g.yang shog bang mdzod nor gyis khengs: ci bsam lhun gyis 'grub gyur cig: hūm̐: nor bdag 'dzam gling gter gyi bdag: gling bzhi dbang bsgyur rgyal po che: lha dbang mi dbang klu dbang rgyal: 'dod pa'i dpal la mnga' dbang can: khyed rnams thugs rje deng 'dir (415)bskyed: bdag dang yon sbyor mched lcam la: lha yi tshe dang mi yi nor: klu nor rin chen phywa g.yang khug: zad pa med pa 'dod rgu'i gter: bkres skom med pa longs spyod che: nor g.yang zas g.yang deng 'dir khug: nor bu rang bzhin dgos 'byung dpal: tshe dang dpal la mnga' yang brnyes: dkyil 'khor 'di la phywa zhig phob: gnas khang 'di ru g.yang zhig khug: bdag cag ci bsam dngos grub rnams: rtsa gsum lha yis byin rlabs kyis: nor lha gnod sbyin dngos grub stsol: ma ma skyed skyed nṛ bhrum̐: phywa khu ye: g.yang khu ye: a yu badzra ho: zhes brjod/ ༈ kong sprul rin po che'i dgongs gter tshig bdun bla sgrub kyi sgrub thabs padma rgyas pa'i gu ru nor lha'i skabs nas byung ba'i g.yang 'gugs ni: hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge= ya mtshan= padma 'byung= 'khor du= khyed kyi= byin gyis= gu ru nor lha'i rnam par byon: ratna gter gyi dbang mchog skur: dbul phongs bkres skom sdug bsngal sol: dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: hri: gu ru padma nor gyi lha: 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas yid bzhin nor: gnod gnas dbang pa'i 'khor dang bcas: thugs dam gnyen po des skul na: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: mthu stobs dzu 'phrul shugs skyed la: snor bcud rgud pa sel ba dang: dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod:

phyi snod 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i: dwangs bcud mthu stobs phywa g.yang khug: nang bcud skye 'gro lha klu mi'i: tshe bsod dbang thang phywa g.yang khug: gsang ba rtsa gsum nor lha yi: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i phywa g.yang khug: rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas: srid zhi'i dge mtshan ma lus pa'i/ phywa yi dpal dang dbyangs kyi bcud: thogs pa med pa gnas 'dir bsdus: (416)sgrub rten rdzas la dbyer med bstim: nyams rgud med pa'i phyag rgyas thob: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la: tshe bsod nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rgyas: dpal 'byor rgya mtsho 'dzad med 'khyil: dbu 'phang dgung ltar mtho ba dang: dbang thang lhun po ltar brtan pa'i: bkra shis dge legs 'phel rgyas mdzod: ces so/ ༈ dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi g.yang 'gugs su grags pa ni/ hrī: mdangs ldan lhun grub 'od zer thig le'i dbus: rnam kun rgyal ba sras bcas rig 'dzin tshogs: rtsa gsum lha tshogs rig 'dzin 'gro 'dul dang: sgyu 'phrul nor lha'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams tshogs: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma: mda' dar sna tshogs dar kyi cod pan gyis: sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang: lha klu gnod sbyin mi yi nor bu sogs: phyi snod 'jig rten srid pa'i bcud kun sdus: tshangs pa brgya byin dri za klu dbang (418)lha: stobs dpal phun tshogs mi yi tshe srog mdangs: nang bcud skye 'gro ma lus thams cad kyi: dpal 'byor phun tshogs g.yangagi bcud sdus shig: gsang ba phyogs dus rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi: sku gsung thugs dang mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rtsal: phyag mtshan 'od zer sna tshogs sku yig 'char: dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang dang 'dir 'dus pa'i: mched lcam sgrub pa po la byin chen phob: mi shigs rdo rje'i tshe dang phun tshogs dpal: mchog thun dpon slob 'bral med dngos grub stsol: khyad par dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung tshogs:

zhing dang phyogs skyong dpal mgon bdun cu lnga: sde dpon sum cu mi bzad dregs pa'i tshogs: skyong ba'i srung ma kun gyi g.yang khug cig: g.yang bcud 'od dang thig le me re re: bar snang sku dang gsung gi dkyil 'khor 'khrigs: bde drod nyams dang rtogs pa'i rig pa bun: zag bcas 'ja' skur zhig pa'i snang bzhi (419)bgrod: gsang gsum rig par smin pa'i rdo rje'i spun: thogs med mkha' la spyod pa'i dngos grub stsol: dus gsum dbyings su dag pa'i dus gcig klong: 'pho 'gyur skye 'gags med pa'i g.yang 'khyil shog: ces so/ ༈ mchog gling gter byon thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las/ nor sgrub rin chen bum bzang gi g.yang 'gugs ni/ hūm̐ hrī: 'od gsal spros dang bral ba'i ye shes las: srid dang zhi ba'i zhing khams longs spyod dang: 'dod rgu 'byor ba'i dngos por snang ba kun: thams cad lhun gyi grub pa'i pho brang che: phyi ltar bkra shis gter gyi bum bzang la: nangaltar ye shes rol pa'i gzhal med khang: gsang ba rtsa gsum nor lha'i dkyil 'khor du: dgyes bzhin bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs rab 'byams kun: rnal 'byor mos pa'i gdung bas gsol 'debs shing: sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes rgyud bskul na: mkhyen brtse ye shes rgyas pa'i klong (420)yangs nas: 'dod rgu'i dngos grub char bzhin dbab tu gsol: sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rmad po che: srid zhi'i dpal gyis 'byor pa'i byin chen phob: glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rje'i nus stobs kyis: 'khor 'das kun gyi phya g.yang gnas 'dir sdus: lha dang sgrub rdzas dbyer med rten la bstim: bkra shis longs spyod rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: dpag med mchog thun dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: sprin ltar gtibs pa'i rtsa gsum nor lha'i tshogs: gang 'dul skur ston sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes: rab 'byams nor lha 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lhar:

phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub stsol: 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i khams kun kyi: legs pa'i dpal dang phya g.yang longs spyod kun: dar dkar g.yab cing klang nas spyan 'dren na: thogs pa med par bkra shis gnas 'di ru: 'dod rgu yid bzhin 'byor pa'i dngos grub stsol: (421)hūm̐ hrīḥ dkyil 'khor rab 'byams lha tshogs thams cad kyi: ye shes gzi byin thugs rje nus stobs skyed: gnod sbyin nor lha gter bdag bye ba'i tshogs: zhal bzhes dam tshig gnyen po rjes su dgongs: lha klu gza' skar sa bdag brtan ma'i tshogs: las kyi rdzu 'phrul myur mgyogs glog ltar 'khyug: bod skyong gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs: rdo rje'i tha tshig ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: de ring bkra shis dge ba'i gnas 'di ru: phya g.yang 'dod rgu'i dngos grub char ltar phob: rab 'byams rigs lnga sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i zhing: mi zad longs spyod rgyan gyi phywa g.yang khug: stong gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi: snod bcud dpal gyi 'byor pa'i phya g.yang khug: sa chu me rlung 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i: dwangs ma gzi brjid nus pa'i= 'jig rten mngon par mtho ba'i dpung rnams kyi: tshe dang blo gros stobs (422)rtsal phywa= nyan rang 'phags dang po skye'i tshogs rnams kyi: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes phywa= shar phyogs dri za'i yul gyi lang tsho dang: rgya nag btsan brjid khrims kyi phywa= lho phyogs grul bum dbyangs kyi snyan 'gyur dang: rgya gar dam pa'i chos kyi= nub phyogs klu dbang nor bu'i dbang mdzod dang: ta zig nor gyi 'byor pa'i phywa= byang phyogs gnod sbyin gter gyi nabum bzang dang: ge sar dpa' rtsal ldan pa'i= tshe ring nad med dge ba'i= dbul phongs sdug bsngal zhi ba'i= 'bru nor longs spyod rgyas pa'i= rta phyugs rkang 'gro'i 'phel gyi= bza' btung gos rgyan 'byor pa'i=

khams gsum dbang du 'dus pa'i= srid gsum zil gyis non pa'i phywa= snyan grags stong gsum khyab pa'i= chos rgyud chu ltar ring ba'i= mi rgyud chad pa med pa'i= log 'dren dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i= nyin mtshan (423)bkra shis bde legs= phywa khug g.yang skyobs dngos grub gnas 'dir stsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: khu ye puṣṭi ku ru ye sarba siddhi pha la bhrum̐:

ces dang*/ ༈ yang mchog gling thugs rje chen po padma sgyu 'phrul drwaba'i las tshogs las byung ba'i g.yang 'gugs ni/ hūm̐: chos rnamasarnam dag bde ba can gyi zhing: gnas khang lhun grub ye shes gzhal yas khang: rang rtsal skye 'gro pho mo lha lha mo: nor lha mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rnam par gnas: kun kyang 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i ngang: de ring bkra shis dge ba'i gnas 'di ru: phun tshogs pa'i dpal 'byor lhun gyis grub: ngo mtshar gnas mchog 'di nyid nyams re dga': rin chen gzhal yas 'di ni byin re che: gu ru rtsa gsum rnam sras dzaṃ bha la: nor lha pho mo mched lcam yon mchod rnams: 'dod rgu'i longs spyod bsod nams dpal gyi g.yang: (424)rang byung ye shes cho 'phrul bsam mi khyab: bde ba chen po'i rtsal las cir snang yang: dam rdzas mchod sprin thams cad bcud dang ldan: 'dod rgulhun gyi grub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: bsod nams mtha' yas sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin: ye shes las grub nor lha rgya mtsho yis: dpal 'byor lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos kyi dbyings las thugs rje'i skur sprul pa: bla ma rtsa gsum nor lha rgya mtsho dang: sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag med kyis: thugs rje byin rlabs bsam mi khyab pa yis: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i mkhyen rtse ye shes dpal: drang srong rig pa 'dzin pa'i mthu stobs dang: nyan thos byang sems bslab pa'i shes rab dang: tshangs pa brgya byin 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs: longs spyod rgya chen gnod sbyin rnams kyi dpon: nor gyi bdag po klu yi rgyal po dang: 'khor los bsgyur rgyal bsod nams mnga' thang can: (425)ma lus kun kyi tshe bsod 'byor pa dang: dbang thang stobs rtsal dpal g.yang gnas 'dir khug: shar phyogs rgya nag lho phyogs rgya gar yul: nub phyogs ta zig byang phyogs ge sar dang: dpal g.yang ldan pa'i yul khams thams cad nas:

'bru nor longs spyod thams cad dbang du sdus: thos bsam sgom gsum shes rab dpal g.yang khug: bsod nams dbang thang rgyas pa'i dpal g.yang khug: stobs rtsal snyan grags 'phel ba'i= rigs rgyud chos rgyud 'phel ba'i dpal= 'bru dang rkang 'gro 'phel= bza' btung gos rgyan bzang po'i= gser dngul rin chen 'phel ba'i= dar zab mtha' gru'i nor gyi= go khrab 'khar rdzong btsan pa'i= bsnyen bskur kun gyis byams pa'i= nad med lang tsho dar ba'i= che btsan gzhan dpung 'joms pa'i= sa bcud rtsi bcud rgyas pa'i= lo tog (426)'bras drug rgyas pa'i= 'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub pa'i= dpal ldan g.yang gi dngos grub gnas 'dir sdus: bsod nams dge legs rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: ces so/ ༈ chos rgyal rdo rje'i dzam dkar g.yang 'gugs ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas: sdug bsngal sgra yang mi grags pa'i: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i g.yang: tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol: thugs rje gzigs shig tshe dpag med: po ta la yi zhing khams nas: nyon mongs dug lnga'i ming yang med: thugs rje phun sum tshogs pa'i g.yang: mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsol: brtse bas gzigs shig spyan ras gzigs: padma 'od kyi zhing khams su: sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i ming yang med: 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin g.yang: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol: byin gyis rlobs shig padma 'byung: mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su: (427)zhe sdang 'khrul pa'i ming yang med: dga' bde phun sum tshogs pa'i g.yang: me long ye shes dngos grub stsol: byin gyis rlobs shig rdo rje sems: dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams su: nga rgyal 'khrul pa'i ming yang med: dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing: mnyam nyid ye shes dngos grub stsol: byin gyis rlobs shig rin chen 'byung: bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: 'dod chags 'khrul ba'i ming yang med: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i g.yang:
