sor rtog ye shes dngos grub stsol: byin gyis rlobs shig snang mtha' yas: las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams su: phrag dog ngar 'dzin ming yang med: mdzad phrin phun sum tshogs pa'i g.yang: bya grub ye shes dngos grub gtsol: byin gyis rlobs shig don yod grub: 'og min chos dbyings zhing khams su: gti mug 'khrul pa'i ming yang med: phun tshogs (428)lnga dang ldan pa'i g.yang: chos dbyings ye shes dngos grub stsol: byin gyis rlobs shig rnam snang mdzad: khams lnga dag pa'i yum chen lngas: 'byung lnga'i bcud dang tshe g.yang stsol: o rgyan sprul ba'i zhing khams nas: ye shes mtsho rgyal ḍā ki'i tshogs: gsang sngags zab mo'i chos kyi g.yang: tshe gcig sangs rgyas dngos grub stsol: bde stong rtsal 'byongs dngos grub stsol: snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du: bka' rgyud bla ma'i lha tshogs kyis: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi g.yang: tshe gcig sangs rgyas dngos grub stsol: rang snang dag pa'i gzhal yas nas: yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyis: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub g.yang: don gnyis mthar phyin dngos grub stsol: nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas: dpa' bo ḍā ki rgya mtsho dang: gsang ba sngags kyi byin rlabs g.yang: rang bzhin smin grol dngos= gar bzhugs chos kyi pho brang nas: bka' bab (429)chos bdag mched grogs spun: bskyed rdzogs lha sngags zung 'jug g.yang: mdzad phrin gong 'phel= gang 'dul sprul pa'i pho brang nas: chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral rnams: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa'i g.yang: mngon spyod nus mthu'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrīḥ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: nor bdag arya dzam bha la: snying rjes 'gro ba'i don kun mdzad: tshe bsod zas nor g.yang gi bdag: 'khor dang yang 'khor bcas pa rnams: sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel bar: 'gro la thugs brtsis rjes dgongs la: tshe g.yang thams cad 'dir stsol cig: rkang bzhi phyugs kyi g.yang stsol cig:

myur zhing mgyogs pa rta yi g.yang: 'dod rgu 'byung ba nor gyi g.yang: 'dod 'jo ba dang glang gi g.yang: theg cher khur ba dre'u'i g.yang: 'phel (430)stobs ldan pa lug gi g.yang: phyugs kyi grangs tshan ra yi g.yang: nor gyi bzang btsan mdzo yi g.yang: thams cad 'di ru g.yang du len: mdzes shing yid 'ong dar zab g.yang: rin thang che ba gser dngul g.yang: sa bcud 'bras drug 'bru yi g.yang: rin chen nor dbyig rgyan gyi g.yang: ro brgya ldan pa bza' btung g.yang: thams cad 'di ru g.yang du len: steng phyogs tshangs pa lha yi g.yang: bar phyogs lha srin gnyan gyi g.yang: 'og phyogs klu g.yang yid bzhin nor: thams cad 'di ru= lus 'phags po yi gzugs bzang g.yang: 'dzam bu gling gi dam chos= ba lang spyod kyi dkor nor g.yang: sgra mi snyan gyi tshe ring= gling bzhi gling phran skye 'gro yi: tshe bsod dbang thang g.yang du len: rgya gar rgyal po'i chos srid g.yang: rgya nag rgyal po'i mnga' thang g.yang: ta zig rgyal po'i nor g.yang dang: ge (431)sar rgyal po'i dmag g.yang dang: dbu dkar rgyal po'i dpa' g.yang rnams: thams cad 'di ru g.yang du lenaḥ mtho ba dgung gi mtho g.yang dang: dma' ba sa yi brtan g.yang dang: mi nor zas gos phun tshogs g.yang: bkrag dang gzi mdangs longs spyod g.yang: go mtshon dpa' rtsal rdzu 'phrul= sde snod 'dzin pa rab byung= dpa' rtsal stobs shugs bu tsha'i= mdzes btsun 'dzom pa mo btsun= tshe rig ldan pa srid kyi= thams cad 'di ru g.yang du len: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe g.yang rnams: nyi zla bzhin du shar zhing byon: lho yi phyogs nas tshe= lho sprin bzhin du 'tshubs shing byon: nub kyi phyogs nas tshe= na bun bzhin du 'thibs shing byon: byang gi phyogs nas tshe= chu bo bzhin du 'bab cing byon= steng gi phyogs nas= sbrang char bzhin (432)du 'bab cing byon: 'og phyogs nas tshe= 'bras drug bzhin du smin cing byon: snyan dang grags pa'i bstod dbyangs rnams:

g.yu 'brug bzhin du grags cing byon: bu slob rigs rgyud 'du ba'i g.yang: skar tshogs bzhin du bkrag shig byon: hūm̐ hrīḥ shar phyogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas: che g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod: lho phyogs rin chen mkha' 'gro mas: zas nor longs spyod g.yang khug cig: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod: nub phyogs padma mkha' 'gro mas: 'khor 'das dbang sdud= snang srid dbang 'du bar mdzod: byang phyogs las kyi mkha' 'gro mas: las bzhi phrin las g.yang= gnod byed gdon bgegs tshar gcod mdzod: nor lha tshogs bdag 'khor bcas kyis: 'dzam gling g.yang rnams 'dir khug cig: phyag g.yang thams cad 'dir= g.yang yul 'di ru g.yang khug cig: (433)gnas khang 'di la rtag par bzhugs: g.yang chas 'di la brtan par mdzod: tshe rdzas 'di la bcud phob cig: mi nor 'di la srung skyobs mdzod: 'gyur ba med par brtan bzhugs 'tshal: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: zad med gter gyi dngos grub= bsod nams nor gyi dngos grub: mchog dang thun mong dngos= 'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzod: sarba siddhi pha la a la la ho: zhes grangs mang bar bsag go/ ༈ kong sprul rin po ches mdzad pa'i grwa mngon dzam dmar g.yang 'gugs ni/ hrīḥdzaḥ dngos grub mchog stsol dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bden grub drang srong gtsang rigs dkar phyogs skyong*/ khyad par nor lha gter bdag sprul 'khor bcas// rab 'byams zhing dang rang rang bzhugs pa'i gnas// pho brang lcang lo can nas skur skyod la// 'da' dka' rdo rje'i tha tshig ma bsnyel bar// bkra shis dpal gyi (434)gang ba'i gnas mchog 'dir// srid zhi'i phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod// sngon byung gdod ma'i mgon pos skad cig la// gzhi snang rig pa 'khor 'das grol gzhir bsdus// lhun rdzogs yon tan phywa dpal g.yang ltar chags/ de ring gnas khyim 'di ru g.yang 'gug go

/bar du mkhan slob chos gsum zhal 'dzom ste// gangs can ljongs su chos srid dpal 'byor drangs// mtha' bzhi'i phywa g.yang tshe dpal 'gugs pa bzhin// de ring lha khyim 'di ru g.yang 'gug go// phyi dus grub rigs mthu rtsal can rnams kyis// phywa cha bkod cing g.yang cha bkram nas kyang*// srid zhi'i g.yang bsdus sbyin bdag dpal bskyed ltar// de ring lha khyim 'di ru g.yang 'gug go/ hrīḥdzaḥ dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*/ chos nyid rnam dag rten 'brel (435)bslu med mthus// lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin bden pa yis// srid dang zhi ba'i phywa g.yang 'dir khug cig /mngon dga' dpal ldan bde ldan las rab rdzogs// stug po bkod pa chos dbyings lhun grub sbubs// rab 'byams sprul pa'i zhing dang der bzhugs kyi// rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs 'dir khug cig /nam mkha' 'byung bzhi ri rab rgya mtsho dang*/ nyi zla gza' skar gling bzhi gling phran khams// nor bu bum bzang dpag bsam ljon shing sogs// brtan pa snod kyi phya g.yang 'dir khug cig /drang srong rig 'dzin mkhas grub dge ba'i bshes// lha klu mi dbang sde brgyad mthu bo che// rigs bzhi rgyal blon btsun mo khyim bdag sogs// g.yo ba bcud kyi phywa g.yanga'adir khug cig /rgya gar rgya nag o rgyan sham bha la// gangs can hor bod ta zig bal po dang*// khrom dang ge sar gar log la sogs pa/(436)/'dzam bu gling gi phywa g.yang 'dir= 'chi med tshe dang sgrib med bsod nams rgyun// 'bad med longs spyod snyan grags gzi mdangs stobs// dpal 'byor dbang thang 'khor slob mnga' ris sogs// mtho ris legs dgu'i phya g.yang 'dir= rma g.yang zas dang dkor mdzod nor gyi rigs// rkang bzhi phyugs dang bang mdzod 'bru sna'i tshogs// brgyud 'dzin srid dang rgol 'joms dpung la sogs// btsan phyug 'phan dar phywa=

mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod grub pa'i yon tan dang*/ rnal 'byor nyams rtogs gsang 'dzin mthu nus rtsal/ chos mthun dkar po'i bsam sbyor ji snyed sogs// dge legs gtan gyi phywa g.yanga'adir khug cig hrī dzaḥ rnal 'byor rigs 'dzin dgongs pa'i rtsal bskyed cing*// le rgan 'bar ba'i dar gyis g.yob pa'i tshe// rtsa gsum nor lha rab 'byams thugs dam bskul// da lta snyigs ma'i dus kyi rgud pa shar// bdag cag (437) yon bdag chos ldan 'byor pa dman// de phyir rtsa gsum nor lha'i tshogs bskul na// thugs dam ma bsnyel phrin las rtsal sprugs la// srid zhi'i dwangs bcud khab len lcags bzhin sdus// sna tshogs nor bu'i char rgyun 'dzad med phob// 'gugs byed zer gyis lha 'dre mi gsum sdus// 'ching byed rgya yis brtan g.yo'i chos kun chings// glog 'gyu'i rtsal gyis yid la gang 'dod khug /lcags kyu 'bar bas srog gi dwangs mar gzir// 'od dmar drwa bas sgo gsum 'chugs med sdoms// dregs ldan sems kyi brtan pa dbang med phrogs// gzugs can gzugs med snang ba chos la sgyur// 'khor 'das lam gyis bsdus pa'i phya g.yang khug /'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa'i = brtan g.yo snod bcud kun gyi= mi 'byed stong gsum zhing gi= ha ye hu ye (438)sngags kyi brda yis 'bod/ spro bsdu sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin pho nya 'gyed// bzang zhing dud pas gtsang rigs lha srung bskul// lha mda' dar sna'i 'phur mas g.yab 'dor nas// ma g.yel ma g.yel rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i lha// ma g.yel ma g.yel gnod sbyin nor gyi bdag /sprul pa'i pho nyas 'jig rten gsum khongs la// phywa g.yang thogs med 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod// phywa tshe 'dod kyi thig le kyi li li/ rma g.yang zer gyi rmu thag sha ra ra/ dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char rgyun si li li/ dmu yal dpal gyi mtsho mo me re re/ g.yang gi lha gzhi dkar po bkra la gsal// tshe bsod dpal gyi lhun po brtan la brjid// phywa g.yang 'byor pa'i snum zhag 'tsher la 'thib// dbang thang nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gsal la brtan// phywa dang bla tshe ri la ma bros la// g.yang dang bsod nams sgo ru ma

(439)nyams pa// 'gyur med phyag rgya gsum gyi rgyas 'debs shing*// mi gnas mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings su sba// mchog gsum nor lha rgya mtsho'i mthu dpal gyis// srid zhi'i phywa g.yang g.yang rdzas 'di la bstim// 'phral yun dge legs nam mkha' mdzod chen la// dbang bsgyur sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs shog ces dang*/ ༈ 'jam mgon mi pham rin po ches mdzad pa'i ge sar rgyal po'i g.yang 'gugs srid zhi'i dwangs bcud bsdus pa'i nor bu ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ phyogs dus kun khyab mnyam pa nyid kyi klong*// mi shigs 'od lnga 'bar ba'i ti la ka// rtag brtan g.yung drung gsang ba'i pho brang nas// ye shes rdo rje'i tshe dbang mchog 'chang ba// rig 'dzin chen po 'dzam gling rgyan mchog rtsal// shes rab ral gri'i mda' gzhu'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// srid pa'i dgra sde 'joms pa'i dpa' bo che// kun 'byung yid bzhin nor bu'i (440)rgyal po ni// sku rje don grub wer ma dkar po dang*// bka' 'khor snang srid dregs pa'i dpung dang bcas// mchod cing bstod nas thugs dam bskul lags na// thogs med phrin las dbang gi 'od zer gyis// steng 'og phyigs bcu'i khams na gnas pa yi// lha klu mi yi srid pa'-i tshe dpal stobs// 'khor 'das lam gsum dwangs ma'i dge mtshan cha// khab len rdo yis lcags bzhin 'dir bkug nas// 'od 'bar bkra shis rdzas kyi rnam pa ru// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig /snang srid bde stong dbyings su zhu ba yi// dgyes mnyam 'dod pa'i rol gar cher g.yo ba'i// ye shes las dang 'jig rten rab 'byams kyi// gter bdag nor lha rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskul// dga' ba'i gar dang dgyes pa'i bro 'khrab cing*// bde ba'i glu dbyangs 'brug stong sgra ltar sgrog /bde chags dbang gi 'od zer kun (441)tu khyab// snang srid rab 'byams shig shig yom yom 'ur// steng nas bkra shis lha yi phywa g.yang khug

/'og nas 'apel chen klu yi phywa= bar nas dge mtshan mi yi phywa= dbyings nas sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin g.yang= gnas nas rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i dgyes= yul nas chos skyong dgra lha'i mthu= zas gos dpal yon ma lus pa// 'od lnga'i thig la'i rnam pa ru// 'dir khug 'dir bsdus 'dir bstim shig /phywa cha g.yang gi rdzas rnams dang*// rnal 'byor lus ngag yid gsum la// byang chub bar du mi 'bral bar// nor bu bum bzang dpag bsam shing*// gser gyi snying po'i sprin bzhin du// dgos 'dod char pa rtag tu phob// 'dod rgu'i 'byor pa mtsho ltar bskyil// stobs dpal nus pa gong du 'phel// rig khams rtsa rlung nyams pa gsos// bkra shis phya g.yang (442)gzi byin spor/ re 'bras da lta nyid du smin// srid zhi'i dwangs bcud dbang gyur nas// 'dod pa chos kyi dbyings su ni// mthar phyin ye shes sku ru smin// mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i phan bde'i char// rtag khyab lhun grub 'bebs par shog /oṃ he he/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha bhandha bhandha/ dha ra ya dha ra ya/ ni rundha ni rundha/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rnam g.yengs kun/ urṇa ma ṇi ye swa hā/ oṃ khu ye khu ye phywa khu ye khu ye khu ye g.yang khu ye/ hu ye hu ye ma hā shri bi dzaḥya 'du/ bde skyid dpal 'byor thams cad puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swa hā/

zhes so/ ༈ thang stong rgyal pos mdzad pa'i g.yang 'gugs ni/ kyai stong gsum khams na yul bde zhing*/ rdzong btsan khrims gnyan dus char bab// lo legs chos dar phyi yi g.yang*// deng 'dir khu ye phywa g.yang len// mi chos phyugs rgyud 'phel nang gshin/ pho dpa' mo mdzangs 'og rta mgyogs// (443)go btsan mtshon rnon nang gi g.yang*// de ring khu ye phywa g.yang len/ mkhas grub rtsod rgyal don gnyis 'grub// nad med tshe ring rgyags skyid bde// mthar thug 'tshang rgya don gyi g.yang*// deng 'dir= chos dbyings chos can bslu med mthu// bden pa'i tshig la dbang rnams kyi// ci btab smon lam 'grub pa'i g.yang*/ deng 'dir= tshos rdzogs rten 'brel mnga' thang g.yang*/ rdzas rtags rgyal srid nye bcas kyis// 'jig rten dge mtshan bkra shis g.yang*/ deng 'dir khu ye phywa g.yang len// dza ya dza ya siddhi hoḥ zhes so/ ༈ dkar lugs tshe ring mchod lnga'i g.yang 'gugs ni/ kyai mchog gsum rtsa gsum chos skyong nor lha'i mthu// 'phags pa'i thugs rje byin rlabs nus rtsal dang*// lha dang drang srong gnod sbyin bsod nams las// grub pa'i mnga' thang snyan grags longs spyod dang*// 'khor los bsgyur ba'i phywa g.yang 'dir= dar po'i dar g.yang (444)btsan po'i btsan g.yang dang*// phyug po'i phyug g.yang thams cad 'dir= shar gyi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang 'gugs pa// bsod nams nyi zla bzhin du shar zhing byon// lho yi phyogs nas= nor phyugs lho sprin bzhin du 'thib cing byon// nub kyi= snyan grags g.yu 'brug bzhin du sgrogs shing byon// byang gi= longs spyod sbrang char bzhin du 'beb cing byon// mtshams bzhi'i phyogs nas= tshe dpal yun ring chu bo bzhin du byin// steng gi= yon tan kun khyab nam mkha' bzhin du byon/ bar snang khams nas= mi rgyud skar tshogs bzhin du bkra zhing byon// 'og gi phyogs= nyams rtogs rtsi shing rgyas ltar smin cing byon// shar phyogs rgya yi ja dar 'dir bsdus shig

/lho phyogs rgya gar chos g.yang= nub phyogs gu ge'i gser g.yu= byang phyogs ga ser rtsal g.yang= cang shes rta yi rta g.yang= za le 'bri yi 'bri g.yang= tshe tshe ra yi ra (445)g.yang= g.yang dkar lug gi lug g.yang= rtsi mchog mar gyi mar g.yang= 'bras drug 'bru yi 'bru g.yang= zang med gter gyi bum pa ltar mdzod la/ dpal 'byor mtsho ltar rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol/ ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog ces dang*/ yang rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro'i khams lnga'i g.yang 'gugs ni/ bhyo/ gzugs phung gti mug gnas dag chos dbyings mdangs/ dus gsum rgyal yum chos dbyings dbang phyug ma'i/ thugs sprul budha gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// dkar mo sna tshogs mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na sdud byed g.yab dar dkar po bsnams// sna tshogs las kun myur bsgrub bden mthu can// dar dkar g.yab cing rgyud bskul spyan 'dren no/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor phywa g.yang 'gugs par mdzod// phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*// steng phyogs lha klu sa bdag lag nas drongs// mi phyugs gnas khang nor/ (446)rdzas rten 'di stims// dwangs gsal gsal khyab tshe g.yang brtan par mdzod// bhyo/ rnam shes zhe sdang gnas dag le long mdangs/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum mchog ma ma ki/ thugs sprul rdo rje gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// sngon mo zhi ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na 'gugs byed g.yab dar sngon po bsnams// mi mthun las rkyen 'joms pa'i bden mthu can// dar sngon g.yab cing= tshe bsod dpal 'byor/ phyogs bcu'i chu khams nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*// shar phyogs dri za rgyal 'gong lag nas drongs// mi phyugs gnas khang nor rdzas rten 'dir stims// snum bcud dkyus ring tshe g.yang brtan par mdzod// bhyo/ tshor ba nga rgyal gnas dag mnyam nyid mdangs// dus gsum rgyal yum sangs rgyas spyan ma yi// thugs sprul rin chen gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// ser mo rgyas pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na 'ching byed (447)g.yab dar ser po bsnams// tshe bsod dpal 'byor skyed pa'i bden mthu can// dar ser g.yab=

tshe bsod= phyogs bcu'-i sa khams nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*// lho phyogs gshin rje srin thel lag nas drongs// mi phyugs gnas khang nor rdzas rten 'dir stims// sra brtan gzhom med tshe g.yang brtan par mdzod// bhyo/ 'du shes 'dod chags gnas dag sor rtogs mdangs// dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed yum gos dkar mo'i// thugs sprul padma gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// dmar mo dbang gi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na 'gugs byed g.yab dar dmar po bsnams// snang srid dbang du 'gugs pa'i bden mthu can// dar dmar g.yab= tshe bsod= phyogs bcu'-i me khams nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*// nub phyogs klu dbang btsan bdud lag nas drongs/ mi phyugs gnas khang nor rdzas rten 'dir stims// drod bkrag gzi 'bar tshe g.yang (448)brtan par mdzod// bhyo/ 'du byed phrag dog gnas dag bya grub mdangs// dus gsum rgyal yum dam tshig sgrol ma yis// thugs sprul karma gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// ljang mo las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na myos byed g.yab dar ljang gu bsnams// bar chad dgra gegs 'dul ba'i bden mthu can// dar ljang g.yab = tshe bsod= phyogs bcu'-i rlung khams nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin ma mo'i lag nas drongs// mi phyugs gnas khang nor rdzas rten 'dir stims// g.yo myur stobs ldan tshe g.yang brtan pa mdzod// ces so// ༈ klong chen snying thig las yum ka'i g.yang 'gugs lhan thabs phyung ba ni// hūm̐/ shar gyi phyogs nas g.yang 'gugs ma// rdo rje yum chen sangs rgyas spyan// phyag na mda' dar bum pa 'dzin// 'byung ba sa yi bkrag mdangs bcud// phywa dang g.yang du 'dir khug cig /lho yi phyogs nas g.yang 'gugs ma// rin chen yum ni ma mā ki// phyag na (449)mda'= 'byung ba chu yi bkrag= phywa dang g.yang= nub kyi phyogs nas g.yang= padma'i yum chen na bza' dkar// phyag na=

'byung ba me yi= phywa dang g.yang= byang gi phyogs= las rab yum chen dam tshig sgrol// phyag na= 'byung ba rlung gi= phywa dang= dbus kyi phyogs nas g.yang= dbyings kyi dbyings phyur kun tu bzang*// phyag na= 'byung ba nam mkha'i= phya dang= btsun mo dpal ldan nor gyi rgyun// sku mdog gtso ma gser gyi mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyed skyil bzhugs// me tog bi dza pu ra dang*/ rin chen 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin// shin tu mdzes ldan dbu skra grol// mu tig nor bu'i do shal dang*// utpal me tog phreng bas brgyan// 'bras ldan byang chub shing la brten// rin chen 'bru yi bang mdzod dang*// rta dang ba lang g.yag lug phyugs// tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang gter// longs spyod nor gyi (450)dngos grub kun// char ltar 'beb pa'i g.yang khug cig /zla ba'i 'od zer dbyangs can ma// 'phags ma dang ni sbas ma dang*// nor sbyin ma dang rab sbyin ma// lha mo mdzes ma rab bzang ma// dbul ba sel ba khyed rnams kyis// rin chen 'bru sogs 'gres/ shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung*// mkhas shing bu mang dpal dang ldan// dri za kun kyi bdag po yin// smin drug la sogs shar skar bdun// rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ma dang*// don grub dang ni mi pham ma// dga' mchog ma dang dga' bde ma// dga' can ma dang dga' 'phel ma// lha mo gzhon nu brgyad rnams kyis// rin chen 'bru: sogs/ lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po// mkhas shing bu mang dpal dang ldan// grul bum kun kyi bdag po yin// mchu dang bre dang lho skar bdun// dpal ldan ma dang grags ldan ma// grags pa thob dang grags 'dzin ma// legs par (451)las dang rab snga dang*// legs par sad dang bde sgrub ma// lha mo gzhon nu brgyad rnams kyis// rin chen 'bru= sogs/ nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang*// mkhas shing bu mang dpal dang ldan// klu rnams kun kyi bdag po yin// lha mtshams la sogs rgyu skar drug// rna cha sra mkhregs ma dang ni// padma dkar dang skya rengs dang*// cha med gcig dang dgu pa dang*// rol dang gnas dang stobs myur srid// lha mo gzhon nu brgyad rnams kyis// rin chen 'bru=

sogs/ byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras// mkhas shing bu mang dpal dang ldan// gnod sbyin kun kyi bdag po yin// mon gru la sogs byang skar bdun// rab chags lha mo stong lha mo// sa dang de bzhin padma dang*// rgyal po che dang nye gnas dang*// rigs dang khrel yod dpal ldan ma// lha mo gzhon nu brgyad rnams kyis// rin chen 'bru yi= ri rgyal lhun po'i steng phyogs nas// (152)dbang po la sogs lha chen brgyad// rol mtsho la gnas klu chen sde// go la'i khyim gyi drang srong tshogs// phyogs skyong dgu dang 'jigs byed tshogs// dpal mgon bdun cu'i tshogs rnams kyis/ rin chen 'bru= sogs/ gling chen bzhi dang gling phran brgyad// ri rab zom dang gser ri bdun// rol mtsho lha gnas rgya mtsho'i rum// sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i lha// ri rab nags tshal skyed mos tshal// gtsug lag khang dang rgyal po'i khab// grong dang grong khyer la gnas pa'i// lha yi phywa dang snod kyi g.yang*// rin chen 'bru yi= sogs/ mkhar gyi rtse dang sgyes po'i lha// thab lha yu mo 'bar ba dang*// mu dang snang dang mkhar gong la// gnas pa'i zhing lha tshangs pa dang*/ khyim lha gel thung nang lha dang*// sgo lha rta g.yang phyugs kyi lha// rma g.yang tshogs lha don grub dang*// rta lha dmag dpon nor lha mchog /kha rje dbang (453)thang snyan grags lha// sbu gu mi la 'go ba yi// srog lha mo lha dgra lha dang*// pho lha yul lha lo zla zhags// spar sme tshes grangs dus tshod lha// snod kyi phywa dang bcud kyi g.yang*/ rin chen 'bru yi= khyad par g.yang can nor gyi lha// jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// mkha' 'gro'i rgyal mo spun lnga yi// 'chi med tshe dang rigs rgyud bu// rma g.yang nor dang rkang bzhi phyugs// mngon shes gter dang zas gos nor// lo tog bcud dang bza' shing dpal// char chu rgyas shing lo 'bras legs// phan tshun mdza' dang nad yams med// bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i g.yang*// 'bad pa med par deng 'dir khug

/mdor na lha dang mi'i drang srong*// tshogs kyi bdag po gnod sbyin sde// nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci// lto phye che dang 'phrog ma'i bu// sna tshogs gzugs sprul rdzu 'phrul can// srid pa chags pa'i snod dang bcud// ma (454)lus lus pa med pa yi// phywa g.yang ma 'khyams kyi li li// phywa g.yang ma yar nu ru ru// phya g.yang ma dog ta la la// rgyu 'byor yon gyi bdag po yi// bla dang tshe dang bsod nams dang*// dbang thang rten du gnas 'dir bzhugs// dga' 'khyil bzhin du kyi li li// g.yung grung bzhin du 'du ru ru// rgya mtsho bzhin du me re re// gnas 'dir brtan pa'i bkra shis shog / ces dang*/ ༈ yang snying thig tshe ring ma'i g.yang 'gugs bsdus pa ni/ bhyo mkha' 'gro chen mo sde lnga ni// ye shes lnga yi klong nas sprul// 'byung ba chen po kun la khyab// 'byung ba chen po nam mkha' ni// 'byung ba lnga yi bdag po ste// de nyid las ni thams cad sprul// sra zhing 'thad pa brtan pa'i gzhi// rin po che yi 'byung gnas las// brtan g.yo'i dngos po thams cad sprul// rin chen 'bru dang rta nor phyugs// sna tshogs dbyig gi g.yang khu cig /rlan cing gsher ba chu yi klong*// rgya mtsho che dang (455)rol mtsho bdun// klu dbang rnams kyi mdzod yin pas// sna tshogs nor bu'i phya dang g.yang*// 'bad pa med par deng 'dir khug// drod ni sreg pa me yi klong*// rta gdong rgod ma kha'i dbyings la// smin zhing skyed pa'i rten 'brel dang*// de las byung zhing smin pa'i bcud// dngos grub yon tan g.yang khug cig /yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi khams// skyed dang sdud pa'i bdag po ste// chud mi za ba'i srod 'dzin byed// de las byung ba'i phywa dang g.yang*// dngos grub thams cad 'dir khug cig /mdor na lha klu mi'i nor bu// gling bzhi ri rab rgya mtsho'i bcud// sa rdo ri brag snod bcud dang*// lha dbang klu dbang rgyal po'i mdzod// nyi zla gza' skar go la'i gnas// lha dang drang srong mngon shes can// bskal par gnas pa'i phywa dang g.yang*// ma lus lus pa med pa kun// rten 'brel rdzas kyi nus pa yis// deng gi rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi// (456)bsod

nams tshe dpal longs spyod la// nyi zla bzhin du kyi li li// longs spyod bzhin du me re re// chu klung bzhin du 'du ru ru// 'dres shing brtan pa'i g.yang khug cig ces so// ༈ rgyal dbang lnga pas mdzad pa'i dgra lha rta thugs dkar po'i g.yang 'gugs ni/ kyai/ 'jig rten mun pa sel ba nyi zla'i g.yang*// de ring bkra shis gnas 'dir myur du khug /yid bzhin nor bu phun tshogs dgos 'dod g.yang*// de ring= tshangs pa rgya byin la sogs lha yi g.yang*// de ring= 'khor los bsgyur rgyal la sogs mi yi g.yang*// de ring= dga' bo 'jog po la sogs klu yi g.yang*// de ring gnos sbyin tshogs kyi 'dzad med 'byor pa'i g.yang*// de ring= ge sar dpa' brtul 'dzom pa dmag gi g.yang*// de ring= rigs rgyud bu tshad grangs med 'phel ba'i g.yang*/ de ring= mtshon chas mi phig go khrab btsan pa'i g.yang*// de ring= gang bsam skad cig bgrod pa rta yi g.yang*// de ring= phun tshogs (457)phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i g.yang*// gnas 'dir bkra shis phywa dang g.yang du 'khyil// nor lha gnyen po 'khor dang bcas pa kun// nyin dus bya ra mtshan dus mel tshe mdzod// rgyab kyi rten ma mdun gyi mkhar ba mdzod// phar 'gro bskyol la tshur 'ong bsu ba dang*// na gdon chag chen bar chad kun las skyobs// bsam don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ༈ mthar g.yang rten de dag thams cad kyang rdo rje'i mtshon cha me dpung gi gur du tshud nas bse rag 'gong po sris rkun sogs kyis glag lta ba'i gnas med par bsgom la// sba zhing brtan par bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ dkon mchog rtsa gsum byin rlabs dang*// chos dbyings 'gyur med bden pa yis// 'khor 'das phya g.yang dwangs ma'i bcud// bkra shis g.yang rten rnams la thim// sa bcud ser po gser la bsdu/ chu bcu lan tsha'i snying po bsdu// me bcud 'bar ba'i shel la bsdu// rlung bcud srab 'jam dar la bsdu/

mkha' bcud me long (158)gtsang mar bsdu// spros pas khams gsum bkrag mdangs ldan// bsdus pas rten la gzi byin bskyed// brtan pas mi 'gyur rdo rje 'dra// mi nyams nyi zla'i ga 'ur sba/ mi shigs rdo rje'i phreng bas bsdoms// bdud rtsi thabs sbyor rigs sngags kyis// bden pa'i mthu yis bgegs las srungs// chos kyi dbyings su bcud sbas pas// sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs na/ gnod byed bgegs rnams lta ci smos// chos nyid thabs shes sku gsung thugs// tshad med ye shes pha rol pyin// kha sbyor bdun gyi phyag rgya las// nam g.yang 'da' bar mi 'gyur zhing*// tshe g.yang bkra shis 'phel bar shog /oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra rakṣa rakṣa/

grangs kha shas brjod// nongs bshags ni/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs// yig brgya dbyangs gsal// rten snying bcas lan gsum brjod la lhag chad kha skong zhing nus pa brtan par bya'o// brtan bzhugs ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpal chen mo 'khor (459)dang bcas pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu'ang sgrub pa'i rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du de srid du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang*/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ya swa bha/ zhes 'bru 'thor/ bkra shis brjod pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas padma rnam rgyal 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin// de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab g.yo med pa// 'jig rten (460)gsum du grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams kyi zhi byed pa// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin// dam chos bden pa thob pa'i bkra shis kyis phyug cing*// dge 'dun mi dang lha dang lha ma yon gyi gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpal chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i = oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ya swa hā/

zhes 'bru 'thor// bkra shis brjod pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba= sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis sngon du 'gro bas 'os zhing 'thad pa'i bkra shis rgyas bsdus ci rigs brjod cing*/ bye brag tu/ rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus skyed pa'i yum// thugs rje tshad med nor gyi char pa 'bebs// mar gad mdog can rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// lha mo dpal chen mo yi bkra shis shog /grangs med gong nas mngon par (461)byang chub kyang*// thugs rje'i mthu yi nor sbyin sems ma'i tshul// gser mdog rin chen rgyan ldan mdzes sdug ma// lha mo chen mo brgyad kyi bkra shis shog /gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas// tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes shing*// sgrub pa po la dbyig gis char 'bebs pa'i// gnod sbyin nor skyong rnams kyis bkra shis shog /tshangs dang bgya byin rgyal po chen po bzhi// rang rang sder bcas mthu dang dpal ldan pa// ston pa'i dam chos skyong bar mdzad pa yi// lha yi dge bsnyen rnams kyi bkra shis shog /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags dang*/ nor dang longs spyod 'dod rgu phongs med pa// gong nas gong du 'dzad med gter la spyod// sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa la sogs pa rnams kyis mtha' rgyas par bya'o// ༈ de nas gzhi bdag dkar gtor dang*// gtor 'gugs bcas sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas// chad tho ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bskal pa'i dang po la: slob dpon (462)padma thod phreng gis: dam la btags pa'i srung ma rnams: chos nyid bden pa'i bka' la nyon: gdong dmar bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir: lha srin sde rgya dam la btags: bdag ni slob dpon de'i rgyud: khyod ni lha 'dre g.yar dam can: sngon tshe slob dpon bka' ma bcag: da lta sngags 'chang dam ma dbral: rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par brjod:

brtan ma ni/ bhyo: slob dpon padma thod phreng gi: bka' nyan ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs: dam chosadapal gyi gtor ma longs: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: bro mnan ni/ hūm̐: nga ni 'jigs byed chen po ste: khams gsum thams cad spyi nas non: dgra bgegs gdug can 'byung po rnams: dug gsum las kyi khung bur mnan: mnan no bcings so sa mā yā: rdo rje bro yi rgyas gdab po: sus kyang 'jig par nus ma yin: oṃ lam hūm̐ laṃ st+waṃ bha ya nan: rjes chog mchod bstod ni/ oṃ ku ru kulle sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ= sogs/ gang gi dran pa (463)tsam gyis na: lha dang lha min mir bcas rnams: nges par mngag zhugs byed gyur pa'i: /sgron ma de la phyag 'tshal bstod// nongs bshags ni/ ma rnyes yongs su= sogs dang yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ /'dir ni rten dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya// bsdu ldang ni/ bdag mdun thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer byung*// snod bcud la phog thams cad 'od dmar zhu// me long la ni has btab yal ba bzhin// thams cad bdag thim bdag kyang hrīḥl thim// de yang rim gyis 'dus nas stong pa nyid// slar yang zung 'jug gtso bo rkyang pa'i skus// 'khor ba ji srid 'gro ba'i don bya'o// dge bas bdag gzhan 'brel thog thams cad kun// bde chen zhing gi dpal la spyod par shog /rab dkar chos spyod bcu dang dge ba bcu// mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum dang thos bsam sgom// bslab pa gsum gyi dri bsung rab 'phro ba'i// 'dus pa'i padmo 'dab stong ldan (464)gyur cig /dge 'dun sde rgyas 'chad dang rtsom pa dang*// thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba kun 'phel zhing*// 'dus pa mthun dang tshe ring nad med sogs// 'dod rgu du mas phongs par ma gyur cig /'byor pa rnam thos bus kyang 'gran med cing*// btsun tshul nye bar 'khor ltar bag yod par// gzhan don spyan ras gzigs kyi phrin las bzhin// thub dbang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog

/ bkra shis ni/ byin rlabs mchog stsol rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*/ dngos grub mchog stsol 'phags ma rig byed ma// dpal gyi lha mo rnam mang thos sras sogs// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog / ces me tog gi char phob pas dge legs bya'o// | sgrub pa grol ba'i nyin tha ma la/ gong gi mjug chog gi brtan bzhugs zin nas/ sbyin bdag la g.yang rdzas gtad pa ni/ ༈ dpal chen lha mo 'khor gyi grogs mo brgyad dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ste rten rnams sal thim pas g.yang rten rnams ngo bo lha mo 'khor bcas gnyis su med pa la rnam (465)pa 'khor bcas gyi phya g.yang dwangs bcud thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che lta bur gyur/ kyai/ de ring dngos grub rgya mtsho stsol// rin chen 'byung ldan nam yang lang*/ bkra shis gdugs kyi snga dro la// sngags 'chang rig 'dzin bdag cag gis// mi yi g.yang dang phyugs kyi rtsi// pha btsun dgra bla'i bkrag g.yang bcas// bkra shis g.yang rten bcas pa rnams// gti mug rmongs pa'i lag tu g.yang mi gtad// nga rgyal dregs pa'i lag tu g.yang mi gtad// 'dod chags glen pa'i lag tu g.yang mi gtad// phrag dog gtum po'i lag= pha spun phyi che'i lag= bu sring mag pa'i lag= 'dre srin byur gsum lag= mi la bse rag= god 'dre the'u rang lag= g.yang gtad su dang gang la gtad// g.yang gtad yon bdag 'di la gtad// lha mda' dar sna'i rgyan ldan la// rin chen dngul dkar me long btags// dpal (466)chen lha mo 'khor dang bcas// tsan dan dri bzhin 'bral med bzhugs// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi phywa g.yang 'du// de ring yon bdag khyod la gtad/ rin chen g.yang bshos rgyan ldan 'di// brjid ldan ri rab lhun po bzhin// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu 'dra// de ring yon bdag khyod la gtad// g.yang sgye rin chen sna lnga'i bcud// dar sna rnga ma'i rgyan gyis brgyan// mi nor phyugs gsum 'phel ba'i g.yang*// de ring yon bdag khyod la gtad// g.yangs spel padma 'dab brgyad dang*// g.yang gi gser sbrul 'khyil pa dang*/

g.yang phor mar khus bkang ba yang*/ de ring= gser dngul g.yu sogs rin chen rigs// dar sna gos sna go mtshon dang*// lo tog 'bru dang rtsi bdud mar// bdud rtsi ja chang 'o ma'i mtsho// ro ldan kha zas mang po sogs// sna tshogs g.yang rdzas 'di rnams kun// 'dod rgu'i dpal yon 'byung ba'i phyir/ yid (467)bzhin nor bu rin chen 'dra// de ring= tshe yi rten phur ma bud cig /g.yang gi mtsho mo ma skam zhig /bkra shis bde legs 'byung bar shog /skyid kyi nyi ma 'char bar shog /tshe yi rten phur tshugs par shog /g.yang gi rgya mtsho 'khyil bar shog /nor gyi dpal g.yang 'phel bar shog /srid kyi chu mig rdol bar shog /bla med byang chub thob par shog / ces gtad la/ gong gi bkra shis dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa/ rab 'byams rgyal ba sogs nas sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog bar brjod la sbyin bdag rang gnas su btang*/ de nas rten yod sar phyin la/ kyai/ bkra shis g.yang gi ra ba ru// 'khor 'das bcud kyi rten phur btsug /'dod rgu 'byung ba'i bang mdzod 'dir// phya g.yang 'du ba'i gta' 'dzug go /bsod nams dpal las grub pa yi// 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo dang*/ khyim bdag rta mchog glang po che// phyogs las rnam rgyal sde (468)dpon te// rin chen sna bdun g.yang gi rten// g.yang rnams rten la 'khor bar mdzod// rgyal ba'i mtshan bzang las grub pa// dpal be'u 'khor lo padma gdugs// rgyal mtshan dung dkar bum pa nya// bkra shis rtags brgyad g.yang gi rten// g.yang rnams rten la 'khor bar mdzod// srid zhir dge legs byed pa'i rdzas// me laung dur ba bilba zho// gi waṃ li khri yungs dkar dung*// bkra shis rdzas brgyad g.yang gi rten// g.yang rnams rten la 'khor bar mdzod// rin chen dar zab lhab lhub gos// go mtshon 'bru sna zas sna dang*// phyugs lug spu dang dkar mngar phud// bkra shis dge mtshan can rnams kyi// dpal dang 'byor pa'i bcud bsdus nas// phywa yi rtags dang g.yang gi rten// dmu zhags dwangs ma ma yal bar/

khang khyim 'di ru legs bkod pas// phywa g.yang ma nyams rten la bzhugs// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// dad cing mos pa'i rten la bzhugs/ dpal (469)gyi lha mo 'khor dang bcas// mda' dar la sogs rten la bzhugs// steng 'og bar gsum nor lha rnams// sna tshogs g.yang gi rdzas la bzhugs// 'go ba'i lha dang skyobs pa'i lha// rgyab rten sdong grogs mdzad pa'i lha// dgra bla yul lha khyim lha rnams// ma 'khyams ma bros rten 'dir bzhugs// srid pa gsum gyi phywa g.yang sdus// khyim lha gel thung che btsun lha// ma lha bu rdzi 'phen pa'i lha// nor lha rma g.yang btsan phyug lha// thab lha rog po grogs mdzad lha// sgo lha stag g.yag dpa' dar lha// g.yangagi ra ba sgo bzhi po// mthun pa'i rdzas la rten chos la// mi nor zas gsum srung ba dang*// dgra 'dre gdon gsum thal bar rlog// dus dang rgyun du dad mos kyis// mchod pa 'bul ba dgyes bzhes la// 'khor 'das phywa dang g.yang gi bcud// rgyu sbyor 'di yi spyod yul (470)du/ 'dzad med gter tu gyur pa dang*// yon bdag mi nor zas gsum bcas// dus rnams rtag tu srung ba dang*// dpal 'byor longs spyod phywa g.yang kun// mi nyams 'phel rgyas rab brtan pas// sbyin bdag gnas skabs mthar thug kun// mi 'dzad gter la spyod par shog g.yang sgo bsdams pa ni/ kyai/ da ni g.yang la srung bkod 'tshal// phywa g.yang mi nyams sgo bsdam mo// 'byung ba'i lha mo chen mo ni// don dam rigs kyi yum mchog lnga// mda' dar bum pa phyag na 'dzin// 'byung ba'i dwangs bcud 'khyil pa'i g.yang*// phyag rgya lnga yi rgyas thob la// phywa g.yang phyi ru ma btab zhig /dzam bha la dang gang ba bzang*/ ma ṇi bha dra ku be ra// rang rtags mtshon cha ne'u le bsnams/ gnod sbyin bye ba'i 'khor dang bcas// srid gsum dpal 'byor bsdus pa'i gter// thugs dam bzhin du bsrung mdzod la// phywa g.yang phyi ru ma btang zhig

/yul (471)'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po// spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras// mthu ldan chos kyi rgyal po bzhi// rin chen go mtshon brjid pa ldan// de ring thugs dam ma bsnyel bar// bkra shis g.yang gi gter mdzod srungs// phyogs bzhi'i gdon la bka' nan stsol// phywa g.yang phyi ru ma btang zhig /mchong gi sgo mos thag gi sa gnon// gser gyi sgo mos thag gis bkag /ting 'dzin rgyas btab mi 'jig cing*/ sngags kyi rgyas btab nyams pa med// phyag rgya'i rgyas btab 'grol mi srid// phywa gsum g.yang gi sgo la gdab// ma grol bar du mi 'grol bar// mi g.yang phyugs rtsi brtan gyur cig /shar sgo shing stag skya bos srungs// lho sgo g.yu 'brug sngon pos srungs// nub sgo gnyan bya dmar pos srungs// byang sgo rus sbal rgya bos srungs// phyi sgo gser gyi mi bo dang*// nang sgo lcags kyi mi bo ches// srungs (472)la phywa g.yang brtan par mdzod// sgo srung mthu rtsal ma tshung cig /bkra shis g.yang rten ma 'chug cig /'dre srin nang du mazhugs shig /bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs shog oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swa hā/ smon lam gdab pa ni/ 'dod pa'i khams na longs spyod pa'i// dngos grub bdag gi kun thob nas// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog mchod// phrin las rnam bzhi rdzogs par shog /rin chen sna bdun longs spyod nas// gter gyi dngos grub phyug rnams dang*// gzi brjid ldan dang dpal chen mos// rtag tu bdag la srung gyur cig /bang mdzod 'bru dang 'dod 'jo'i ba// rgyal mtshan 'khor los sgyur ba dang*// thogs med rdzu 'phrul grub nas ni// lam mchog bde la gnas par shog cais dang*/ nyi ma thams cad dge ba yin// rgyu skar thams cad bzang po yin// sangs rgyas thams cad rdzu 'phrul che// dgra bcom rnams ni zag pa zad// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ (473)
